en: Jacoba Mosselhof is a courtyard street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Although Amsterdam has a long history of almshouse courtyards, the Jacoba Mosselhof was only created in the 21st century. It is named after the social and political activist Jacoba Mossel.

name: Jan Cupidohof
en: The Jan Cupidohof is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Jan Evertsenstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Jan Evertsenstraat is a street in the Amsterdam boroughs of West and Nieuw-West. It was named in 1910, when the road was still planned in the municipality of Sloten. After annexation, Amsterdam kept the name by council decision in 1925. It is named after the Zeeland naval hero Johan Evertsen (1600-1666).

name: Jan Luijkenstraat
en: Jan Luijkenstraat is a street in the Museumkwartier, Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Jan Maijenstraat
en: The Jan Maijenstraat is a street in the Jan Maijenbuurt of Amsterdam-West, laid out in the mid-1920s. It lies between the Vespuccistraat and the Mercatorstraat and runs parallel to the Jan Evertsenstraat. The name is a tribute to the seafarer Jan Jacobsz.

name: Jan Nautahof
en: The Jan Nautahof is a street in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. By council decision of 17 October 1984 it was named after Jan Nauta (Almelo, 1917 - Vught camp, 1944), a resistance fighter and member of the Trouwgroep. Several streets in this neighbourhood are named after resistance fighters.

name: Jan Pieter Heijestraat
en: The Jan Pieter Heijestraat is a street in Amsterdam-West. It links the Overtoom with the Kinkerstraat, and halfway along it crosses the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. It was named in 1898 after the Amsterdam physician and poet Jan Pieter Heije (1809-1876).

name: Jan Schaeferpad
en: The Jan Schaeferpad is a footpath with an associated cycle path in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The municipality named two objects in the Basic Register of Addresses and Buildings (BAG) after Jan Schaefer: the Jan Schaeferbrug and the Jan Schaeferpad, named on 11 July 2000.

name: Jan van Eijckstraat
en: The Jan van Eijckstraat is a street in the Zuid borough of Amsterdam. It is named after the Flemish painter Jan van Eyck (1390-1441).

name: Jan van Riebeekstraat
en: The Jan van Riebeekstraat is a street in the Chassébuurt, Amsterdam-West.

name: Javakade
en: The Javakade is a street and quay along the southern side of Java Island in Amsterdam-Oost. It runs east from the western tip of Java Island to the Seranggracht. At the western tip it turns north-east and joins the Sumatrakade.

name: Javaplantsoen
en: The Javaplantsoen is a largely paved park in the Indische Buurt of Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Javaplein
en: The Javaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost's Indische Buurt, where the Molukkenstraat and Javastraat cross and the Borneostraat and Eerste Ceramstraat join. Notable buildings include the former bathhouse, the Berlage blocks and the Borneohof, which won the Amsterdam New Building Prize in 2012.

name: Javastraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Javastraat is a street in the Indische Buurt of Amsterdam-Oost. It continues the line of the Eerste van Swindenstraat, from the Celebesstraat to the Javaplantsoen, and is the main shopping street of the neighbourhood.

name: Jennerstraat
en: The Jennerstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Joan Muyskenweg
en: The Joan Muyskenweg is a road that begins in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Overamstel district, and ends in Duivendrecht in the municipality of Ouder-Amstel.

name: Joh. M. Coenenstraat
en: The Joh. M. Coenenstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid that continues the line of the Beethovenstraat to the Roelof Hartplein. It is named after the Hague conductor and composer Johannes Meinardus Coenen (1824-1899). Because it is short, many people wrongly think this stretch is also called the Beethovenstraat.

name: Johan Rijnjastraat
en: Johan Rijnjastraat is a street in Amsterdam-Noord. It was built on farmland enclosed by De Nieuwe Noorder and the Rijksweg 10 (Ringweg-Noord).

name: Johannes Verhulststraat
en: The Johannes Verhulststraat is a street in the Amsterdam borough of Zuid, named after the Dutch composer and conductor Johannes Verhulst.

name: Johannes Vermeerstraat
en: The Johannes Vermeerstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid was named in 1903 after the 17th-century painter Johannes Vermeer (1632-1675). It runs from the Hobbemastraat to the Ruysdaelstraat. Its first section borders the Museumplein on the odd-numbered side. Halfway along is the Johannes Vermeerplein, named after the painter in 1909.

name: Johannes Worpstraat
en: The Johannes Worpstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. The street off the Prinses Irenestraat received its name by council decision on 1 February 1956, after the organist Johannes Worp.

name: John M. Keynesplein
en: The John M. Keynesplein is a square in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Joos Banckersplantsoen
en: The Joos Banckersplantsoen is an open space in Amsterdam-West. It was named by district council decision on 14 May 2001 after the admiral Joos Banckers.

name: Joos Banckersweg
en: The Joos Banckersweg is a street in Amsterdam-West. It was named by council decision of 20 April 1939 after the admiral Joos Banckers.

name: Kadijksplein
en: The Kadijksplein is a square in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is built up only on its eastern and southern sides; the western and northern sides are formed by the Schippersgracht and the Prins Hendrikkade.

name: Pluvierplein
en: The Pluvierplein is a square in the Vogelbuurt in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Poeldijkstraat
en: The Poeldijkstraat is a street in the Westlandgracht district of Slotervaart in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Polderweg
en: The Polderweg is a street in Amsterdam-Oost. It runs north-east from the Linnaeusstraat. Where it meets the railway line between Amsterdam Muiderpoort and Amsterdam Science Park it bends, and continues south-east to bridge 2360 over the Ringvaart.

name: Polluxplein
en: The Polluxplein is one of the many small squares in Tuindorp Oostzaan. Like the Polluxstraat, it was named on 26 October 1921 after the star Pollux, in a district where all streets and squares are named after celestial bodies. It is one of four squares arranged symmetrically around the Zonneplein.

name: Pompmanstraat
en: The Pompmanstraat is a street and alley in Amsterdam-Oost. It lies on Borneo Island and, together with the Botteliersplein, is intended for pedestrians linking the Pythonbrug and the Korte brug. The street was named on 27 November 1996 by the Zeeburg borough.

name: Pontplein
en: The Pontplein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord. It received its name in the period 2006-2013. It is not yet mentioned in the Stadsatlas published in 2006, but does appear in official documents from 2013. It is named after the landing stages of the IJpleinveer ferry.

name: Populierenweg
en: The Populierenweg is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Postjesweg (Amsterdam)
en: The Postjesweg (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-West and Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Potgieterstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Potgieterstraat (Amsterdam) is a Dutch street in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Potvisstraat
en: The Potvisstraat is a street in the Walvisbuurt, Oostzanerwerf, Amsterdam-Noord. Around 1991 the Walvisbuurt was laid out, and its streets were named after animals hunted in the whaling trade.

name: President Brandstraat
en: The President Brandstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Prinses Amaliaplein
en: The Prinses Amaliaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is already shown on Hendrik Petrus Berlage's Plan Zuid of 1917. It forms the terminus of the Minervalaan towards the Zuiderstation. It would, however, take the city years to reach this point, although the ground plan has hardly changed.

name: Prinses Marijkestraat
en: The Prinses Marijkestraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Prinses Irenebuurt.

name: Raamdwarsstraat
en: The Raamdwarsstraat is a relatively short street at the southern tip of the Jordaan, Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Raamplein
en: The Raamplein is a square in central Amsterdam. It lies on the Marnixstraat at the height of the Passeerdersgracht. The much older Raamstraat and the Raamdwarsstraat (named since 1913) lead onto the square.

name: Radarweg
en: The Radarweg is a road in Amsterdam-Westpoort and Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was built to link the Basisweg with the Westelijk Havengebied. It originally lay within the harbour area, but an advancing city brought ever more buildings. The arrival of Station Amsterdam Sloterdijk in Teleport marked a turning point.

name: Radioweg (Amsterdam)
en: The Radioweg (Amsterdam) is a street in the Watergraafsmeer district of the Oost borough. It has two parts: the first runs through a residential neighbourhood, and the second runs between and alongside sports grounds.

name: Rapenburgerstraat
en: The Rapenburgerstraat is a street between the Muiderstraat and the Anne Frankstraat in the Dutch capital, Amsterdam. Like the Rapenburgerplein and the Rapenburg street, it is named after the artificial near-island Rapenburg. The Rapenburgerstraat once lay along the former island of Marken (also called Valkenburg) in the old Jodenbuurt.

name: Reestraat
en: The Reestraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms part of the De 9 Straatjes shopping area.

name: Reggestraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Reggestraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. The name Reggestraat occurs in about ten municipalities in the Netherlands.

name: Reigersbos (straat)
en: Reigersbos (straat) is a street in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Reijnier Vinkeleskade
en: The Reijnier Vinkeleskade is a street in the Museumkwartier district of Zuid.

name: Reimersbeek
en: Reimersbeek is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, Buitenveldert.

name: Reinier Claeszenplein
en: The Reinier Claeszenplein is a square in the Geuzenbuurt in De Baarsjes in Amsterdam-West.

name: Remijden
en: Remijden is a street in Osdorp in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Reyer Anslostraat
en: The Reyer Anslostraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Richard Wagnerstraat
en: The Richard Wagnerstraat is a street in the Apollobuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Rietwijkerstraat
en: The Rietwijkerstraat is a street in the Hoofddorppleinbuurt in the Amsterdam Zuid borough.

name: Rijnsburgstraat
en: The Rijnsburgstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid between the Sloterkade and the Aalsmeerplein. It is named after the South Holland village of Rijnsburg. It was previously part of the Sloterweg, which linked Amsterdam with the village of Sloten.

name: Rijnstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Rijnstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Amsterdam Rivierenbuurt in the Zuid borough. The street lies on land annexed from the municipality of Nieuwer Amstel in 1896 and, by council decision of 22 March 1922, was named after the River Rhine. It is exactly one kilometre long.

name: Rijtuigenhof
en: The Rijtuigenhof is a street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Robijnstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Robijnstraat (Amsterdam) is a street located in the De Pijp district of Amsterdam.

name: Roelantstraat
en: The Roelantstraat is an extremely short street in Amsterdam-West. By council decision of 20 April 1939 it was named after the Roelantslied, as part of a series of names drawn from medieval literature.

name: Roelof Hartplein
en: The Roelof Hartplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid where the Roelof Hartstraat, Van Baerlestraat, Joh. M. Coenenstraat and Cornelis Anthoniszstraat meet. The square was named in 1917 after the physician and philanthropist Roelof Hart (1837-1892).

name: Roelof Hartstraat
en: The Roelof Hartstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, between the Roelof Hartplein and the Hobbemakade. It was named in 1893 after the physician and philanthropist Roelof Hart (1837-1892). The neighbouring stretch, which had also carried the name, was renamed Van Baerlestraat in 1917.

name: Roetersstraat
en: The Roetersstraat is a street in the Plantagebuurt, in the eastern part of Amsterdam's canal belt. It links the Sarphatistraat with the Plantage Kerklaan. The street crosses the Valckenierstraat, the Nieuwe Achtergracht and the Nieuwe Prinsengracht, and borders the Nieuwe Kerkstraat and the Nieuwe Keizersgracht.

name: Roggeveenstraat
en: The Roggeveenstraat is a residential street in the Spaarndammer- and Zeeheldenbuurt in Amsterdam. It is named after the Dutch explorer Jacob Roggeveen.

name: Roomtuintjes
en: Roomtuintjes in Amsterdam is a street in the Dapperbuurt, Amsterdam-Oost. Most of the original buildings in this neighbourhood date from the late 19th century. Roomtuintjes was laid out in the 1970s. The street name, only fixed in 1973, refers to the Herberg De Roomtuintjes inn and its associated roomtuintjes.

name: Rosendaalstraat
en: The Rosendaalstraat is a street in the Tuindorp Amstelstation neighbourhood, Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Rozenstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Rozenstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Jordaan district of Amsterdam. It is named after the rose flower. Numerous municipalities in the Netherlands and Belgium have a Rozenstraat.

name: Rudolf Dieselstraat
en: The Rudolf Dieselstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Rumphiusstraat
en: The Rumphiusstraat is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. Open only to pedestrians, cyclists and mopeds, it runs between the Conradstraat and the Isaac Titsinghkade. It received its name only in 2005, named after Georg Everhard Rumphius. It lies on the former site of the NSM.

name: Rusland (straat)
en: The Rusland (straat) is a street in central Amsterdam. It links the Oudezijds Achterburgwal with the Kloveniersburgwal and lies in line with the Sint Agnietenstraat. It is a short but wide street. It is so wide because its left-hand side was originally the Raamsloot, which was filled in during the 16th century.

name: Rutherfordstraat
en: The Rutherfordstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Ruyschstraat
en: The Ruyschstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost. It links the Ceintuurbaan with the 's-Gravesandeplein, which lies beside the Oosterpark. It begins at the Weesperzijde on the Amstel, where the Nieuwe Amstelbrug connects it with the Zuid borough.

name: Ruysdaelstraat
en: The Ruysdaelstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies via the Diamantbrug in line with the Albert Cuypstraat, runs from the Hobbemakade to the Hondecoeterstraat and crosses the Van Baerlestraat.

name: Sam van Houtenstraat
en: The Sam van Houtenstraat is a street in the Amsterdam district of Geuzenveld.

name: Sanderijnstraat
en: The Sanderijnstraat is a street in Bos en Lommer in Amsterdam-West. It received its name on 20 April 1939 and is named after the Abele spel Lanseloet van Denemarken, about the pair of lovers Lanseloet and Sanderijn (Sandrijn). The odd-numbered side of the Sanderijnstraat forms one unit with the even-numbered side of the Lanseloetstraat.

name: Sara Burgerhartstraat
en: The Sara Burgerhartstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West, in the Landlust district.

name: Sarphatikade
en: The Sarphatikade has been a street in Amsterdam-Centrum since 1878. At its start it lies on the northern bank of the Singelgracht, and further on on the western bank of the Amstel.

name: Sassenheimstraat
en: The Sassenheimstraat is a street in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid, in the Hoofddorppleinbuurt district, in the Aalsmeerwegbuurt Oost neighbourhood.

name: Saxenburgerdwarsstraat
en: The Saxenburgerdwarsstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Saxenburgerstraat
en: The Saxenburgerstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West, in the Vondelparkbuurt-West neighbourhood.

name: Schalk Burgerstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Schalk Burgerstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Transvaalbuurt, Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Scheldestraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Scheldestraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, named after the River Schelde, which flows through France and Flanders and empties into the Westerschelde estuary. The street received its name in 1922 and, in the Rivierenbuurt beyond the Barbiersbrug over the Amstelkanaal, forms the continuation of the Ferdinand Bolstraat.

name: Schellingwouderdijk
en: The Schellingwouderdijk is a dyke and street in the former village of Schellingwoude in Amsterdam-Noord. The village lies largely as ribbon development along the dyke. The dyke forms part of the Waterlandse Zeedijk. To the west this former sea dyke is called the Nieuwendammerdijk, and to the east the Durgerdammerdijk.

name: Schielandplein
en: The Schielandplein is a square in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Schoolstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Schoolstraat (Amsterdam) is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Sierplein
en: The Sierplein is a square in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Slatuinenweg
en: The Slatuinenweg is a street in Amsterdam-West, in the De Baarsjes district.

name: Slibveldenweg
en: The Slibveldenweg is a road in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, in the Tuinen van West neighbourhood.

name: Sloterweg (Amsterdam)
en: The Sloterweg (Amsterdam) is a just over 2.4 km long dyke road in Sloten (municipality of Amsterdam), between the Johan Huizingalaan and the Ringvaart of the Haarlemmermeerpolder.

name: Smaragdplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Smaragdplein (Amsterdam) is a square in the Diamantbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Solebaystraat
en: The Solebaystraat is a street in the Gibraltarbuurt, Landlust, Amsterdam-West. By council decision of 27 April 1933 it was named after the Battle of Solebay in June 1672. Streets in the surrounding area are named after sea battles.

name: Solitudolaan
en: The Solitudolaan is a street in the Weespertrekvaartbuurt, in the Omval & Overamstel district within the Watergraafsmeer district of Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Solitudopad
en: The Solitudopad is a street in the Weespertrekvaartbuurt, in the Omval & Overamstel district within the Watergraafsmeer district of Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Spaarndammerplantsoen
en: The Spaarndammerplantsoen in the Spaarndammerbuurt in Amsterdam-West was named in 1913 after the village of Spaarndam. On the Spaarndammerplantsoen stand three residential blocks with workers' housing, designed by Michel de Klerk in 1914-1920 in the style of the Amsterdam School.

name: Spijtellaantje
en: The Spijtellaantje is a relatively short street in the Hoofddorppleinbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Spinozastraat
en: The Spinozastraat is a street in central Amsterdam. It was named in 1872 after Benedictus de Spinoza (1632-1672). It lies behind the Sarphatistraat, near the Weesperplein, on the Singelgracht, opposite the Mauritskade.

name: Spooksteeg
en: The Spooksteeg is a short alley in the Oudezijde in central Amsterdam. It begins after the Vredenburgersteeg and Vredenburgerbrug and ends at the Zeedijk. In line with it lies the Waterpoortsteeg.

name: Spreeuwenpark
en: The Spreeuwenpark is a park in Amsterdam-Noord, in the Vogelbuurt-Zuid.

name: Staalmeesterslaan
en: The Staalmeesterslaan is an avenue in Amsterdam-West. The street was named on 14 October 1964 after Rembrandt van Rijn's painting De staalmeesters (The Syndics).

name: Staalstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Staalstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the city centre, linking the Kloveniersburgwal (at the Nieuwe Doelenstraat) with the Zwanenburgwal (at the Waterlooplein). The Staalstraat crosses the Groenburgwal, and the Verversstraat comes out onto it. The street is closed to car traffic and is a shopping street with cafés and cheap eateries.

name: Stadionkade
en: The Stadionkade is a street in the Zuid borough of Amsterdam. It leads towards the Olympic Stadium and takes its name from it.

name: Staringplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Staringplein (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-West, in the Overtoomse Sluis district.

name: Sterrenplein
en: The Sterrenplein is one of the many small squares in Tuindorp Oostzaan. It received its name on 26 October 1921, named after a star, in a district where all streets and squares are named after celestial bodies. It is one of four squares arranged symmetrically around the Zonneplein.

name: Stettineiland
en: Stettineiland is a rectangular artificial island and a street in Amsterdam-West. The name refers to the Baltic port of Stettin, now the Polish Szczecin, which was important for the timber trade with Amsterdam. The island lies where part of the Houthavens stood until the early 21st century.

name: Steve Bikoplein
en: The Steve Bikoplein (until 1978: Pretoriusplein) is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Strawinskylaan
en: The Strawinskylaan is an elevated street in the Zuid borough of Amsterdam. By council decision of 13 September 1972 the avenue was named after the Russian composer Igor Stravinsky (1882-1971). The associated Strawinskypad footpath and cycle path lies at ground level to the north of the avenue.

name: Stromarkt
en: The Stromarkt is a square-like street in Amsterdam-Centrum. The square lies on the east side of the Singelgracht, where the Brouwersgracht on the opposite side meets the Singelgracht. On its east side the square continues via the Smaksteeg into the Kattengat. Several national monuments stand on the square.

name: Stuyvesantstraat
en: The Stuyvesantstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West, in the De Baarsjes district, Westindische Buurt neighbourhood.

name: Suikerplein
en: The Suikerplein is a square in Amsterdam-West, in the Spaarndammerbuurt.

name: Sumatrakade
en: The Sumatrakade is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Surinamekade
en: The Surinamekade is a street, quay and promenade on KNSM Island in Amsterdam-Oost. The quay along the IJ was for many years a harbour quay for sea-going ships of the Koninklijke Nederlandse Stoomboot-Maatschappij (KNSM). Since around 1990 KNSM Island has been a residential area, and the Surinamekade partly serves as a walking area.

name: Surinamestraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Surinamestraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-West. It forms part of Stadsroute 106. It lies on the south side of a neighbourhood in which all street names refer to Suriname and the Netherlands Antilles. The street begins at the Overtoomse Sluis bridge over the Kostverlorenvaart and ends at the Surinameplein.

name: Suze Groenewegplantsoen
en: The Suze Groenewegplantsoen is a street and park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The street received its name by council decision of the Slotermeer/Geuzenveld borough on 2 November 1993, named after Suze Groeneweg. The park and buildings were laid out as part of urban densification.

name: Ten Katestraat
en: The Ten Katestraat is a street in the Kinkerbuurt in Amsterdam-West. It runs north to south, at right angles to the Kinkerstraat. It begins at the Jan Hanzenstraat and then crosses the Wenslauerstraat, Bellamystraat, Hasebroekstraat, Kinkerstraat, Borgerstraat and Jacob van Lennepstraat.

name: Teniersstraat
en: The Teniersstraat is a small street in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Museumkwartier and the Johannes Vermeerbuurt.

name: Ter Haarstraat
en: The Ter Haarstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West. This through-traffic street lies between the Bilderdijkstraat and the Bilderdijkgracht/Bilderdijkkade. It is named after Bernard ter Haar, writer and professor. The street received its name at the council meeting of 11 September 1895, although building still had to take place.

name: Termietergouw
en: Termietergouw and Termieterweg are roads in Landelijk Noord, Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Texelplein
en: The Texelplein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord. The square and the Texelstraat both lie in Tuindorp Buiksloot, in the small district of Blauwe Zand. The name refers to the blue colour of the sand that was pumped in at the time. The name also survives in the Blauwezandbrug.

name: Th. K. van Lohuizenlaan
en: The Th. K. van Lohuizenlaan is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Thérèse Schwartzeplein
en: The Thérèse Schwartzeplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Timorplein
en: The Timorplein is a triangular square in the Indische Buurt in Amsterdam-Oost. It lies on the northern side of the Borneostraat. The Borneostraat runs alongside the square and is the main local through road.

name: Tjalkstraat
en: The Tjalkstraat in Amsterdam is a street in the Banne Buiksloot district of Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Tongelaer
en: Tongelaer is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Tonia Stieltjesplein
en: The Tonia Stieltjesplein is a relatively young square in a relatively old setting in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Torenven
en: Torenven is a street in Amsterdam-Noord. The name Torenven refers to a small lake near the tower, in this case the church tower of the Church of Zunderdorp.

name: Touwbaanpark
en: The Touwbaanpark is a relatively new small city park, 60 by 26 metres, in Amsterdam-Centrum, Oostelijke Eilanden, Oostenburg. The park was laid out around 2015 on a former untidy car park, which had itself been built on the site of the demolished factory buildings of Wiener & Co.

name: Transvaalplein
en: The Transvaalplein in Amsterdam is a square in the Transvaalbuurt in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Troelstralaan (Amsterdam)
en: The Troelstralaan (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Trompenburgstraat
en: The Trompenburgstraat is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Tuinstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Tuinstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Jordaan district of Amsterdam, between the Lijnbaansgracht and the Prinsengracht. It is about 500 metres long and crosses, among others, the first and second Tuindwarsstraat. The Nieuwe Tuinstraat continues the line of the Tuinstraat beyond the Lijnbaansgracht and runs as far as the Singelgracht.

name: Tussen de Bogen
en: Tussen de Bogen is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies between the two railway viaducts of the line between Centraal station and Sloterdijk station. It runs between the Grote Bickersstraat and the Haarlemmerplein, parallel to the Haarlemmer Houttuinen and the Eilandsgracht.

name: Tussen Meer
en: Tussen Meer (sometimes written as one word, Tussenmeer) is the central main street of the Osdorp district in the Amsterdam Nieuw-West borough. It runs from the Osdorpplein to the Dijkgraafplein. The street crosses the Hoekenes, the Wolbrantskerkweg, the Baden Powellweg and the Osdorperweg.

name: Tweede Ceramstraat
en: The Tweede Ceramstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Tweede Coehoornstraat
en: The Tweede Coehoornstraat is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is named after Menno van Coehoorn. Given its name in 1919, it lies between the Blankenstraat and the Kraijenhoffstraat in the Czaar Peterbuurt. It is barely twenty metres long.

name: Tweede Constantijn Huygensstraat
en: The Tweede Constantijn Huygensstraat is a street in Amsterdam Oud-West. It received its name in three phases (1894, 1898, 1985). An earlier name for the street was the Tweede Bilderdijkstraat; the Eerste Bilderdijkstraat became the Eerste Constantijn Huygensstraat.

name: Tweede Hugo de Grootstraat
en: The Tweede Hugo de Grootstraat is a street in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt in Amsterdam-West. By council decision of 30 March 1881 it received its name, together with the Eerste and Derde Hugo de Grootstraat, the Hugo de Grootplein and the Hugo de Grootkade/Hugo de Grootgracht.

name: Tweede Jacob van Campenstraat
en: The Tweede Jacob van Campenstraat is a street in De Pijp, Amsterdam-Zuid. It runs from west to east, beginning at the Eerste van der Helststraat. It is named after the architect Jacob van Campen.

name: Tweede Jan van der Heijdenstraat
en: The Tweede Jan van der Heijdenstraat is a street in De Pijp, Amsterdam-Zuid. It came into being when the original Jan van der Heijdenstraat was split in two by the construction of the Sarphatipark. West of the park it was designated the Eerste Jan van der Heijdenstraat, and east of it the Tweede.

name: Tweede Laurierdwarsstraat
en: The Tweede Laurierdwarsstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Tweede Leeghwaterstraat
en: The Tweede Leeghwaterstraat is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It runs parallel to the Eerste Leeghwaterstraat, a little further south. Named after Jan Adriaanszoon Leeghwater, it lies between the Conradstraat and the Funenpark and crosses the Czaar Peterstraat and the Blankenstraat.

name: Tweede Rozendwarsstraat
en: The Tweede Rozendwarsstraat is a street in the Jordaan in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the area between the Rozengracht and the Rozenstraat and was laid out in the first half of the 17th century as part of the Derde Uitleg of Amsterdam.

name: Tweede van Swindenstraat
en: The Tweede van Swindenstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Dapperbuurt.

name: Tweede Weteringplantsoen
en: The Tweede Weteringplantsoen is a small park and street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Valeriusplein
en: The Valeriusplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid, between the Koninginneweg and the Lyceumbrug. It is named after the Dutch songwriter (and notary) Adriaen Valerius.

name: Van Alphenstraat
en: The Van Alphenstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Van Boshuizenstraat
en: The Van Boshuizenstraat in Amsterdam-Buitenveldert received its name by council decision of 15 January 1958. It is named after Koenraad van Boshuizen, bailiff of Amstelland and Waterland (1515-1530).

name: Van de Veldestraat
en: The Van de Veldestraat is a relatively short street in the Museumkwartier of Amsterdam-Zuid. On 10 June 1880 it was named by council decision after the brothers and painters Adriaen van de Velde (known for landscapes) and Willem van de Velde the Younger (seascapes). The entire street is a pedestrian area.

name: Van der Boechorststraat
en: The Van der Boechorststraat is a street in Amsterdam Buitenveldert. It runs from De Boelelaan, in line with the western branch of the Gustav Mahlerlaan (called the Karel Lotsylaan until 1997), parallel to the Buitenveldertselaan north-south. Besides smaller streets, the A.J. Ernststraat also comes out onto it.

name: Van der Helstplein
en: The Van der Helstplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Van der Hoopstraat
en: The Van der Hoopstraat is a street in the Staatsliedenbuurt in Amsterdam-West. It runs from the Van Hogendorpplein, via the Van Limburg Stirumplein, to the Van Hallstraat. The street was named in 1888 after Joan Cornelis van der Hoop (1742-1825). Other streets nearby are also named after statesmen.

name: Van der Pekplein
en: The Van der Pekplein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord, in the Volewijck district.

name: Van der Vijverstraat
en: The Van der Vijverstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Van Gentstraat
en: The Van Gentstraat is a street in the Landlust neighbourhood, in the Bos en Lommer district of Amsterdam-West.

name: Van Hallstraat
en: The Van Hallstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West. It was named in 1903 after Floris Adriaan van Hall (1791-1866), an Amsterdam lawyer and Minister of Finance. The street lies in the Staatsliedenbuurt, and the streets around it are named after statesmen.

name: Van Heenvlietlaan
en: The Van Heenvlietlaan is a street in the Buitenveldert district of Amsterdam-Zuid. It was named in 1959 after Jan van Heenvliet, bailiff of Amstelland and Waterland (1396/1397). It lies in line with the Drentestraat and begins at the De Boelelaan.

name: Van Hogendorpplein
en: The Van Hogendorpplein is a square in Amsterdam-West, in Westerpark.

name: Van Leijenberghlaan
en: The Van Leijenberghlaan is a street in the Buitenveldert district of Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Van Limburg Stirumstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Van Limburg Stirumstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-West. It received its name in 1886 and is named after Leopold van Limburg Stirum (1758-1840), captain in the Staatse leger.

name: Van Noordtkade
en: The Van Noordtkade is a street in Amsterdam-West, in the Zeeheldenbuurt.

name: Van Noordtstraat
en: The Van Noordtstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West, in the Spaarndammerbuurt and Zeeheldenbuurt.

name: Van Oldenbarneveldtplein
en: The Van Oldenbarneveldtplein is a square in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Van Reigersbergenstraat
en: The Van Reigersbergenstraat is a street in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt in Amsterdam-West. By council decision of 20 January 1886 it was named after Maria van Reigersberch, wife of Hugo de Groot. The street lies in an area that between the 17th century and the early 20th century was known as the 'Zaagmolenbuurt'.

name: Van Speijkstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Van Speijkstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-West. It begins at the southern end on the Baarsjesweg, with a slight bend. West of this bend lies the former Riva site, now the Piri Reisplein, the building site of the Westermoskee. In the middle the street is crossed by the Van Kinsbergenstraat.

name: Veelaan
en: The Veelaan is a street in the former Oostelijk Havengebied of Amsterdam. Since the area was redeveloped, the avenue has become an important traffic artery linking the old Indische Buurt with the peninsulas of the Oostelijk Havengebied. It owes its name to the cattle market and municipal slaughterhouses that once stood here.

name: Veluwelaan
en: The Veluwelaan is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Rivierenbuurt, Veluwebuurt, better known as the Landstrekenbuurt.

name: Veronesestraat
en: The Veronesestraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, Oud-Zuid, in the Apollobuurt.

name: Verversstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Verversstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in central Amsterdam. The narrow street, barely more than an alley, runs between the Groenburgwal and Zwanenburgwal canals, north-east from the Staalstraat to the Raamgracht. A distinctive feature of the Verversstraat is the skybridge that joins the facades on its northern side.

name: Vierwindendwarsstraat
en: The Vierwindendwarsstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Centrum, Haarlemmerbuurt, Westelijke Eilanden.

name: Vlaardingenlaan
en: The Vlaardingenlaan is a major through street in the Westlandgracht sub-district of Overtoomse Veld in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Voetboogstraat
en: The Voetboogstraat is a narrow street in Amsterdam-Centrum, between the Spui and the Heiligeweg. It runs parallel to the Handboogstraat and the Kalverstraat. It is sometimes also wrongly called the Voetboogsteeg, although that is historically incorrect.

name: Voltaplein
en: The Voltaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Voltastraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Voltastraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, in Watergraafsmeer, in the Middenmeer district. Like the nearby Voltaplein, it received its name on 23 December 1927, after the scientist Alessandro Volta, namesake of the unit of electric potential, the volt. The street begins at the Voltaplein and runs to the Archimedesplantsoen.

name: Vondelstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Vondelstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Dutch city of Amsterdam, in the Amsterdam-West borough, between the Stadhouderskade and the Anna van den Vondelstraat. It formally received this name on 25 September 1867, at the instigation of the architect Pierre Cuypers, after the poet Joost van den Vondel (1587-1679).

name: Voorlandpad
en: The Voorlandpad is a path in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Voorsteven (Amsterdam)
en: Voorsteven (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Noord. It was built around 1976 in a new residential area near Banne Buiksloot, in the north-west section. Because of the way it was built, it has also become a small neighbourhood in its own right.

name: Vosmaerstraat
en: The Vosmaerstraat in Amsterdam-West is a relatively short street of about fifty metres in the Cremerbuurt. Its history runs parallel to that of the J.J. Cremerplein, of which it is one of the side streets. Until 1896 the land in the Stads- en Godshuispolder was agricultural, within the municipality of Nieuwer-Amstel.

name: Vreedenhaven
en: Vreedenhaven is a street with a small park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, in the Wildemanbuurt in the Osdorp district. The street and park received their names on 15 July 1958, after a vanished country estate in the municipality of Sloten that was swallowed up by Amsterdam in 1921.

name: Vuurwerkerplantsoen
en: De Vuurwerkerweg is a street in Amsterdam-Noord that in the 2020s is being partly converted into a street with a park: the Vuurwerkerplantsoen. The street received its name on 27 June 1962, after the trade of vuurwerker, common in the shipbuilding that was prevalent here, a job standing for blacksmith or welder.

name: Waaigat (Amsterdam)
en: The Waaigat (Amsterdam) is a dead-end street in the Amsterdam-Centrum borough, on Wittenburg, one of the three Oostelijke Eilanden reclaimed in the IJ in the second half of the 17th century. The street lies on the Wittenburgervaart. The name Waaigat is an old name for an opening in a canal wall.

name: Waalstraat
en: The Waalstraat is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in the Zuid borough of Amsterdam. It is named after the Dutch river of the same name.

name: Waddenweg
en: The Waddenweg is a street in Amsterdam-Noord. For through traffic it begins as a continuation of the Meeuwenlaan, where that road makes a sharp right-hand bend at the Nieuwendammerdijk and Leeuwarderweg.

name: Waterlandplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Waterlandplein (Amsterdam) is the central square and neighbourhood shopping centre of the Waterlandpleinbuurt in Amsterdam-Noord. The square lies north of the Werengouw, south of the IJdoornlaan, west of the Volendammerweg and east of the Beverwijkstraat.

name: Weesperzijde (straat)
en: Weesperzijde (straat) is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Westeinde (Amsterdam)
en: The Westeinde (Amsterdam) is a short street, but an important link in central Amsterdam.

name: Westerkade (Amsterdam)
en: The Westerkade (Amsterdam) is the western quay of the Lijnbaansgracht in the Jordaan in Amsterdam-Centrum. For many years that Lijnbaansgracht formed the outer edge of Amsterdam, apart from the ramparts.

name: Westhavenweg
en: The Westhavenweg in Amsterdam-Westpoort was named in 1943 after the Westhaven. That harbour, about half of which was dug in 1937, was initially called the Fordhaven, but soon came to be unofficially known as the Westhaven.

name: Westzaanstraat
en: The Westzaanstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West, in the Spaarndammerbuurt.

name: Kerkstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Kerkstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the centre of Amsterdam. It runs eastwards from the Leidsegracht to the Magere Brug over the Amstel. The Kerkstraat runs parallel between the Keizersgracht and the Prinsengracht and crosses the Leidsestraat, the Nieuwe Spiegelstraat, the Vijzelstraat, the Reguliersgracht and the Utrechtsestraat.

name: Merwedeplein
en: The Merwedeplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Vijzelstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Vijzelstraat (Amsterdam) lies within the Amsterdam canal belt between the Muntplein and the Prinsengracht. The street crosses the Reguliersdwarsstraat, the Herengracht, the Keizersgracht and the Kerkstraat.

name: A.S. Onderwijzerhof
en: The A.S. Onderwijzerhof in Amsterdam is a small square and almshouse courtyard in the Amsterdam borough of Centrum.

name: Alexanderplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Alexanderplein (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies at the eastern end of the Plantage Middenlaan, at the junction with the Sarphatistraat.

name: Amstelstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Amstelstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum between the Rembrandtplein and the Blauwbrug over the river Amstel, near the Stopera on the Waterlooplein. The street is named after the river.

name: Amstelveld
en: The Amstelveld is a square in the centre of Amsterdam, between the Reguliersgracht, Prinsengracht and Kerkstraat, close to the Utrechtsestraat. On the square stands the Amstelkerk of 1668-1670, a largely wooden building.

name: Beursplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Beursplein (Amsterdam) is a square in the centre of Amsterdam, between the Damrak and the Beursstraat. On the square are the Effectenbeurs (Beursplein 5), the Beurs van Berlage and the Bijenkorf.

name: Ceintuurbaan (Amsterdam)
en: The Ceintuurbaan (Amsterdam) is a street in the De Pijp district of Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Churchill-laan (Amsterdam)
en: The Churchill-laan (Amsterdam) is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. Until May 1946 it was called the Noorder Amstellaan. On 10 May 1940 the avenue was the scene of the arrival of the occupiers. On 7 May 1945 the Allies used the avenue to liberate Amsterdam.

name: Damstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Damstraat is a side street off the Dam in Amsterdam. It runs roughly eastwards from the Dam to the Oudezijds Voorburgwal.

name: Gerard Douplein
en: The Gerard Douplein is a square in De Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid, named after the painter Gerard Dou. The square lies a short distance from the Albert Cuypmarkt. It is the junction of the Gerard Doustraat (east-west) and the Eerste van der Helststraat (north-south).

name: Haarlemmerdijk
en: The Haarlemmerdijk is an Amsterdam shopping street forming the continuation of the Haarlemmerstraat, running parallel between the Haarlemmer Houttuinen and the Brouwersgracht, between the Korte Prinsengracht and the Singelgracht. The dyke is a flood barrier built during the urban expansion of 1612.

name: Haarlemmerplein
en: The Haarlemmerplein links the Amsterdam Korte Marnixstraat with the Planciusstraat and borders the Haarlemmerdijk and the Singelgracht in Amsterdam-Centrum. The square dates from the construction period of the Grachtengordel.

name: Haarlemmerstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Haarlemmerstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the centre of Amsterdam. It runs west from the Singel to the Korte Prinsengracht, as a continuation of the Nieuwendijk. It is called the Haarlemmerdijk as far as the Haarlemmerplein, after which it continues as the Haarlemmerweg.

name: Jozef Israëlskade
en: The Jozef Israëlskade is a street in the Amsterdam borough of Zuid. The quay is named after the painter Jozef Israëls (1824-1911). It lies on the south side of De Pijp, a district forming the eastern part of the former borough of Oud-Zuid, known as the Nieuwe Pijp.

name: Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen
en: The Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen is a square and small park in the centre of Amsterdam. It lies in line with the Leidseplein and is often regarded as part of that square. On its south-eastern side the Weteringschans emerges onto the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen.

name: Leidsekade (Amsterdam)
en: The Leidsekade (Amsterdam) is a street in the centre of Amsterdam. Like the nearby Leidseplein, it is named after the Leidsepoort, where the road to Leiden began. The quay curves along the north-eastern bank of the Singelgracht, opposite the Nassaukade and Stadhouderskade.

name: Leidsestraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Leidsestraat (Amsterdam), a busy shopping street, lies between the Koningssluis (Brug 29, spanning the Herengracht at the Koningsplein) and the Leidseplein, and crosses the Keizersgracht (with Brug 43) and the Prinsengracht (the canal belt).

name: Marnixplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Marnixplein (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-Centrum. The term plein here refers only to open space. It has the shape of a double T-junction. Like the quay and street, the square is named after Filips van Marnix van Sint-Aldegonde (1540-1598), writer, politician and confidant of William of Orange.

name: Max Euweplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Max Euweplein (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-Centrum, named after the chess grandmaster and mathematics teacher Max Euwe. On its south-western side a bridge, the Hein Donnerbrug, crosses the Singelgracht to the Stadhouderskade and the entrance to the Vondelpark.

name: Nieuwezijds Kolk
en: The Nieuwezijds Kolk (often simply called 'De Kolk') is a small square in the centre of Amsterdam. It borders the Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal and is linked to the Nieuwendijk by the Kolksteeg. In the middle of the square stands the Korenmetershuisje, built in 1620 for the guild of corn measurers.

name: Oostelijke Handelskade
en: The Oostelijke Handelskade in Amsterdam lies in the Eastern Docklands and was built between 1875 and 1883. The quay lies on the IJhaven and received its present name in 1883. Previously it was known as the Handelskade.

name: Plantage Middenlaan
en: The Plantage Middenlaan is the main street of the Plantage district of Amsterdam-Centrum. The street dates from the great urban expansion of 1658. Notable buildings on the Plantage Middenlaan include the Hollandsche Schouwburg, Desmet and the Muiderpoort.

name: Reguliersbreestraat
en: The Reguliersbreestraat is a street in Amsterdam between the Muntplein and the Rembrandtplein. It is named after the Reguliersklooster (1394-1532), a monastery that stood at the level of the later Keizersgracht, outside the city gate Regulierspoort.

name: Reguliersdwarsstraat
en: The Reguliersdwarsstraat runs from the Koningsplein to the Rembrandtplein in the city centre of the Dutch capital Amsterdam. Since the early 1980s it has been a well-known nightlife street with many restaurants, cafés and a few clubs. It is best known for its gay hospitality venues.

name: Rooseveltlaan (Amsterdam)
en: The Rooseveltlaan (Amsterdam) is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. The avenue is lined with poplars on either side of the carriageway. Unlike the original Amstellaan (now Vrijheidslaan) and the Noorder Amstellaan (now Churchilllaan), it has no broad central strip of greenery. It was called the Zuider Amstellaan from 1922 to 1946.

name: Ruysdaelkade
en: The Ruysdaelkade is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It runs largely along the Boerenwetering, which forms the western boundary of De Pijp; on its other side lies the Hobbemakade. The quay was named in 1872 after the 17th-century family of painters and engravers Ruysdael.

name: Sint Olofspoort
en: The Sint Olofspoort was a former city gate in Amsterdam. The gate has disappeared, but the alley linking the Warmoesstraat and the Zeedijk is still called Sint Olofspoort. Until 7 July 1914 the alley was called the Oudezijds Wijde Kapelsteeg; it is now spelled 'Sint-Olofspoort'.

name: Surinameplein
en: The Surinameplein in Amsterdam-West links the Hoofdweg with the Cornelis Lelylaan and Haarlemmermeerstraat, and is connected via the Surinamestraat to the Overtoom and Amstelveenseweg.

name: Thorbeckeplein
en: The Thorbeckeplein lies in the centre of Amsterdam, at right angles to the Rembrandtplein and in line with the Reguliersgracht. It came into being when the part of the Reguliersgracht between the Herengracht and the Reguliersdwarsstraat was filled in, in 1785.

name: Utrechtsestraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Utrechtsestraat (Amsterdam) is a shopping street in Amsterdam. It is named after the city of Utrecht and dates from the great urban expansion of 1658. It received this name because it ran from the Reguliersbreestraat to the Utrechtsepoort.

name: Van Baerlestraat
en: The Van Baerlestraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It received its name by council decision of 29 September 1875; it is named after the preacher, orator, writer and professor Caspar van Baerle, better known by his Latin name Barlaeus.

name: Van Woustraat
en: The Van Woustraat is a street in the Amsterdam district of De Pijp. It was named in 1880 after the bell-founder Geert van Wou. The street lies in line with the Westeinde and the Frederiksplein, and runs south, roughly parallel to the Amstel, to the Jozef Israëlskade and the bridge over the Amstelkanaal.

name: Victorieplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Victorieplein (Amsterdam), named the Daniël Willinkplein from 1922 to 1946, is a square in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Voormalige Stadstimmertuin
en: The Voormalige Stadstimmertuin is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum and now a protected townscape. It lies north of the Sarphatistraat, south of the Korte Amstelstraat and Nieuwe Achtergracht, west of the Weesperplein and east of the Amstel.

name: Walenpleintje
en: The Walenpleintje is a small square on the Oudezijds Achterburgwal in Amsterdam, named after the Walloon Church that stands on it. The square has long been called the Walenpleintje colloquially, and in 1978 the municipality made this its official name to mark the 400th anniversary of the Alteratie of Amsterdam.

name: Westermarkt (Amsterdam)
en: The Westermarkt (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-Centrum between the Keizersgracht (at no. 198) and the Prinsengracht (at no. 281). On the square stands the Westerkerk. The square took the popular name Westermarkt after the church was completed in 1631.

name: 's-Gravelandseveer
en: The 's-Gravelandseveer is a street in the centre of Amsterdam. It lies on the north side of the Amstel and forms the southern part of the peninsula between the Groenburgwal and the Kloveniersburgwal. Seen from the east, the Groenburgwal becomes the street.

name: 's-Gravenhekje
en: The 's-Gravenhekje is a quay in the centre of Amsterdam. The small street lies at the northern end of the Oudeschans, directly opposite the Kalkmarkt on the same canal. The name was already in use at the end of the eighteenth century and refers to a former timber store.

name: 's-Gravesandeplein
en: The 's-Gravesandeplein in Amsterdam-Oost received its name in 1897 and is named after Willem Jacob 's Gravesande, professor of mathematics and astronomy at Leiden.

name: 's-Gravesandestraat
en: The 's-Gravesandestraat in Amsterdam-Oost was named in 1889 after Willem Jacob 's Gravesande (1688-1742), professor of mathematics and astronomy at Leiden. The street links the Mauritskade with the 's-Gravesandeplein.

name: Aalbersestraat
en: The Aalbersestraat is an important through street in the Amsterdam district of Geuzenveld. It forms part of the Geuzenveld ring road. The northern section was opened to traffic in 1956 and the southern section in 1958; the street runs from south to north through the district.

name: Aalsmeerplein
en: The Aalsmeerplein is a square in the Hoofddorppleinbuurt neighbourhood of Amsterdam-Zuid. It was named by council decision of 19 July 1933, after the Aalsmeerweg, the street running from the city to the square, which is itself named after Aalsmeer.

name: Aaron Coplandstraat
en: The Aaron Coplandstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It was named by council decision on 17 December 2002 after the composer Aaron Copland. All the streets in the neighbourhood are named after composers.

name: Abcouderpad
en: The Abcouderpad is a footpath and cycle path several kilometres long in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Abcouderstraatweg
en: The Abcouderstraatweg is a street in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Adam Smithplein
en: The Adam Smithplein, Amsterdam, is a square in the Riekerpolder district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Adama van Scheltemaplein
en: The Adama van Scheltemaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Adèle Opzoomerstraat
en: The Adèle Opzoomerstraat is a street in Slotermeer, Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Admiraal De Ruijterweg
en: The Admiraal De Ruijterweg is a street in Amsterdam-West, named after the admiral Michiel Adriaenszoon de Ruyter (1607-1676). It lies in line with the De Clercqstraat and begins at the Wiegbrug over the Kostverlorenvaart, ending at the Haarlemmerweg.

name: Aert van Nesstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Aert van Nesstraat (Amsterdam) is a residential street in the Spaarndammerbuurt of Amsterdam. It links the Tasmanstraat and the Nova Zemblastraat and until 2014 lay more or less in line with the Stavangerweg towards or from the Houthaven.

name: Agatha Dekenstraat
en: The Agatha Dekenstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Akkerstraat
en: The Akkerstraat is a street in Betondorp, Amsterdam-Oost. Other cities such as Groningen and Eindhoven also have an Akkerstraat.

name: Akoleienstraat
en: The Akoleienstraat is a street in the Amsterdam district of the Jordaan. Its name is a slightly altered form of the flower akelei (columbine).

name: Alan Turingplein
en: The Alan Turingplein is a square in Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam-Oost. As part of urban densification, a derelict site was laid out as a small urban square behind Ringdijk 44 (the house number covers several buildings) in the Frankendael neighbourhood.

name: Albert Camuslaan
en: The Albert Camuslaan is a street in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Albert Cuypstraat
en: The Albert Cuypstraat is a street in the Amsterdam district of De Pijp. It was named in 1883 after the 17th-century painter Albert Cuyp. The street runs from the Ruysdaelkade in the west to the Van Woustraat in the east, and crosses the Ferdinand Bolstraat.

name: Albert Luthulistraat
en: The Albert Luthulistraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Transvaalbuurt.

name: Albert Wittenbergplein
en: The Albert Wittenbergplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Albrecht Dürerstraat
en: The Albrecht Dürerstraat is a street in Amsterdam.

name: Aldebaranplein
en: The Aldebaranplein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Aletta Jacobslaan
en: The Aletta Jacobslaan is an important through street in Slotervaart in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in line with the Vlaardingenlaan and was opened to traffic around 1966, which required a cutting through the Ringspoorbaan railway. The street runs on to the point where it crosses the Johan Huizingalaan.

name: Amaliastraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Amaliastraat (Amsterdam) is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-West, in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt Noord.

name: Ambonplein
en: The Ambonplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Ampèrestraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Ampèrestraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer, in the Tuindorp Middenmeer district. It was named on 23 December 1927, when the council named streets, squares and parks in this area after scientists, in this case after André-Marie Ampère, namesake of the ampere unit of current.

name: Amstelkade
en: The Amstelkade, together with the Jozef Israëlskade, is a quay on the Amstelkanaal in Amsterdam.

name: Amstelplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Amstelplein (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Amstelvlietstraat
en: The Amstelvlietstraat is a street in the Amstelkwartier Noord neighbourhood of the Omval/Overamstel district, Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Anderlechtlaan
en: The Anderlechtlaan is an avenue in Nieuw-Sloten, Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Andreas Bonnstraat
en: The Andreas Bonnstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost. A notable building is the former Andreas Bonnstraat bathhouse, near the Boerhaaveplein, halfway along the street. The Badhuistheater is housed in this bathhouse.

name: Anna van den Vondelstraat
en: The Anna van den Vondelstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West. As far as is known, no other street in the Netherlands has that name.

name: Annie M.G. Schmidtstraat
en: The Annie M.G. Schmidtstraat is a street on the Oosterdokseiland in Amsterdam-Centrum. The Oosterdokseiland was redeveloped in the first decade of the 21st century. Older buildings and the street plan disappeared under sand and for years became a building pit.

name: Annie Romeinplein
en: The Annie Romeinplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It was named on 13 May 1997; by decision of the Stadsdeel Zuidoost council it was named after the writer Annie Romein-Verschoor. It is wedged between the Geldershoofd and Gravestein flats to the north and the Bijlmerdreef to the south.

name: Anthonie van Dijckstraat
en: The Anthonie van Dijckstraat is a street in Amsterdam.

name: Antillenstraat
en: The Antillenstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West, in the part known as Amsterdam Oud-West (Westindische Buurt).

name: Anton de Komplein
en: The Anton de Komplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Anton Waldorpstraat
en: The Anton Waldorpstraat is a street in the Overtoomse Veld district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Antwerpenbaan
en: The Antwerpenbaan is a street in Nieuw Sloten in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in line with the Louwesweg and ends at the eastern leg of the Laan van Vlaanderen, where it becomes the Ardennenlaan. From 1960 to 1988 the Louwesweg ran across the Sloten horticultural area to the Plesmanlaan.

name: Apollolaan (Amsterdam)
en: The Apollolaan (Amsterdam) is a street in the Amsterdam borough of Zuid. It is named after the Greek god Apollo.

name: Arent Janszoon Ernststraat
en: The Arent Janszoon Ernststraat (colloquially the A J Ernst) is a street in the Buitenveldert district of the Dutch city of Amsterdam.

name: Arlandaweg
en: The Arlandaweg is a road in Amsterdam-Westpoort, in the Sloterdijk business park, in the Teleport district. The road was named on 7 September 1989 after Stockholm-Arlanda Airport. Several streets in Teleport were named after airports. The road connects in the east with Molenwerf and the Velserweg.

name: Asterweg
en: The Asterweg is a road in the Buiksloterham neighbourhood, Amsterdam-Noord.

name: August Allebéplein
en: The August Allebéplein in Amsterdam-Overtoomse Veld was named on 17 February 1960 after August Allebé (1846-1927), painter, draughtsman and director of the Academie voor Beeldende Kunst. It forms the centre of the Overtoomse Veld district, whose construction began in 1958.

name: Australiëhavenweg
en: The Australiëhavenweg is a road in the Amsterdam business area of Westpoort. It connects the Hornweg at the Australiëhaven, an inlet dock of the Amerikahaven, with the Noordzeeweg. Railway tracks run alongside the road for freight transport.

name: Avercampstraat
en: The Avercampstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Azartplein
en: The Azartplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost. Since 1930 it has formed the hinge between the Java Island and the KNSM Island on the IJ, in the former Eastern Docklands. They were joined to the mainland from the south by the Verbindingsdam.

name: Baarsjesweg
en: The Baarsjesweg is a street in Amsterdam-West. This road marks the eastern boundary of De Baarsjes. It runs alongside the Kostverlorenvaart for more than a kilometre.

name: Bachplein
en: The Bachplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Bakkersstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Bakkersstraat (Amsterdam) is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Centrum. The name already appeared in 1604 and refers to a 'backhuis' (bakehouse) that stood here from 1595 to 1603.

name: Balboaplein
en: The Balboaplein is a city square in De Baarsjes, Amsterdam-West.

name: Balboastraat
en: The Balboastraat is a street in De Baarsjes, Amsterdam-West.

name: Banneplein
en: The Banneplein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Banstraat
en: The Banstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Barentszstraat
en: The Barentszstraat is a street in the Zeeheldenbuurt in Amsterdam-West. It begins at the Zoutkeetsplein and ends at the Barentszplein. Before the house blocks were built, a ropewalk, the Groote Zeevaart, stood along its whole length in the 18th century and earlier.

name: Bart de Ligtstraat
en: The Bart de Ligtstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Beemsterstraat
en: The Beemsterstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Noord. It received its name by council decision on 4 November 1925; the extension of the street in the 1960s was also designated Beemsterstraat on 30 October 1963. It is named after the Beemster polder.

name: Bellamydwarsstraat
en: The Bellamydwarsstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-West. It lies between the Bellamystraat and the Jan Hanzenstraat and is about 95 metres long.

name: Bellamyplein
en: The Bellamyplein is a triangular square in the Bellamybuurt neighbourhood of Amsterdam-West, between the Bilderdijkkade and the Ten Katestraat. Streets that open onto the square are the Kwakersstraat, Elisabeth Wolffstraat, Agatha Dekenstraat, Jan Hanzenstraat and Bellamystraat.

name: Ben Viljoenstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Ben Viljoenstraat (Amsterdam) and the Ben Viljoenspoorbrug (railway bridge) lie in the Transvaalbuurt, Amsterdam-Oost. The neighbourhood lies in the former Overamstelpolder, which until 1896 belonged to the municipality of Nieuwer-Amstel. After annexation the area was designated for housing; in the early 1920s the Afrikanerbuurt appeared here.

name: Benjamin Brittenstraat
en: The Benjamin Brittenstraat is a street in Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Benkoelenstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Benkoelenstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, lying between the Javaplein and the Balistraat. It received its name on 2 September 1913, after the city of Bengkulu, called Benkoelen in the Dutch East Indies period, on Sumatra. It lies in the Indische Buurt, where all streets and squares refer to the Dutch East Indies.

name: Berkelstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Berkelstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. The name Berkelstraat also occurs in several other municipalities in the Netherlands.

name: Bernard Shawsingel
en: The Bernard Shawsingel is a waterway and street in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Bertelmanplein
en: The Bertelmanplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Bestevâerstraat
en: The Bestevâerstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West. It runs parallel to the Admiraal de Ruijterweg and, like it, has a curved course because it follows the old ditch pattern. It begins at the Maarten Harpertszoon Trompstraat.

name: Beulingstraat
en: The Beulingstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies within the canal belt (Grachtengordel).

name: Beursstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Beursstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the centre of Amsterdam. It lies between the Damrak and the Warmoesstraat and runs from De Bijenkorf on the Beursplein north-eastwards to the Oudebrugsteeg. It passes the rear façade of the Beurs van Berlage, on the east side of the building.

name: Bezaanjachtplein
en: The Bezaanjachtplein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Bijlmerplein
en: The Bijlmerplein is the central square of the Amsterdam district of Bijlmermeer and of the whole of Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is named after the Bijlmermeer.

name: Bilderdijkstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Bilderdijkstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-West, between the Hugo de Grootgracht and the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. It links the Frederik Hendrikstraat and, via the Pesthuysbrug, the Eerste Constantijn Huygensstraat. The De Clerqstraat and Kinkerstraat cross it.

name: Blankenstraat
en: The Blankenstraat is a street in the Czaar Peterbuurt in Amsterdam. It runs parallel to the Czaar Peterstraat and was once part of the VOC ropewalks, where rope was made for the Company. It is named after the hydraulic engineer Jan Blanken (1775-1838).

name: Blasiusstraat
en: The Blasiusstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Bloedstraat
en: The Bloedstraat is a short, narrow street in the Wallengebied of Amsterdam-Centrum. It runs from the Nieuwmarkt to the Oudezijds Achterburgwal. Since 1464 the site of the street was occupied by the Minderbroedersklooster (Minorite friary) and the vroedschapskerk ('council church') of the 'Grauwe Monniken'.

name: Bloemendalergouw
en: The Bloemendalergouw is a road in Landelijk Noord, Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Bloemstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Bloemstraat (Amsterdam) is listed on the 1832 Cadastral map as the Blomstraat. It is a street in the Jordaan district of Amsterdam-Centrum. The street's name is connected with the nearby Bloemgracht.

name: Blomwijckerpad
en: The Blomwijckerpad is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Boerhaaveplein
en: The Boerhaaveplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Bokkinghangen
en: Bokkinghangen is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies between the Zoutkeetsgracht and the Barentszplein, and is partly the western quay of the Westerdok. Going south, one reaches the Zandhoek via the Petemayenbrug, also a quay of the Westerdok.

name: Bontekoestraat
en: The Bontekoestraat is a residential street in the Spaarndammerbuurt of Amsterdam-West.

name: Borneostraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Borneostraat (Amsterdam) is a main street in the Indische Buurt of Amsterdam-Oost. It branches off the Zeeburgerdijk after the Zeeburgerdijkspoorbrug and runs to the Javaplein. It was named in 1900 after the island of Borneo, the largest island in the Indies archipelago.

name: Bos en Lommerplantsoen
en: The Bos en Lommerplantsoen is a park in Amsterdam-West.

name: Bos en Lommerplein
en: The Bos en Lommerplein in Amsterdam-West was laid out in the 1940s on land of the former municipality of Sloten, annexed in 1921. It is named after the farm of that name, demolished in 1940, which stood along the Sloterdijkermeerweg and linked Sloterdijk with the Sloterdijkermeerpolder (now the Sloterplas).

name: Bosboom Toussaintstraat
en: The Bosboom Toussaintstraat is a street in the Helmersbuurt in the Amsterdam-West borough. It was named in 1882 after Geertruida Bosboom-Toussaint, a well-known Dutch writer.

name: Breitnerstraat
en: The Breitnerstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Breughelstraat
en: The Breughelstraat is a street in the Apollobuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Brink (Amsterdam)
en: Brink (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer.

name: Buiksloterdijk
en: The Buiksloterdijk is a dyke and street in Amsterdam-Noord. In 1924 it became the new name for the stretch of the Waterlandse Zeedijk in the former municipality of Buiksloot, annexed to Amsterdam in 1921. North-west of it the old sea dyke is called the Landsmeerderdijk, and south-east the Nieuwendammerdijk.

name: Buikslotermeerdijk
en: The Buikslotermeerdijk is a street, former dyke and historic route in the Buikslotermeer district of Amsterdam-Noord. The dyke forms the southern boundary of the former Buikslotermeerpolder and runs west from the Meeuwenlaan to the Noordhollands Kanaal, where it meets the IJdoornlaanbrug (bridge 970).

name: Buikslotermeerplein
en: The Buikslotermeerplein is a square and area in the Buikslotermeer district, in the Buikslotermeerpolder in Amsterdam (Noord). Most of it is taken up by a shopping centre, now called Boven 't Y, the largest in the borough.

name: Buiksloterweg
en: The Buiksloterweg is a road in Amsterdam-Noord. It connects the IJ ferry landing stage, via the De Ruijterkade at the Tolhuis, with the Buiksloterdijk. On the west side lies a Shell site, largely abandoned, being converted into the new district of Overhoeks.

name: Buiten Vissersstraat
en: The Buiten Vissersstraat is an ancient little street in Amsterdam-Centrum, about 32 metres long.

name: Burgemeester Rendorpstraat
en: The Burgemeester Rendorpstraat is a street in Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It runs from the Burgemeester Van Tienhovengracht to the northern side of the Sloterplas. Halfway along it is crossed by the Burgemeester Röellstraat.

name: Carolina MacGillavrylaan
en: The Carolina MacGillavrylaan is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Carrascoplein
en: The Carrascoplein is a square in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a public transport hub in Amsterdam.

name: Castorplein
en: The Castorplein is one of the many small squares in Tuindorp Oostzaan in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Ceramplein
en: The Ceramplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Chasséstraat
en: The Chasséstraat is a street in the Amsterdam borough of West. It was named in 1922, shortly after the 1921 annexation of Sloten, where the street had previously lain as the Rijnstraat. The name refers to the lieutenant-colonel in the Batavian Legion David Hendrik Chassé (1765-1849).

name: Chet Bakerstraat
en: The Chet Bakerstraat is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Chopinstraat
en: The Chopinstraat is a street in the Apollobuurt of Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Christiaan Huygensplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Christiaan Huygensplein (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer, in the Middenmeer district.

name: Colensostraat
en: The Colensostraat is a relatively short little street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Comeniusstraat
en: The Comeniusstraat is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, in the Slotervaart district.

name: Concertgebouwplein
en: The Concertgebouwplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid, lying south of the Royal Concertgebouw. From 1893 to 1988 it was called the J.W. Brouwersplein, after the parish priest and writer Jan Willem Brouwers (1831-1893). It was renamed to mark the 100th anniversary of the Concertgebouw.

name: Conradstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Conradstraat (Amsterdam) is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in the centre of Amsterdam.

name: Cornelis Dirkszstraat
en: The Cornelis Dirkszstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West. It was named by council decision on 30 September 1931 after the Geuzen leader Cornelis Dirkszoon. Until then it was known as the 'street behind the Jan Evertsenstraat'.

name: Cornelis Dopperkade
en: The Cornelis Dopperkade is a street in the Prinses Irenebuurt in Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Cornelis Krusemanstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Cornelis Krusemanstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies in line with the De Lairessestraat and runs from the Valeriusplein to the Amstelveenseweg. On this street stands the Sint-Agneskerk. It was named in 1917 after the painter Cornelis Kruseman (1797-1857).

name: Cornelis Lelyplein
en: The Cornelis Lelyplein is the station square of Amsterdam Lelylaan station. The square lies beneath the station, south of the Cornelis Lelylaan, north and west of the Schipluidenlaan and north and east of the Pieter Calandlaan.

name: Cornelis Schuytstraat
en: The Cornelis Schuytstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is named after the Dutch composer and organist Cornelis Schuyt (1557-1616).

name: Cornelis Troostplein
en: The Cornelis Troostplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Cort van der Lindenkade
en: The Cort van der Lindenkade is a street in the Geuzenveld district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West. By council decision of 11 December 1953 it was named after Pieter Cort van der Linden, prime minister of the Netherlands from 1913 to 1918.

name: Cruquiusstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Cruquiusstraat (Amsterdam) is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It forms part of the Czaar Peterbuurt. The street essentially begins at the Conradstraat, though a further section in line with it runs to the Oostenburgervaart, which for house numbering is counted as part of the Conradstraat.

name: Cruquiusweg (Amsterdam)
en: The Cruquiusweg (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Oost. The road was named in 1879 after Nicolaas Samuel Cruquius (1678-1754). The district office of the former Zeeburg borough (1990-2010) was located on the Cruquiusweg.

name: Cullinanplein
en: The Cullinanplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a pedestrian area in the Nieuwe Pijp, in the Diamantbuurt. The neighbourhood was built in the 19th century on former farmland under the municipality of Nieuwer-Amstel.

name: Czaar Peterstraat
en: The Czaar Peterstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum, named after Tsar Peter the Great. On the south side it is bounded by the Oostenburgergracht and on the north side by the Piet Heinkade. Its side streets are the Cruquiusstraat, Eerste Leeghwaterstraat, Tweede Leeghwaterstraat and Lijndenstraat.

name: Da Costaplein
en: The Da Costaplein is a square in Amsterdam-West, in the Da Costabuurt.

name: Daan Roodenburghplein
en: The Daan Roodenburghplein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Daniël Stalpertstraat
en: The Daniël Stalpertstraat is a street in the Oud-Zuid borough of Amsterdam, in the Oude Pijp district. It is named after the 17th-century Amsterdam architect and city architect Daniël Stalpaert (1615-1676). It runs from the Ruysdaelkade in the west to the Eerste van der Helststraat and Gerard Douplein in the east.

name: Dapperplein
en: The Dapperplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost. It is crossed north-south by the Dapperstraat, where the daily Dappermarkt is held, and east-west by the Tweede van Swindenstraat.

name: Kalfjeslaan
en: The Kalfjeslaan is an avenue in Amsterdam-Zuid, in Buitenveldert.

name: Kamerlingh Onneslaan
en: The Kamerlingh Onneslaan is a major through street in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Watergraafsmeer district, and forms the continuation of the Hogeweg. It begins at the Middenweg and runs westwards with a gentle bend, lying clearly lower in the polder than Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Karnstraat
en: The Karnstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Kastelenstraat
en: The Kastelenstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, in Buitenveldert.

name: Kattenburgerkruisstraat
en: The Kattenburgerkruisstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum on Kattenburg, and is named after it.

name: Kattengat
en: The Kattengat is a short street in Amsterdam-Centrum. It runs from east to west and begins as a side street of the Spuistraat. At the Smaksteeg it emerges onto the Stromarkt, which lies on the Singel.

name: Kijkduinstraat
en: The Kijkduinstraat is a street in Landlust, Amsterdam-West. By council decision of 27 April 1933 it was named after the Battle of Kijkduin at Fort Kijkduin near Den Helder. Streets in the area are named after naval battles. Several towns, such as Haarlem and Arnhem, also have a Kijkduinstraat.

name: Kingsfordweg
en: The Kingsfordweg is a street in Amsterdam in the Teleport business area, close to Sloterdijk station. It links the Changiweg with the Arlandaweg from north to south and, after crossing the Arlandaweg, dead-ends at the Haarlemmertrekvaart. A Coca-Cola factory stood here from 1930. The street runs parallel to the Einsteinweg.

name: Kinkerstraat
en: The Kinkerstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West, part of the Kinkerbuurt. It was named in 1881 after the poet and lawyer Johannes Kinker (1764-1845). It runs from the Nassaukade to the Kostverlorenvaart, where the Kinkerbrug links it to the Postjesweg.

name: Kleine Zonneplein
en: The Kleine Zonneplein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Klipperstraat
en: The Klipperstraat in Amsterdam is a street in the Banne Buiksloot district of Amsterdam-Noord.

name: KNSM-laan
en: The KNSM-laan is an avenue on the KNSM-eiland in the Eastern Docklands of the Dutch capital Amsterdam. The name refers to the Koninklijke Nederlandse Stoomboot-Maatschappij (KNSM), which was based on the artificial 'island' from 1903 to 1979.

name: Koekoeksplein
en: The Koekoeksplein is a square in the Vogelbuurt, Amsterdam-Noord. The municipality of Utrecht also has a Koekoeksplein.

name: Koenenkade
en: The Koenenkade is a road in the municipalities of Amsterdam and Amstelveen in the Dutch province of Noord-Holland. It runs westwards from the Amstelveenseweg in the Amsterdam district of Buitenveldert. The municipality of Nieuwer-Amstel named the road after a former resident.

name: Koerierstersplein
en: The Koerierstersplein is a city square in Amsterdam-Centrum. The square is a pedestrian area.

name: Konijnenstraat
en: The Konijnenstraat is a street in the Amsterdam Jordaan district, in the Centrum borough. It runs between the Lauriergracht to the north and the Elandsstraat to the south, and lies close to the Prinsengracht.

name: Koningin Wilhelminaplein
en: The Koningin Wilhelminaplein lies in the Overtoomse Veld district of Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Koningsstraat (Amsterdam)
en: Koningsstraat (Amsterdam), sometimes wrongly spelled Koningstraat, is a street in the Nieuwmarkt district of Amsterdam running from the Nieuwmarkt south-eastwards to the Oudeschans. The Kromboomssloot and several alleys cross it, including the Brandewijnsteeg, the Zakslootje and the Koningsdwarsstraat.

name: Koornhorst
en: Koornhorst is a building and street in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The street received its name on 10 October 1973, named after a farm in Bergh-Montferland. The building was put up in a district known as the K-Buurt.

name: Korsjespoortsteeg
en: The Korsjespoortsteeg is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Korte Marnixkade
en: The Korte Marnixkade is a street in the Planciusbuurt Zuid district of the Amsterdam-Centrum borough.

name: Korte Marnixstraat
en: The Korte Marnixstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum, in the Haarlemmerbuurt. All buildings except number 4 are municipal monuments.

name: Korte Zoutkeetsgracht
en: The Korte Zoutkeetsgracht is a short street between the Planciusstraat and the Houtmankade in the Planciusbuurt Noord in Amsterdam-Centrum. In 2000 the municipality renamed this stretch of quay along the Zoutkeetsgracht as Korte Zoutkeetsgracht, clearing up much confusion for postal workers, visitors and couriers.

name: Kortenaerplein
en: The Kortenaerplein is a square in Amsterdam-West.

name: Kouterstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Kouterstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Watergraafsmeer district.

name: Kraaienplein
en: The Kraaienplein is a square in the Vogelbuurt Zuid district of Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Kraanspoor
en: Kraanspoor is a street in Amsterdam-Noord; it is also the name of the largest building on that street.

name: Kraijenhoffstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Kraijenhoffstraat (Amsterdam), or Eerste Kraijenhoffstraat, is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It borders the Funenpark and lies in the Czaar Peterbuurt. It runs from the Tweede Coehoornstraat across the Cruquiusstraat and ends at a block addressed from both the Eerste and the Tweede Leeghwaterstraat.

name: Krimpertplein
en: The Krimpertplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It received its name by council decision of 19 October 1983, after the Krimpert farm on the Verwolde estate near Laren in Gelderland.

name: Kromme Palmstraat
en: Kromme Palmstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies like a hook in the triangle formed between the Brouwergracht, Lijnbaansgracht and Palmgracht (no longer a canal since 1895), at the northernmost point of the Jordaan district. The little street dates from the same period as the neighbouring Driehoekstraat.

name: Krommeniestraat
en: The Krommeniestraat is a street in the Spaarndammerbuurt in Amsterdam-West.

name: Krommertstraat
en: The Krommertstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West. It was named by council decision on 22 April 1925 after the watercourse De Krommert.

name: Krugerplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Krugerplein (Amsterdam) is a square in the Transvaalbuurt in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Kruislaan (Amsterdam)
en: The Kruislaan (Amsterdam) is a street in the Oost borough of Amsterdam. The street takes its name from its location in the former municipality and polder of Watergraafsmeer (Kruis Wech). It crosses the Middenweg. On 1 January 1921 the municipality of Amsterdam incorporated Watergraafsmeer.

name: Laanweg
en: The Laanweg is a street in Amsterdam-Noord. Although the name was only fixed on 8 October 1986, its history goes back to 1851, when the Buiksloterham polder was drained. Three 'traffic routes' (dijk, weg and laan) were created there, and the last of these had a row of trees.

name: Land van Cocagneplein
en: The Land van Cocagneplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Landsmeerderdijk
en: The Landsmeerderdijk is a dyke and street in Amsterdam-Noord. It is the section of the Waterlandse Zeedijk that formerly lay in the municipality of Landsmeer. In 1966 the southern part of that municipality, up to and including the A10 ring road, was added to Amsterdam, including the hamlet of Kadoelen and the Landsmeer section of the former sea dyke.

name: Lange Niezel
en: The Lange Niezel, with the Korte Niezel as its continuation, is a narrow street in the Wallengebied district of Amsterdam-Centrum. It runs from the Warmoesstraat to the Oudezijds Voorburgwal, where it continues as the Korte Niezel. The street contains 17 national monuments.

name: Langebrugsteeg
en: The Langebrugsteeg is a small street in Amsterdam. It runs from the Rokin to the Nes, where it becomes the Grimburgwal. At the corner with the Oude Turfmarkt, on the east side of the Rokin, stands an equestrian statue of Queen Wilhelmina.

name: Langkatstraat
en: The Langkatstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Laurierstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Laurierstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Jordaan district, in the Amsterdam-Centrum borough. It runs from the Prinsengracht to the Lijnbaansgracht and crosses the Eerste and Tweede Laurierdwarsstraat in turn.

name: Le Mairestraat
en: The Le Mairestraat is a residential street in the Spaarndammerbuurt in Amsterdam.

name: Leeuwarderweg (Amsterdam)
