en: The Leeuwarderweg (Amsterdam) is a section of the Waterlandse Zeedijk at Tuindorp Buiksloot in Amsterdam-Noord. It is an old dyke, now lying beside the former Volewijkspark and the present Noorderpark.

name: Leeuwenhoekstraat
en: The Leeuwenhoekstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Legmeerplein
en: The Legmeerplein is a square in Amsterdam, located in the Legmeerpleinbuurt in the Hoofddorppleinbuurt district of Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Legmeerstraat
en: The Legmeerstraat is a street in the Hoofddorppleinbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid, Amsterdam.

name: Lepelstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Lepelstraat (Amsterdam) is a short and narrow street with houses in the Weesperbuurt in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Levantkade
en: The Levantkade is a street and quay on the KNSM-eiland in the Oostelijk Havengebied in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Levantplein
en: The Levantplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Lia Doranastraat
en: The Lia Doranastraat is a street in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Liergouw
en: The Liergouw is a road between the villages of Schellingwoude and Ransdorp in Amsterdam-Noord. It is about 2500 metres long and runs from the south-west towards the east.

name: Lijndenstraat
en: The Lijndenstraat is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It runs parallel to the Tweede Leeghwaterstraat, which lies a little further south. Named after Frans Godert van Lynden van Hemmen, the street lies between the Conradstraat and the Blankenstraat and crosses only the Czaar Peterstraat.

name: Linnaeushof (Amsterdam)
en: The Linnaeushof (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Watergraafsmeer district and the Middenmeer neighbourhood.

name: Lizzy Ansinghstraat
en: The Lizzy Ansinghstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Lodewijk van Deysselstraat
en: The Lodewijk van Deysselstraat is a street in the Amsterdam districts of Slotermeer and Geuzenveld, running from east to west.

name: Louwesweg
en: The Louwesweg in Slotervaart, in the Amsterdam borough of Nieuw-West, lies in line with the Aletta Jacobslaan, from the Johan Huizingalaan to the Antwerpenbaan. It was named in 1957 after the senior civil servant Stefan Louwes (1889-1953), who developed the food distribution system in the Second World War.

name: Lumeijstraat
en: The Lumeijstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam Oud-West. Originally named Emmastraat in the former municipality of Sloten (1911), it was renamed in 1922 after the Geuzen leader Willem II van der Marck Lumey, because Amsterdam, which had annexed Sloten, already had an Emmastraat.

name: Lupineplein
en: The Lupineplein is a rectangular square, probably square in shape, in Amsterdam-Noord. It received its name on 21 January 1920, as did the Lupinestraat, which leads from the south to the square. Both are named after the lupin plant.

name: M.J. Granpré Molièreplein
en: The M.J. Granpré Molièreplein is a street and pedestrian area in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was named by council decision on 2 December 1997 after the architect Marinus Jan Granpré Molière.

name: Maasstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Maasstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in the Zuid borough of Amsterdam. It is named after the river that flows through France, Belgium and the Netherlands.

name: Majoor Fransweg
en: Majoor Fransweg is a road in Amsterdam-West.

name: Majubastraat
en: The Majubastraat is a street in the Transvaalbuurt, Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Makassarplein
en: The Makassarplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost. The surrounding district, at the point where the Zeeburgerdijk, Flevoweg and Insulindeweg meet, is named the Makassarpleinbuurt.

name: Marcantilaan
en: The Marcantilaan is a street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Marcusstraat
en: The Marcusstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Maria Beshof
en: Maria Beshof is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Although Amsterdam has a long history of almshouse courts (hofjes), the Maria Beshof was not created until the 21st century. The court is named after the chemical engineer Marie Bes.

name: Maritzstraat
en: Maritzstraat is a relatively short street in the Transvaalbuurt, Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Marnixkade (Amsterdam)
en: The Marnixkade (Amsterdam) in the Amsterdam Jordaan is a quay that runs largely parallel to the Marnixstraat and forms the eastern bank of the northern part of the Singelgracht. The opposite bank of that canal is formed by the Nassaukade. The three sections of the Marnixkade do not connect directly with one another.

name: Martin Vlaarkade
en: Martin Vlaarkade is a street in Amsterdam-West (Oud-West).

name: Meeuwenlaan (Amsterdam)
en: The Meeuwenlaan (Amsterdam), largely located in the Nieuwendammerham in Amsterdam-Noord, links the Waddenweg with the Pontplein. Like all the other streets to its west, its name refers to a bird, in this case the gull.

name: Meidoornplein
en: The Meidoornplein is a rectangular square in Amsterdam-Noord. It received its name on 21 January 1920, taking a piece from the Meidoornlaan, which had been named in 1919. Both were named after the hawthorn. The Meidoornlaan has crossed the square since building began in the same period.

name: Melkweg (straat in Amsterdam)
en: Melkweg (straat in Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam. The name also belongs to a cultural centre in Amsterdam-Centrum, a farm in Osdorp, and a sports park in Amsterdam-Noord that lies in line with the street.

name: Memeleiland
en: Memeleiland is a rectangular artificial island and street in Amsterdam-West. The name refers to the city of Klaipėda, formerly called Memel. That area was once important to Amsterdam's timber trade. The island lies on the site of part of the Houthavens, which existed until the early 21st century.

name: Mercatorplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Mercatorplein (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-West.

name: Messinastraat
en: The Messinastraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, named by council decision on 30 October 1991 after the Sicilian port city of Messina on the Strait of Messina. The street lies between the Sumatrakade to the north and the KNSM-laan.

name: Michelangelostraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Michelangelostraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Amsterdam-Zuid borough, in Oud-Zuid, in the Apollobuurt. It is named after Michelangelo di Lodovico Buonarroti Simoni, Italian painter, sculptor, architect and poet (1475-1564).

name: Minervalaan
en: The Minervalaan is a street in the Amsterdam borough of Zuid. It is named after the Roman goddess Minerva, who stood for reason.

name: Minervaplein
en: The Minervaplein is a square in the Zuid borough of Amsterdam. It is named after Minerva, the Roman goddess of reason and intellect.

name: Moermanskkade
en: The Moermanskkade is a little-known street and quay in Amsterdam-Westpoort. The quay refers to the banks of the Minervahaven and Mercuriushaven, on which a 500 metre long street has been laid.

name: Molenwerf (Amsterdam)
en: Molenwerf (Amsterdam) is a square in Amsterdam-West.

name: Mosplein
en: The Mosplein is a square and shopping area in the Bloemenbuurt in Amsterdam-Noord. It was laid out in the early 1920s, at the same time as the Disteldorp was built.

name: Mozes en Aäronstraat
en: The Mozes en Aäronstraat is a short street in central Amsterdam. It runs from east to west, starting at the Dam near the Eggertstraat, close to the Nieuwendijk. It then continues with a gentle bend to the Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal.

name: Muiderstraat
en: The Muiderstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum that links the Mr. Visserplein with the Plantage Middenlaan. It runs from the Mr. Visserplein to the Hortusbrug (bridge no. 239) over the Nieuwe Herengracht, by the Hortus Botanicus, where it continues as the Plantage Middenlaan.

name: Museumstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Museumstraat (Amsterdam) links the Stadhouderskade, at the Museumbrug, with the Museumplein. It was named in 1880 after the Rijksmuseum, completed in 1885, which was built over the street. The section beneath the museum building is the Passage Rijksmuseum.

name: Muzenplein
en: The Muzenplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid. It carries a joint design by Hendrik Petrus Berlage and Piet Kramer for the urban development of that district. Kramer had a small plantation in mind for this square; whether it was ever built is unknown. The square is in fact a T-junction.

name: Naaldwijkstraat
en: The Naaldwijkstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Narva-eiland
en: Narva-eiland is a rectangular artificial island and street in Amsterdam-West. The name refers to the Baltic port Narval, which was important to the timber trade with Amsterdam. The island lies on the site of part of the Houthavens, which existed until the early 21st century.

name: NDSM-plein
en: The NDSM-plein is a square in Amsterdam-Noord. It received its name in the 21st century, when the former shipbuilding area of the Nederlandsche Dok en Scheepsbouw Maatschappij (NDSM) was redeveloped.

name: Nicolaas Beetsplantsoen
en: The Nicolaas Beetsplantsoen is a square in the Kinkerbuurt in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is named after the Nicolaas Beetsstraat, which in turn is named after the writer Nicolaas Beets. The square is bounded on the east by the Nicolaas Beetsstraat and on the south by the Jacob van Lennepkanaal and the Jacob van Lennepkade.

name: Nicolaas Beetsstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Nicolaas Beetsstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in the Oud West/De Baarsjes district of Amsterdam-West. It begins in the north at the Bellamystraat, although that first stretch is open only to pedestrians and cyclists, who pass under a gatehouse. It then crosses the Hasebroekstraat and the Kinkerstraat with a slight kink.

name: Nicolaas Berchemstraat
en: The Nicolaas Berchemstraat is a street in De Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid. It was named in 1886 after the painter Nicolaes Berchem. The street is scarcely longer than 50 metres and runs north-south between the Stadhouderskade/Singelgracht and the Albert Cuypstraat.

name: Niersstraat
en: The Niersstraat is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Nieuwe Amstelstraat
en: The Nieuwe Amstelstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Nieuwe Hoogstraat
en: The Nieuwe Hoogstraat is an Amsterdam street that links the Oude Hoogstraat with the Sint Antoniesbreestraat in Amsterdam-Centrum. It runs from the Bushuissluis over the Kloveniersburgwal towards the Snoekjessteeg. In the shadow of the Zuiderkerk, the Zanddwarstraat and the Zuiderkerkhof border the Nieuwe Hoogstraat.

name: Nieuwe Kerkstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Nieuwe Kerkstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in central Amsterdam. It lies in the former Jewish quarter of Amsterdam and is crossed by the Weesperstraat.

name: Nieuwe Nieuwstraat
en: The Nieuwe Nieuwstraat is a centuries-old narrow street in central Amsterdam. It already appears on the map by Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode from 1599. The street forms part of a pedestrian area around the Nieuwendijk.

name: Nieuwe Oostenburgerdwarsstraat
en: The Nieuwe Oostenburgerdwarsstraat is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is wedged between the Wittenburgervaart and the Oostenburgervoorstraat, which was moved in the 20th century. The street runs parallel to the Oostenburgerdwarsstraat and crosses the Nieuwe Oostenburgerstraat.

name: Nieuwe Oostenburgerstraat
en: The Nieuwe Oostenburgerstraat is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies between the Oostenburgerdwarsstraat and the Nieuwe Oostenburgerdwarsstraat. The houses on the odd-numbered side have their back elevations facing the Wittenburgervaart and look out over the Ezelsbrug.

name: Nieuwe Teertuinen
en: The Nieuwe Teertuinen is a quay in Amsterdam's Haarlemmerbuurt. It runs north from the railway line on the north side of the Haarlemmerplein. On the Sloterdijkstraat, beside the railway line, a large office building has been built facing the Nieuwe Teertuinen.

name: Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat
en: The Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat is a street in the central Amsterdam. It is the main street of the Uilenburg island. It continues the line of the Peperstraat, running from the Peperbrug over the Rapenburgwal in a south-westerly direction to the Steenvoetsluis over the Houtkopersburgwal.

name: Nieuwe Vijzelstraat
en: The Nieuwe Vijzelstraat is an extremely short street, about 20 metres long, in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Nieuwegrachtje
en: The Nieuwegrachtje is a short street and filled-in canal in the Nieuwmarkt district of Amsterdam, on the former island of Valkenburg (Marken) in the eastern part of the city centre. It is a side street of the Valkenburgerstraat, which continues past it eastwards as the Foeliestraat.

name: Nieuwendammerdijk
en: The Nieuwendammerdijk is a dyke and street in the Nieuwendam district of Amsterdam-Noord. The former village of Nieuwendam lay in a ribbon of development along the dyke, which holds an old lock, the Nieuwendammersluis. The Nieuwendammerdijk is the roughly 1.8 km section of the Waterlandse Zeedijk that lay in the former municipality of Nieuwendam.

name: Nieuwezijds Armsteeg
en: The Nieuwezijds Armsteeg is an alley in the form of a long, stretched arc in Amsterdam-Centrum. Amsterdam also has an Oudezijds Armsteeg.

name: Nieuwlandhof
en: Nieuwlandhof is a street in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Nieuwpoortkade
en: The Nieuwpoortkade is a street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Nobelweg
en: The Nobelweg is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Watergraafsmeer district and the Frankendael neighbourhood.

name: Noorderdwarsstraat
en: The Noorderdwarsstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Noorderstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Noorderstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Noordhollandschkanaaldijk
en: The Noordhollandschkanaaldijk is a street in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Noordplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Noordplein (Amsterdam) is an urban square in the city centre area of the Amsterdam Noord borough. It came into being after new buildings were completed as part of the Centrum Amsterdam Noord urban plan.

name: Nova Zemblastraat
en: The Nova Zemblastraat is a residential street in the Spaarndammerbuurt in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Obiplein
en: The Obiplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Oetewalerstraat
en: The Oetewalerstraat is a dead-end street in Amsterdam-Oost, Dapperbuurt-Zuid.

name: Olmenweg
en: The Olmenweg is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Olympiaplein
en: The Olympiaplein is a square in the Zuid borough of Amsterdam. It is one of the largest squares in the city, with sport in the middle and housing around it. It was laid out from 1926 as part of Berlage's Plan Zuid, and also in preparation for Amsterdam's hosting of the 1928 Olympic Games.

name: Olympiaweg (Amsterdam)
en: The Olympiaweg (Amsterdam) is a street in the Marathonbuurt, part of the Stadionbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. It begins beside the Olympiaplein, where the Apollolaan ends, and runs south-westwards, diagonally to the streets of the surrounding neighbourhoods, as far as the Stadionweg at the Stadionplein.

name: Oosteinde (Amsterdam)
en: Oosteinde (Amsterdam) and Achter Oosteinde are two streets in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Oostenburgerdwarsstraat
en: The Oostenburgerdwarsstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum on the Oostelijke Eilanden. The name refers to the former island of Oostenburg. The 'dwars' refers to the Groote and Kleine Oostenburgerstraat, which once lay here, roughly where the Oostenburgervoorstraat is now.

name: Oostenburgergracht
en: The Oostenburgergracht is a canal and street on Oostenburg, alongside the Nieuwe Vaart in the eastern part of central Amsterdam. Since 1950 the Oostenburgergracht has formed a wide street. Together, the Oostenburgergracht, Kattenburgergracht and Wittenburgergracht form the so-called Eilandenboulevard.

name: Oostenburgermiddenstraat
en: The Oostenburgermiddenstraat is a street on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. Its history falls into three periods. The original street was called Oostenburger Middenstraat. It lay between the Oostenburger Voorstraat (now Oostenburgervoorstraat) and the Oostenburger Achterstraat.

name: Oostenburgervoorstraat
en: The Oostenburgervoorstraat is a street on Oostenburg, on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It ran from the Oostenburgergracht to the Dijksgracht. The street was first called Oostenburger Voorstraat, with its parallel streets the Oostenburger Middenstraat and Oostenburger Achterstraat.

name: Oosterendstraat
en: Oosterendstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Noord, Waterlandpleinbuurt.

name: Oosterspoorplein
en: The Oosterspoorplein is a square in Amsterdam, in the Oost borough.

name: Oostzanerdijk
en: The Oostzanerdijk is a dyke and street in Amsterdam-Noord. It is the section of the Waterlandse Zeedijk that formerly lay in the municipality of Oostzaan. In 1921 the dyke came to lie within the municipality of Amsterdam.

name: Oranje Nassaulaan (Amsterdam)
en: The Oranje Nassaulaan (Amsterdam) is a street in the Oud-Zuid district. It is the longest street in the Willemsparkbuurt-Noord villa neighbourhood, also known as the Lanenkwartier, near the Vondelpark.

name: Oranje-Vrijstaatkade
en: The Oranje-Vrijstaatkade is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Oranje-Vrijstaatplein
en: The Oranje-Vrijstaatplein is a square in the Oostpoort neighbourhood of the Dapperbuurt district in Amsterdam Oud-Oost. It is a pedestrian area.

name: Orlyplein
en: The Orlyplein is a raised square in Amsterdam-Westpoort, on the west side of Sloterdijk station, lying above the platforms and tracks of the railway line to Haarlem. Since 2009 there has been a separate station section at the Hemboog. The square was named in 1989 after Paris's Orly Airport.

name: Osdorper Ban
en: The Osdorper Ban is a through street in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp. Its name was set by council decision on 15 January 1958, after the hamlet of Osdorp. The name was already in use in the former municipality of Sloten, which joined Amsterdam on 1 January 1921.

name: Osdorperweg
en: The Osdorperweg is a road in Amsterdam Nieuw-West between the village of Sloten and Halfweg. Within Amsterdam it is interrupted by the Slotervaart.

name: Osdorpplein
en: The Osdorpplein is a square in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, lying between Meer en Vaart and Tussen Meer. It was named in 1962 after the garden city of Osdorp, where it serves a central function.

name: Oude Doelenstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Oude Doelenstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum, east of the Dam, linking the Damstraat with the Oude Hoogstraat.

name: Oude Hoogstraat
en: The Oude Hoogstraat is an Amsterdam street that links the Oude Doelenstraat with the Nieuwe Hoogstraat in Amsterdam-Centrum. It runs in a more or less easterly direction from the Paulusbroedersluis (bridge 215) over the Oudezijds Achterburgwal to the Bushuissluis (bridge 224) over the Kloveniersburgwal.

name: Oude Turfmarkt
en: The Oude Turfmarkt is a street in central Amsterdam, opposite the Rokin. The Allard Pierson Museum and the Special Collections department of the University of Amsterdam are located on the Oude Turfmarkt.

name: Oude Waal (Amsterdam)
en: The Oude Waal (Amsterdam) is the quay of a former waterway also called the Oude Waal. This inlet of the IJ came into being in 1377 through a dyke breach and was used for a long time as a repair and winter harbour. When silting made it too shallow, harbour activity moved to the Nieuwe Waal in 1510.

name: Oude-IJselstraat
en: Oude-IJselstraat in Amsterdam is a street in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. As far as is known, Amsterdam is the only Dutch municipality with a street named after the Oude IJssel. At the time of naming the name was still spelled Oude-IJsel.

name: Overhoeksplein
en: The Overhoeksplein is a rectangular city square in Amsterdam-Noord. The entire square is a pedestrian and cycling area.

name: Overschiestraat
en: The Overschiestraat is a street in the Delflandpleinbuurt West district, in the Westlandgracht district, Slotervaart, Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: P.E. Tegelbergplein
en: The P.E. Tegelbergplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost. Here 'plein' carries a double meaning, since it is also open space. The square overlooks the IJ. It received its name on 27 November 1996. The Zeeburg borough named it after Petrus Emelius Tegelberg (1838-1917), co-founder and director of the Stoomvaart-Maatschappij Nederland.

name: Palamedesstraat
en: The Palamedesstraat is a dead-end street in Amsterdam-West.

name: Paleisstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Paleisstraat (Amsterdam) is a short street in central Amsterdam. It runs from west to east, starting at the Singel. It then crosses the Spuistraat, the Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal and the Kalverstraat, and in the east comes out on the Dam.

name: Palmdwarsstraat
en: The Palmdwarsstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Paramariboplein
en: The Paramariboplein is a square in Amsterdam-West.

name: Paulus Potterstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Paulus Potterstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid. It was named by council decision on 22 March 1893 after the painter Paulus Potter.

name: Peelstraat (Amsterdam)
en: The Peelstraat (Amsterdam) is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Veluwebuurt, colloquially known as the Landstrekenbuurt.

name: Peter van Anrooystraat
en: The Peter van Anrooystraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Pienemanstraat
en: The Pienemanstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Zuid, Nieuwe Pijp.

name: Pieter Baststraat
en: The Pieter Baststraat is a street in the Museumkwartier in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Pieter Holmplein
en: Pieter Holmplein is a square in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Pieter Nieuwlandstraat
en: The Pieter Nieuwlandstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, Dapperbuurt.

name: Pieter Pauwstraat
en: The Pieter Pauwstraat is a relatively short and fairly little-known street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Pijnackerstraat
en: The Pijnackerstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid, Nieuwe Pijp.

name: Piraeusplein
en: The Piraeusplein is a square on the KNSM-eiland in Amsterdam-Oost. It is almost entirely enclosed by the Piraeus residential block.

name: Planciusstraat
en: The Planciusstraat is a street in the Amsterdam city centre, in the Centrum borough. It was given its name in 1875 after the minister and navigator Petrus Plancius (1555-1622). Previously this was De Schans, on the Smallepadsgracht.

name: Planetenplein (Amsterdam)
en: The Planetenplein (Amsterdam) is one of many small squares in Tuindorp Oostzaan. It received its name on 26 October 1921, in a district where all the streets and squares are named after heavenly bodies. It is one of four squares arranged symmetrically around the Zonneplein.

name: Plantage Kerklaan
en: The Plantage Kerklaan is a street in the Plantage in Amsterdam, where the Artis zoo is located. It runs from the Lau Mazirelbrug (bridge 259) over the Plantage Muidergracht to the corner of the Plantage Doklaan, where it becomes the Nijlpaardenbrug leading to the Entrepotdok.

name: Plantage Parklaan
en: The Plantage Parklaan is a street in the Plantage district of Amsterdam. It runs alongside the Wertheimpark and the rear of the Hortus Botanicus.

name: Platanenweg
en: The Platanenweg is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Plein '40-'45
en: Plein '40-'45 is the central square of the garden city of Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It received its name in 1955 and commemorates the years of German occupation from 1940 to 1945. Since 1961 the Vrijheidscarillon has stood on the square. The square lies on the edge of the Verzetsheldenbuurt.

name: Hortusplantsoen
en: The Hortusplantsoen is a small park and street in the centre of Amsterdam. The small park lies on the south side of the Hortus Botanicus, between the Nieuwe Herengracht (corner of the Weesperstraat) and the Nieuwe Keizersgracht (at the bend where the canal becomes the Plantage Muidergracht).

name: Jan van Zutphenplantsoen
en: The Jan van Zutphenplantsoen is a small park and green strip in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp. It lies in the south-western part of the district, west of the Hoekenesgracht and east of the Baden Powellweg, between the Slotervaart and the Jan van Zutphenstraat, which is also named after Jan van Zutphen.

name: Oostenburgerpark
en: The Oostenburgerpark is a park and street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Oudenaardeplantsoen
en: The Oudenaardeplantsoen lies on the western section of the Antwerpenbaan in Nieuw Sloten in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The small park was named in 1991 after the Belgian city of Oudenaarde.

name: Sloterkade
en: The Sloterkade is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Vrije Geer
en: De Vrije Geer has been the name of a road in Amsterdam north of the village of Sloten since 1954. The name is derived from a triangular piece of land (a geer) around Sloten, whose inhabitants were exempt from paying certain taxes to the counts of Holland.

name: Cedar (gebouw)
en: Cedar (Dutch for cedar tree) is a large-scale office building on the Bijlmerdreef, adjoining the Amsterdamse Poort shopping centre in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It was officially opened on 7 January 2020 as the head office of ING Groep.

name: Kleiburg
en: Kleiburg is an existing block of flats and street/address in the K-buurt of the Bijlmermeer (Bijlmer-Oost) in the Amsterdam district of Zuidoost. It was the last honeycomb flat in its original 1970s state. From 1995 to the present, the Zuidoost district has been renewing and upgrading the Bijlmer.

name: Onderdoorgang Hercules Seghersstraat
en: Onderdoorgang Hercules Seghersstraat is a gatehouse in Amsterdam-Zuid, De Pijp.

name: Rijksmonument 335336
en: Rijksmonument 335336 comprises a building block on the edge of Brink in Betondorp, Amsterdam-Oost. The building stands partly on Brink (house numbers 43-45) and partly in the Landbouwstraat (house number 61). It was erected in 1926-1928 as a library with reading room in the Betondorp neighbourhood. Homes and shops had stood here earlier.

name: Entrepotbrug
en: De Entrepotbrug is a large residential apartment building from 1992 in the Eastern Harbour District of Amsterdam, designed by architects of atelier PRO. It lies largely above the water of the Entrepothaven. 'Entrepotbrug' is also the street name of the addresses in the building.

name: Weesperstaete
en: Weesperstaete is a Dutch office building from 1969 in Amsterdam. It is located on the Weesperplein, on the corner of the Sarphatistraat, and was designed by Alexander Bodon for Bank voor Onroerende Zaken nv. Colloquially it is known as 'De Doodskist' (The Coffin). It has 9 floors and was originally fitted with a curtain wall of dark-tinted glass.

name: De Dokwerker
en: De Dokwerker is a statue and memorial on the Jonas Daniël Meijerplein in Amsterdam, commemorating the February Strike of 1941. The statue was designed and made by the sculptor Mari Andriessen, commissioned by the Amsterdam municipal government.

name: 11 Rue Crubellier
en: 11 Rue Simon-Crubellier is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Animaris rhinoceros transport
en: The Animaris rhinoceros transport is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artwork was designed by artist and inventor Theo Jansen, who is best known for his moving objects in the form of strandbeesten, mainly skeletons made of plastic, which keep themselves moving once set in motion.

name: Belle (standbeeld)
en: Belle is a 2007 sculpture on the Oudekerksplein in Amsterdam, made by the Dutch sculptor Els Rijerse on commission from the Prostitutie Informatie Centrum (PIC). The bronze figure on a granite plinth pays tribute to sex workers worldwide, and the initiator was former prostitute Mariska Majoor. Belle is French for 'beautiful'.

name: Dragers van verre
en: Dragers van verre is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a creation by Nelson Carrilho, standing since 1989 in the Westerpark in Amsterdam. The poet Kenneth Echteld on the statue: "Let us pause to consider that every person, wherever they come from or are going to, has brought and carries their cultural richness."

name: Het Lieverdje
en: Het Lieverdje is a statue on the Spui in Amsterdam. It was made by the Amsterdam sculptor Carel Kneulman.

name: Mama Baranka
en: Mama Baranka is an artwork in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid, in memory of the death of Kerwin Duinmeijer. The statue is an initiative of Fundashon Antiano Amsterdam (Antillean welfare foundation).

name: Naatje van de Dam
en: Naatje van de Dam or Naatje op de Dam, officially De Eendracht, was a monument that stood on the Dam in Amsterdam, opposite the Palace on the Dam, between 1856 and 1914.

name: Voetballers (Ek van Zanten)
en: Voetballers is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. At the request of Pierre Janssen, and on commission from the Amsterdam municipality, Ek van Zanten depicted two footballers fighting over the ball. Amsterdam wanted a tribute at the Olympic Stadium to the Dutch footballers who finished second at the 1974 World Cup (and possibly also 1978).

name: 101 Namen
en: 101 Namen is a two-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is an artwork by Martine Neddam, born in Algeria but living in Amsterdam-West in 1996. The location is the Van Swindenspoorbrug between the Eerste Van Swindenstraat and the Javastraat, on the side of the Pontanusstraat.

name: 178 Bottles, 1 Message
en: 178 Bottles, 1 Message is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Westpoort. It is a creation by Lieuwe Martijn Wijnands and Saskia Hoogendoorn, working under Art & Design Tijdmakers. It was made in 2014 and consists of LED lighting and steel. The artists were inspired by the nationalities represented in Amsterdam that year.

name: 2 U's naar buiten, 2 U's naar binnen
en: 2 U's naar buiten, 2 U's naar binnen is a two-part artistic artwork standing in the Bos en Lommerplantsoen, Amsterdam Oud-West. The area around the Bos en Lommerplein underwent a transformation around 1960. This was caused by the construction of the GAK building, also known as the aquarium.

name: 270 degrees
en: 270 degrees is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is applied art. The three concrete objects offer a somewhat sheltered spot for birdwatchers who want to watch the birds that have settled in the Osdorper Binnenpolder-Zuid. The area is designated as one of the last medieval landscapes around Amsterdam.

name: Monument Holendrecht
en: The Monument Holendrecht is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue is a creation by Maria Glandorf from 1984. The full inscription reads Monument Holendrecht in memory of the resistance and the liberation. In two bronze human-like figures on a concrete plinth, it depicts the eternal struggle between people and power.

name: 43 Kinderen
en: 43 Kinderen is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Zes cirkelelementen
en: Zes cirkelelementen is the unofficial title of a group of sculptures in Amsterdam-West.

name: Poorten van Noord
en: Poorten van Noord or De 7 poorten is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The artwork was designed by Margit Lukács and Persijn Broersen. It was erected during the construction of the Noorderpark metro station on the North/South line.

name: 8 Decembermonument
en: The 8 Decembermonument is a monument in Amsterdam-Centrum. The monument was unveiled on 8 December 1992 at the tenth commemoration of the December murders of 8 December 1982 at Fort Zeelandia in Suriname. It consists of a plaque placed on the southern side wall of the Mozes en Aäronkerk on the Mr. Visserplein.

name: Abri en peperbus
en: Abri en peperbus is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is placed on the Van Limburg Stirumplein in the Staatsliedenbuurt. The work by Frank Halmans consists of two parts, a tram shelter and a pepperpot.

name: Schelpvorm
en: Schelpvorm is an abstract artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer. The non-figurative sculpture by Joop Hollanders stands at the intersection of the Kruislaan and the Radioweg. The work also shows Hollanders' signature; it consists of bodies pushed into and over each other, which are also attached to each other here.

name: Ode aan een gladde iep
en: Ode aan een gladde iep is a temporary artistic artwork, intended as such, in the Westerpark. It is the work of Dirk Versluis.

name: Aldo van Eyck aan het Bertelmanplein
en: Aldo van Eyck aan het Bertelmanplein is an overview of play equipment that the architect Aldo van Eyck designed for the Bertelmanplein in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Alle eendjes zwemmen in het water
en: Alle eendjes zwemmen in het water is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a creation by artist René Nijssen from 1975, according to the signature on the statue. Nijssen had then just traded abstract expressionism for a more figurative style.

name: Alliantiewapen Oranje-Nassau en Waldeck-Pyrmont
en: The Alliantiewapen Oranje-Nassau en Waldeck-Pyrmont is a relief in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is one of the many sculptures that adorn the facades of Amsterdam Centraal station. It was installed during construction; it dates from the period 1881 to 1889, when the station was being built.

name: Amelia (Chris Schraven)
en: Amelia, colloquially known as Meisje met skippybal, is an artistic artwork standing in the Tweede Weteringsplantsoen, Amsterdam-Centrum. Chris Schraven made this statue to mark the completion of a renovation of the Marnixbad.

name: Amphitrite (kunstwerk)
en: The artwork Amphitrite is a bronze group of statues and fountain on the KNSM-eiland in Amsterdam-Oost, made by Albert Termote in 1956 for the Koninklijke Nederlandse Stoomboot-Maatschappij (KNSM). Amphitrite is the name of a Greek sea goddess. Most KNSM ships had names drawn from Greek or Roman mythology.

name: Amsterdam Oersoep
en: Amsterdam Oersoep is a large public artwork in the Beurspassage in Amsterdam. It came about in 2016, when the building at Damrak 70-79 was thoroughly renovated on commission from owner Bouwinvest and partly given new tenants. The low, dark passage was raised and richly decorated with an enormous total artwork.

name: An outcast sanctuary
en: An outcast sanctuary is an artistic artwork placed in Amsterdam-Oost, Zeeburgereiland. On that island, a large skate park with all kinds of slopes etc. was built from 2018 to 2020. In 2018, the artist duo Iris Roskam and Arno Coenen were commissioned to fill the 'blind walls' with tableaux.

name: Anachoreoo
en: Anachoreoo is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a construction by artist Berend Strik and is placed in/above Park Frankendael. Strik was inspired by follies, a common phenomenon in the 18th and 19th centuries at country estates.

name: André Hazes (Frankey)
en: André Hazes was a statue in Amsterdam-Centrum. In 2020, artist Street Art Frankey had a statue of André Hazes placed. It was one of the larger statues by Street Art Frankey, who is known in Amsterdam for his small artworks that brighten up the cityscape.

name: Engel des doods (Fred Carasso)
en: De Engel des doods is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer. Sculptor Fred Carasso made his bronze rendering of the Engel des doods, also called Geest van de dood, in 1955. Over the years the work has been largely invisible; it hung on the back of the hall of the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery.

name: Angstig konijn
en: Angstig konijn, colloquially known as Angsthaas, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artist himself calls it Anxiety rabbit. Between 2000 and 2019, the Appelsap Fresh Music Festival organised an annual hip-hop festival in the Flevopark in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Animeertegels
en: Animeertegels is an educational artwork from 2001 in Amsterdam-Oost. The work was devised by Kees Aafjes and is incorporated into the pavement of the Eikenplein, Oosterparkbuurt. The artwork consists of a kind of barcode of composite concrete, which marks out the play area of the schoolchildren.

name: Ankh (Peter van de Locht)
en: Ankh is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue is placed on the northwestern embankment of the Wiegbrug and was installed after a complete renewal of this bridge in the period 1988-1990. Ankh is an ancient Egyptian symbol for life and/or immortality. The four-metre-high statue is by artist Peter van de Locht.

name: Anne Frank Mural
en: The Anne Frank Mural is a temporary artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. On the Amstelcampus of the Hogeschool van Amsterdam, at the intersection of the Wibautstraat and the Mauritskade, a small pumping-station building has stood on the Rhijnspoorplein since 1982, which served until 2008.

name: Apen aan tafel
en: Apen aan tafel is a form of art in public space in Amsterdam-West. Around the turn of the millennium, around 2000, parts of the Zeeheldenbuurt were thoroughly renovated. This included the installation of at least two artworks in public space; they share a theme: a table to talk around.

name: Argus (Saske van der Eerden)
en: Argus is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is the work of artist Saske van der Eerden.

name: Armonia
en: Armonia (Harmoniafontein) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. This relatively small fountain with drinking water was designed by Inti Hernandez (1976), originally from Cuba but living and working from Amsterdam since 2005.

name: Arthur van Schendel (Wertheim)
en: Arthur van Schendel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. On 5 March 1952, the portrait bust of Arthur van Schendel, made by Jobs Wertheim, was unveiled. The unveiling took place in the southern part of the Leidsebosje. Van Schendel's widow, a son and a granddaughter, as well as an alderman, were present.

name: Atleet en vrouwenfiguur
en: Atleet en vrouwenfiguur are two artworks in Amsterdam-Zuid. Both hardstone statues stand at the main entrance (marathon gate) of the Olympic Stadium. At the opening of the stadium they stood in their current place, but over the years they were moved, and in 2006 they returned to their original place.

name: Autoprikker
en: De Autoprikker is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a creation by Street Art Frankey and, alongside his Eberhard van der Laan, is his second official work in public space. Frankey places weekly semi-permanent small artworks in Amsterdam on his own initiative, to add some colour to the monotonous streetscape.

name: De baadster
en: De baadster is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sculptor Hildo Krop had not yet become city sculptor of Amsterdam when the "zwembad Marnix" (colloquially Marnixbad) was built on the Marnixplein to a design by Jan Leupen.

name: Bacchus (Frankendael)
en: Bacchus is an artistic artwork in Park Frankendael, Amsterdam-Oost. It is a hardstone statue of Bacchus, god of wine. The maker is unknown. The statue is said to have been placed when Jan Gildemeester lived here from 1759. In 1779 the estate passed to his son Jan Gildemeester Jansz.

name: Neptunus, Amphitrite en Arion
en: Neptunus, Amphitrite en Arion is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Bandenboot
en: The Bandenboot is an art object from 1974 by Robert Jasper Grootveld (1932-2009) in the Oostelijke Eilanden district of Amsterdam. The work was made on commission from the Amsterdam municipality as a play structure for children, and comprises 225 car tyres held together by chains. Initially it stood on the Wittenburg.

name: Banpaal Spaarnwouderdijk
en: The Banpaal Spaarnwouderdijk is a ban post (boundary marker) from 1624, which has stood since then on the Spaarndammerdijk outside Amsterdam. The post had just been placed when Rembrandt van Rijn recorded this obelisk-like post on one of his trips, near a farm. He sketched the whole post, but beheaded it in the final etching Landschap met een obelisk.

name: De barmhartige Samaritaan (Gert ten Wolde)
en: De barmhartige Samaritaan is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The Sint Lucas Ziekenhuis on the Jan Tooropstraat commissioned the statue in 1985 from artist G.J. ten Wolde (Gert ten Wolde from Franeker). The statue is meant to refer to the Good Samaritan from the parable of the same name.

name: Batman en Robin
en: Batman en Robin is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. These Batman and Robin are by artist Stef Vedder. In 2006 he made two statues of super cows, as the artist himself describes them. The 2006 version consisted of likenesses of Superman and Spiderman.

name: Baubles parade
en: The Baubles parade is a collection of artworks placed in the Beatrixpark, Amsterdam-Zuid. A bauble is actually a Christmas bauble. They are the remnants of a collection of balls with mosaics applied to them, which could be seen on the Museumplein in 2012, 2013 and 2014.

name: Totem today
en: Totem today is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It consists of several marble columns bearing texts which, according to artist Jennifer Tee, refer to milestones in human history and to the expectation of the near future, with the (apparent) contrast between technology and spirituality.

name: Beeld in drie delen
en: Beeld in drie delen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The artwork is by artist Leo de Vries from 1965. At the time he made all kinds of untitled statues, such as Compositie and Beeld in tien delen.

name: Terreinplastiek
en: In the Erasmuspark in Amsterdam-West stands a Terreinplastiek by Renze Hettema. The abstract statue from 1972 is made of a three-part plinth of basalt. On it rests a bronze sculpture that balances between the parts of the plinth. It measures 280 by 250 by 135 centimetres.

name: Standbeeld voor F.M. Wibaut
en: The Standbeeld voor F.M. Wibaut is a bronze statue by Han Wezelaar, standing in Amsterdam-Oost. In 1959 the Amsterdam municipality commissioned Wezelaar to make a statue of Floor Wibaut. On 24 June of that year the city council released 60,000 guilders for a statue. Making it took a considerable amount of time.

name: Het beest (beeld)
en: Het beest is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The stone statue by Nel van Lith can be found near the rose garden of the Eendrachtspark, in the section between De Savornin Lohmanstraat and Burgemeester Röellstraat. This part of the park consists of a grass field with a strict rectangular pattern of paths.

name: Behind the rainbow
en: Behind the rainbow is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist is Judith de Leeuw (JDL Street Art), who used artificial intelligence for it.

name: Berm bunnies
en: The Berm bunnies are an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Westpoort. The Port of Amsterdam wanted to break up the monotony of the Nieuwe Hemweg, and in particular of the cycle route Amsterdam-Zaanstad that runs alongside it, with an artwork.

name: De beschermster van de sociale zorg en gerechtigheid
en: De beschermster van de sociale zorg en gerechtigheid is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The Rijksverzekeringbank moved into its building at Apollolaan 15 in Amsterdam in 1939.

name: Beursmannetje
en: Beursmannetje, official title De krantlezende man, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue by Pieter d'Hont travelled a route through the city before arriving at its spot in 2012. d'Hont designed it in 1964/1965 for the centenary of Het Financieele Dagblad.

name: Big talk
en: Big talk is an artwork by Wim Poppinga. It is found at one of the entrances of the Amstelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. In 2007, after a renovation, the park received all kinds of entrance gates, for which artists were enlisted. Wim Poppinga produced a striking gate, set in a kind of Herashekwerk.

name: Het groeiend monument
en: Het groeiend monument (Bijlmerramp) or Bijlmermonument is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Every year on 4 October, the Bijlmer disaster is commemorated at the monument. Until 2023, a separate foundation, Stichting Beheer Het Groeiend Monument, set up for the purpose, was responsible for the monument.

name: Bioom (Yasser Ballemans)
en: Bioom is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is partly applied art.

name: Birth of change
en: Birth of change is an artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos. The artwork stands in the municipality of Amstelveen, to which the park belongs, but its management and so on are handled by the municipality of Amsterdam. The artwork was (partly) designed by artist Serge Verheugen, who supplied several objects for the forest, together called Family ties.

name: Blauwe boog
en: De Blauwe boog is a steel sculpture in Amsterdam, Osdorp. It is an abstract work with a geometric form by artist Cyril Lixenberg. The work dates from around 1990 and is said to represent a gateway to the Osdorp district.

name: Bloemsilhouetten
en: Bloemsilhouetten is the unofficial name for a number of murals in Amsterdam-West. In the 1980s a number of homes in social housing were built in the Kop van Jut neighbourhood, also an unofficial name for the Marcanti neighbourhood. The homes were designed by Sier van Rhijn and executed in brown and white tones.

name: Boerderij bij Duivendrecht (muurschildering)
en: Boerderij bij Duivendrecht is an artistic artwork in Duivendrecht, municipality of Ouder-Amstel. At the beginning of the 1970s, Duivendrecht got a neighbourhood with blocks of flats that show similarities to the (honeycomb) flats in Amsterdam Zuidoost.

name: Zonder titel (Herman Makkink)
en: On the grounds of the former Westergasfabriek in Amsterdam-West stands an untitled artistic artwork by Herman Makkink. Colloquially it is called Bolbewoners. The work from 2003/2004 came after a free commission from Kathryn Gustafson of Mecanoo, who was responsible for the redesign of the factory grounds.

name: Bolgewas (Paul Koning)
en: Bolgewas is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Bomen, bloemen en planten in vier jaargetijden
en: Bomen, bloemen en planten in vier jaargetijden is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Boogconstructie (kunstwerk)
en: Boogconstructie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Piet Slegers made the abstract statue for the location of the municipal energy company (GEB) in Amsterdam, which operated from Spaklerweg 20-26. The site was then situated south of the grounds of the Zuidergasfabriek. Slegers came up with a steel arch construction.

name: Boom van Hippocrates
en: De Boom van Hippocrates is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bright blue statue stands in the Corfuplantsoen in the residential neighbourhood Middelveldsche Akerpolder (De Aker Oost). Artist Adriaan Rees was inspired by the plane tree of Hippocrates, where the Greek Hippocrates of Kos is said to have taught his pupils.

name: Boomstronken
en: Boomstronken - wortels is a form of art in public space in Amsterdam-Oost. It was designed by Barbara Recourt (visual artist) and Fons Broess (mechanical engineer, industrial designer). The multi-part artwork falls under the category of applied art within the Amsterdam Science Park.

name: Boot (Jan Kuipers)
en: Boot is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The Frisian artist Jan Kuipers (1943-2014) was asked in 1977 to design a statue for the Bijlmerweide park, which had just been laid out and opened. Several artists designed statues for that park.

name: Borduurbloemen XL
en: Borduurbloemen XL is an artistic artwork on the Weesperstraat in Amsterdam. In the open space of the municipality of Amsterdam, works in the category Art in public space can be found in all kinds of places. This art comes in all kinds of types, sizes and expressions, from classical statues to 21st-century light installations.

name: Borstplaat (kunstwerk)
en: Borstplaat and De gestreelde borst are fictional names for a relief in Amsterdam-Centrum. The image lies in the paving of the Oudekerksplein at the side of the Oude Kerk. On the copper tile are two breasts and a hand that grabs one of them.

name: Bos Peel
en: Bos Peel is an artistic artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos on the territory of the municipality of Amstelveen, but managed by the municipality of Amsterdam. In the place, just north of the Bosbaan, stood a statue by Gabriel Lester from 2016, which fell victim to vandalism in 2018.

name: Boulderblok Universum
en: The Boulderblok Universum is a structure on the grounds of the Amsterdam Science Park, Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Brains (Rooymans)
en: Brains is an artistic artwork on the Derkinderenstraat in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work is by Ron Rooymans and/or Jorien Rooijmans-de Kruyff van Dorssen.

name: Beeldenroute Brettensuite
en: Beeldenroute Brettensuite is a sculpture trail on the Brettenpad, a cycling and walking route between the Westerpark in Amsterdam-West and Halfweg, largely situated in the Lange Bretten. The sculpture trail consists of 20 sculptures by Herbert Nouwens.

name: Virtual fountains
en: Virtual fountains is a three-part artistic artwork (spring, waterfall and fountain) in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Brugknuffel
en: Brugknuffel is a sculpture by Herman van der Heide. The concrete artwork from 1962 forms part of the southern railing and balustrade of the Sloterbrug between Amsterdam and Badhoevedorp, over the ring canal of the Haarlemmermeer. The bridge is located within the municipality of Haarlemmermeer.

name: Buitenstebinnen
en: Buitenstebinnen is a series of murals by artist Dewy Elsinga in the entrances of the Parkeergarage Marnix in Amsterdam. In 2021 construction began on the Parkeergarage Marnix under the Singelgracht. The garage was built by Mobilis TBI on commission from the Amsterdam municipality.

name: Buizenkolom
en: The Buizenkolom is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. This presumably untitled work by André Volten was placed in 1968 at the Merkelbach School, which had then been open for two years. The school on the Arent Janszoon Ernststraat had to accommodate a surplus of pupils due to population growth in Buitenveldert.

name: Bullebak (beeld)
en: De Bullebak is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The name goes back to a monster said to pull children into the water, and gives its name to two bridges, both on the Marnixstraat. At the northern end, over the offshoot of the Bloemgracht, lies the Bullebakssluis. The bridges are often mixed up.

name: Buurttafel Ambonplein
en: Buurttafel Ambonplein is an artistic artwork standing on the Ambonplein, Amsterdam-Oost. The Zeeburg district wanted to bring communities closer together in its neighbourhoods and had neighbourhood tables placed for that purpose. A concrete neighbourhood table was placed on the Ambonplein. Wooden examples were placed elsewhere, such as the Verzonken tafel.

name: Capriccio (Ronald Tolman)
en: Capriccio is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The statue, several metres high, stands on the Oostenburgergracht, where the Oostenburgervoorstraat meets the canal.

name: Cascade Vondelpark
en: Cascade, or Écriture sur l'eau, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, Vondelpark. The statue is a remnant of a sculpture exhibition held in 1965 to celebrate 100 years of the Vondelpark. The exhibition was put together by Willem Sandberg of the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam.

name: Ceres (Frankendael)
en: Ceres (met korenschoof) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Park Frankendael. It is a hardstone statue of Ceres, goddess of arable farming. The maker is unknown. The statue is said to have been placed when Jan Gildemeester lived here from 1759. In 1779 the estate passed to his son Jan Gildemeester Jansz.

name: Charlotte (Zittend naakt)
en: Charlotte, the nameplate reads Zittend naakt, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue by Hans Sassen (1939) dates from the mid-1970s. Sassen made the statue to comply with the Beeldende Kunstenaars Regeling.

name: Kindermonument Markt voor Joden
en: The Kindermonument Markt voor Joden (also known as Samen spelen, samen leven) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a three-part group of statues by Truus Menger-Oversteegen, standing since 1986 at the entrance to the playground on the Gaaspstraat.

name: Choreografie in staal
en: Choreografie in staal is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a creation by Margot Zanstra, who here combined two important things for her: dance and sculpture. She was first a ballerina with the Nationaal Ballet, but from 1966 devoted herself to the visual arts.

name: Zonder titel (Dik Box, Amsterdam-Zuidoost)
en: At the intersection of the Reigersbosdreef and the Meerkerkdreef in Amsterdam-Zuidoost stands an untitled work by Dik Box, who describes himself as Universal Moving Artists. The artwork, a kinetic object, is a circular construction of three aluminium circles and stands in the small park on the roundabout at that intersection.

name: Closer in distance
en: Closer in distance is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Since 2016, Amsterdam has had the HIV/AIDS monument by Jean-Michel Othoniel, standing on the De Ruijterkade. It had barely stood for five years when the municipality of Amsterdam had to carry out work on this quay of the IJ; a new ferry pier had to be built.

name: Communicatie (Lotti van der Gaag)
en: Communicatie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Lotti van der Gaag was asked to brighten up the entrance of the Telefooncentrale Amsterdam-Slotervaart on the Plesmanlaan with a sculpture.

name: Complex form
en: Complex form is a three-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Compositie (De Vries)
en: Compositie, also referred to as Rustende figuur, is a sculpture by Leo de Vries standing in Amsterdam-Oost. The sculpture, made of French limestone (vaurion), is placed in the Galileïplantsoen. At a length of 2.5, a width of 0.65 and a height of 1.6 metres, it is a striking presence in an open grass field.

name: Compositie van tien elementen
en: Compositie van tien elementen is a form of art in public space in Amsterdam-Noord. In the 1960s the Banne Buiksloot neighbourhood was built, with streets and squares named after concepts from shipping. The park was given the name Koopvaardersplantsoen, after the merchant navy.

name: Constructie (Shlomo Koren)
en: Constructie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The artist Shlomo Koren was asked to design a statue during the laying out of the Bijlmerpark (renamed Nelson Mandelapark in 2014).

name: Constructie in DIN 20
en: Constructie in DIN 20 is an artistic artwork standing in the Siegerpark, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The abstract statue by André Volten has been part of the sculpture park of said park since 1998.

name: Compositie voor een tuin
en: Compositie voor een tuin is an artistic artwork placed in the Siegerpark, Riekerpolder, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue by Shamaï Haber has been part of the sculpture garden of said park since 1998. Unlike the other statues that stand prominently along the paths, Compositie voor een tuin stands in the bushes.

name: Constructie H-Balk DIN 30
en: The Constructie H-Balk DIN 30 is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The creation by artist André Volten has stood since 1968 in the Sloterpark, in the section on the east side of the Sloterplas, on the Oostoever street. The artwork consists of three constructions made of welded H-profiles.

name: Crystal growth
en: Crystal growth is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. Housing association Stadgenoot issued commissions for filling the grounds at Eerste Constantijn Huygensstraat 36, where the Jan Swammerdam Institute stood until 2004. The site was filled in sections.

name: Curiosity 2015
en: Curiosity 2015 is a composite mural in Amsterdam-West. According to the Street Art Museum Amsterdam, it is a combination of two styles of street art, placed on the blank facade of the building at Douwes Dekkerstraat 16, Amsterdam.

name: Daarom moet ik wenen
en: Daarom moet ik wenen (Al ela ani bochea) or Uittocht der Joden is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Oost. The facade sculpture by Wessel Couzijn was placed in 1950 during the construction of the complex on the south-western side of the President Brandstraat, at house number 76. Couzijn placed a laden man, woman and child on a sloping pedestal.

name: Nationaal Dachau Monument
en: The Nationaal Dachau Monument is a Dutch memorial to the Dutch victims of the Dachau concentration camp. It is located in the Amsterdamse Bos, opposite the former grandstand of the Bosbaan, and is an initiative of the Nederlands Dachau Comité.

name: Dagboekfragment uit Het Achterhuis
en: Dagboekfragment uit Het Achterhuis is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a war memorial in memory of Anne Frank. This enormous mural is the work (design and execution) of artist Harry Visser.

name: Dansende beer
en: Dansende beer is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Dansende beer can be seen on the front facade of the building at Derde Oosterparkstraat 159. The first building at that address dates from around 1888. In the 1970s and 1980s, large-scale demolition took place around that address, and for a long time a gap between the new buildings could be seen on this spot.

name: Gouden figuur
en: Gouden figuur or Danser is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The statue is a creation of artist Henk Visch, whose main theme is movement. This statue is also an example of that. It is placed on an apartment building at the Johanna ter Meulenplein in Amsterdam, which borders the Singelgracht on its south side.

name: Danseres met tamboerijn
en: Danseres met tamboerijn is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The work by Fioen Blaisse has stood since 2000 in a small park in front of a former school building at the corner of the Purmerweg and Schermerstraat (school building number 3-19). Blaisse wanted her dancer to convey tension and concentration.

name: Dapperburen
en: Dapperburen (spelled DapperBuren) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Dapperbuurt. The work from 2011 consists of nineteen silhouettes of neighbourhood residents; they are (or were) the neighbours of artist Dorette Evers.

name: DDT666
en: DDT666 is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. According to the municipality of Amsterdam, it is one of the oldest forms of graffiti in Amsterdam. The small mural was made in 1978 by Ivar Vičs, alias Dr. Rat. Vičs had started the punk club DDT with Diana Ozon.

name: De boekenkast
en: De Boekenkast is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. The artwork consists of a gigantic bookcase built into the outer wall of the De Batavier complex on the Lootsstraat (above the front door of house number 34).

name: De beschermer en handhaver van de sociale wetgeving
en: De beschermer en handhaver van de sociale wetgeving is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The Rijksverzekeringsbank moved into its building at Apollolaan 15 in 1939.

name: Bokkenrijder (beeld)
en: De Bokkenrijder (originally "de bokkerijder") is a bronze statue by Gerrit Bolhuis. The statue is placed in the Oosterpark in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue, a boy on a billy goat, was meant to attract young people to sit behind the boy on the goat.

name: De boom valt op mij
en: De boom valt op mij (also known as Er is een hoek in de kamer) is a memorial in Amsterdam-West.

name: De bouwvakarbeider
en: De Bouwvakarbeider, or De bouwvakker, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bronze statue on a brick plinth stands in a strip of greenery beside the junction of the Burgemeester De Vlugtlaan and the Burgemeester Eliasstraat. It is a work by Jan Havermans from 1962.

name: De Bretten
en: De Bretten is a signpost and name board. In 2021 the municipality of Amsterdam wanted to put the nature park Lange Bretten more firmly on the map as a recreation area in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The park is an elongated strip of greenery. To that end, the municipality had an extremely large name board placed by the firm Blowups, to its own design.

name: De brouwers
en: De brouwers is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: De Buurt Optimist
en: De Buurt Optimist is a memorial in Amsterdam-Oost in memory of neighbourhood resident Diana Gemert. The bronze artwork was made in 2023 by visual artist Sarah van Sonsbeeck.

name: De dag (Hildo Krop)
en: De dag is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue dates from the years 1933 to 1937 and belongs to the oeuvre of Hildo Krop. He made De dag for the eye clinic of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis. That building stands on the south side of the WG-Plein. Krop depicted a woman kneeling in a field with a bird in her hand.

name: De doos
en: De doos is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, Buitenveldert. The designer of the statue, which is many metres high, is Jeroen Henneman. The work resembles earlier results of his treatment of the theme of the box. Henneman's earlier box statues are smaller: Doos 2 from 1996 is 75 cm high.

name: De droom van een hond
en: De droom van een hond (A happy dog from Baghdad) is a mosaic in Amsterdam-West.

name: Menselijke energie
en: De Menselijke energie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It forms half of a set of four stacked statue groups and collages from the period 1921-1924 by Hildo Krop. In that period two school buildings rose on the Jozef Israëlskade, a Hogere Burgerschool and a Handelsschool, which were separated by the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat.

name: De geboorte van de daad
en: De geboorte van de daad is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It forms half of a set of four stacked statue groups and collages from the period 1921-1924 by Hildo Krop. In that period two school buildings rose on the Jozef Israëlskade, a Hogere Burgerschool and a Handelsschool, which were separated by the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat.

name: Fusillade (Gerrit Bolhuis)
en: Fusillade, also known as De gevallen hoornblazer, is a bronze statue on the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis. Here, on 12 March 1945, the German army shot thirty political prisoners as a reprisal for an act of resistance.

name: Bobby Haarms, De goede beul
en: Bobby Haarms, De goede beul is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost in honour of Bobby Haarms (1934-2009), a footballer and football coach.

name: De hechtsteek
en: De hechtsteek is an artwork in Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid. It consists of three ribbon-shaped blue plastic sculptures by Jan Jacobs Mulder. They stand on the De Boelelaan by the VUMC, which has been partly built over the De Boelelaan.

name: De hongerwinter
en: De hongerwinter is a war memorial on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is about the Hunger Winter of 1944/1945. It exists in two versions. The original, by Hildo Krop, was placed in the Oosterkerk. It was first fitted on the street side, but over the years it was eroded by weather and soot deposits.

name: De kleine kameleon
en: De kleine kameleon is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is in fact a collection of artworks from 2008 and 2009, made by Kurdish artist Hoshyar Rasheed to mark the completion of a renovation of the Gerbrandypark. The Stadsdeel Geuzenveld-Slotermeer had asked for it.

name: De knoop
en: De knoop is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The name, which has been in circulation for years, refers to an originally untitled work by André Volten. The metres-tall statue is an elaboration of an essentially simple idea: it is a border marker and at the same time a link between Amsterdam-Noord and the IJ.

name: De kunstenaar en de muze
en: De kunstenaar en de muze is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It consists of two bronze reliefs by Frits van Hall. They were placed around 1927 on the side of the entrance of the Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten, which was then still located at Stadhouderskade 86.

name: De kus (Amsterdam)
en: De kus is a stainless steel artwork by Jeroen Henneman. It was designed at the request of Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer for placement at its new head office on the Bijlmerdreef in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It was completed in 1982.

name: De mensch, de stof opwekkend en beheerschend
en: De mensch, de stof opwekkend en beheerschend is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. Theo van Reijn made the statue in 1932 to beautify the facade of the chemistry laboratory building of the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam on De Lairessestraat. The statue is made of tuff stone.

name: De moor, de dame en haar hondje
en: De moor, de dame en haar hondje is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artwork comes from the artist duo Berkman and Janssens at the time, Margot Berkman and Eline Janssens. The commission for the work came from ProRail Amsterdam, which faced an entrance in a dead corner on the De Ruijterkade.

name: De Muur (kunstwerk)
en: De Muur is an artwork in public space in Amsterdam-Noord. It is a creation by Alfred Eikelenboom (1936-2014), who worked on it from 1984 to 1986. In 1987 it was placed on a small field at the IJplein, between the Meeuwenlaan and the Gedempte Insteekhaven.

name: De nacht (Hildo Krop)
en: De nacht is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue dates from the years 1933 to 1937 and belongs to the oeuvre of Hildo Krop. He made De nacht for the eye clinic of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis. That building stands on the south side of the WG-Plein. Krop depicted a pair of roe deer with an owl on a tree branch above them.

name: De oogst (Jan Heyens)
en: De oogst (Jan Heyens) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a facade stone designed by Jan Heyens, placed on the housing complex De Dageraad in Amsterdam. That complex is by Michel de Klerk and Piet Kramer, who designed it in a quirky form of the Amsterdam School.

name: Poort van Constant
en: De Poort van Constant is an artistic artwork, monument and sculptural sign at the entrance to the Ookmeer sports park on the Troelstralaan, at/over the Herman Bonpad in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. In 2024 it is regarded as a crossover between architecture and visual art.

name: De ratelaar
en: De ratelaar is a bronze statue in Amsterdam Oud-West. The work by Rob Cerneüs has stood on the Kwakersplein since 2007 and carries the following inscription: "Ode aan de vuinisman, 130 jaar reiniging 1877-2007".

name: Reus van Bickerseiland
en: De Reus van Bickerseiland is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The maker of the original statue is unknown (anonymous, possibly a shipwright), but the image is centuries old. The original statue stood on the Bickerseiland, named after Jan Bicker.

name: De scheepstimmerman (Johan Polet)
en: De scheepstimmerman is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The sculptor Johan Polet received the commission in 1954 from the municipality of Amsterdam. After the Second World War, Polet had fallen out of favour because he had been a member of the Kultuurraad.

name: De Scheppende Hand & Chaos
en: De Scheppende Hand & Chaos are two artistic artworks in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: De schoone stad aan het IJ
en: De schoone stad aan het IJ is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It consists of two murals by the artist Moos Cohen. In 1940 he was commissioned by the municipality of Amsterdam to make two murals for the Dienst Stadsreiniging on the Bilderdijkkade. After the building was demolished in 2003, the panels were stored for a time.

name: De sleutel ligt onder de deurmat
en: De sleutel ligt onder de deurmat is an artistic doormat in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. At the request of housing corporation Stadgenoot and in collaboration with LEVS Architecten, Martijn Sandberg designed this artwork, 12 by 3 by 23 metres, in the period 2008-2010. It seems big and conspicuous, yet the artwork is hard to find.

name: De spiraal
en: De spiraal is an artistic artwork in Diemen. The statue dates from 2003 and was designed by Alex Vermeulen. From a pond in an empty space at a traffic junction (Provincialeweg and Weesperstraat), a steel spiral bores counterclockwise into the sky. At its end stands a person.

name: De stam
en: De stam is a five-part artistic artwork or group of statues in Amsterdam-West. It is (partly) applied art. The title refers to two meanings: the tree trunk, and the volksstammen (tribes) who worked here for the growing Amsterdam.

name: De Titaantjes
en: De Titaantjes, or Hommage aan Nescio, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a tribute to the writer Nescio by sculptor Hans Bayens. More statues of writers by Bayens are known: he portrayed Multatuli at the Torensluis, and Aagje Deken and Betje Wolff stand at Nes aan de Amstel.

name: De trap (beeld)
en: De trap (2016-2017) is a composite artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Steffen Maas came up with a staircase of bluestone that takes you from one place to another. In his words, "From A to B, from origin to destination, from memory to expectation, from aversion to rapprochement." The staircase itself creates expectation.

name: De verdwenen boer
en: De verdwenen boer is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. Twenty years after the redesign of Molenwerf from station square to "normal street", the statue De verdwenen boer by Karel Gomes was placed around 2005.

name: De vlam
en: De vlam is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue was designed by artist Edith ten Kate (1917-1995), who designed it for the Andreas Ziekenhuis. The statue, made by A. Binder Bronsgieterij, could according to experts be categorised as organic abstract.

name: De Vredesraket
en: De Vredesraket (also Vredesbeeld 21 november 1981) was a sculpture by the Yugoslav artist Slavomir Miletić, which stood on the Museumplein in Amsterdam from 1981 to 1995.

name: De vrijheid van de gedachte
en: De vrijheid van de gedachte is a statue by artist Hildo Krop.

name: De wachter (Boris Tellegen)
en: De wachter is a statue designed by Boris Tellegen in Amsterdam-Zuid, which watches over and waits by a local children's campus. In 2016 the statue was placed in its permanent location on the Antonio Vivaldistraat in Amsterdam-Zuid at the Zuidas.

name: Monument voor Joodse dove oorlogsslachtoffers
en: Het Monument voor Joodse Dove Oorlogsslachtoffers is a memorial on the Hortusplantsoen in Amsterdam for deaf and hard-of-hearing Jewish victims of the Second World War. It came about on the initiative of the Stichting Dovenshoah and was unveiled on 17 October 2010.

name: De werken van barmhartigheid (beeldengroep)
en: De werken van barmhartigheid is a group of statues in Amsterdam-Centrum. Artist Tineke Smith designed a group of statues for the diaconie of the Protestantse Gemeente in Amsterdam at Nieuwe Herengracht 16 (Corvershof), drawing on Matthew 25.

name: De worstelaars
en: De worstelaars is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The sculpture was designed by Hans IJdo. He created two (floating) wrestlers in bronze, locked in a fight. One of the wrestlers already lies on his back but holds the arms of the one above him in check. According to some, it stands for wrestling with life.

name: Sierklinkerwerk Gravenstraat
en: Het Sierklinkerwerk Gravenstraat is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. To view the artwork, you must stare at the ground. For centuries the Gravenstraat, together with the Eggerstraat, has formed the northeastern site boundary of the Amsterdam.

name: Demeure 4
en: Demeure 4 (Lanleff) is an artistic artwork standing in the Siegerpark, Riekerpolder, Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Keesje, het diakenhuismannetje
en: Keesje, het diakenhuismannetje is an artwork standing in the Siegerpark, Riekerpolder, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue by Jan Bronner has been part of the sculpture park of the said park since 1998.

name: Dikke vrindjes
en: Dikke vrindjes is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue stands at the residential care complex for the elderly De Open Hof on Fahrenheitstraat 115 in De Wetbuurt, Watergraafsmeer. The elderly complex had just undergone an extension. In 1985 a statue by Taeke Friso de Jong was placed here.

name: Constructie staal DIN 20
en: Constructie staal DIN 20 is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The creation by artist André Volten stands on the Wiltzanghlaan (near house number 60). The work is made up of H-profiles. Volten experimented more often with these building components in the 1960s.

name: Diversity in bureaucracy
en: Diversity in bureaucracy is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artwork consists of two building-high murals by Judith de Leeuw, who was 26 years old at the time. Through the painting she wanted to point to class inequality and hidden racism as opposed to solidarity.

name: Diversity in one
en: Diversity in one is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord, originally in five parts. In the period from 1983 to 1987, a complex of the former Amsterdamsche Droogdok Maatschappij was changed from shipbuilding area into a residential neighbourhood.

name: Havenwerkers
en: Havenwerkers is the name of a group of sandstone statues that sculptor Hildo Krop originally made for placement at the building of the Koninklijke Hollandsche Lloyd in the Oostelijk Havengebied in Amsterdam.

name: Doe iets
en: Doe iets is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is an installation by Serge Verheugen. It is made of perforated metal angle profiles, which in 2005 were used in the lightly movable scaffold DOEIDOEI for Schiphol, to which an artwork was also attached. It was meant to wave off travellers with dozens of little hands.

name: Domicilie (beeld)
en: Domicilie is a multiple artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Artists Wouter de Baat and Dick Simonis were commissioned by the municipality of Amsterdam to brighten up the Holendrecht-West neighbourhood with an artwork.

name: Door zinloos geweld omgekomen
en: Door zinloos geweld omgekomen is one of the smaller war memorials in Amsterdam. The little monument is placed at the entrance of the elderly centre De Flesseman. It consists of a plaque a few centimetres wide and high, with a depth of a few millimetres.

name: Drie leeuwtjes
en: Drie leeuwtjes, or Leeuwen for short, is a three-part artistic artwork and play element in Amsterdam-Oost. The group of statues is designed by Alice Helenklaken of the artists' group Handle with Care. They are three stone lions, each lying in a different position in the open space belonging to the Leeuwenhoekstraat.

name: Drie pylonen
en: Drie pylonen is an artistic artwork in Molenwijk, Amsterdam-Noord. The neighbourhood was laid out at the end of the 1960s to a design by architect Klaas Geerts. In 1970 three stone pylons were placed for the Spinnekop flats by artist Ben Guntenaar. Buitenkunst Amsterdam described them as "marking in the landscape" or "gateway".

name: Zonder titel (Kees Bierman)
en: In and along the Dostojevskisingel in Amsterdam-Zuidoost lies a three-part untitled artistic and somewhat architectural artwork. It consists of three partly ruined ships designed by artist Kees Bierman (1936). It was assembled in 1988. In the singel, which functions as a canal, a wooden ship floats or stands, increasingly overgrown by local flora.

name: Drie zeilschepen
en: Drie zeilschepen is a mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Droombeeld
en: Droombeeld is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a work by Cephas Stauthamer, standing in the northern part of the Frederik Hendrikplantsoen, where it "guards" one of the entrances. It dates from 1965. Little is known about the work: an abstracted animal in bronze with its jaws wide open.

name: Dubbel glas (Marjet Wessels Boer)
en: Dubbel glas is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The work dates from 2011, when a number of buildings on the Van Noordtstraat were thoroughly renovated. Marjet Wessels Boer was then asked to make a design for the glass of the central stairwell. Wessels Boer came up with light-transmitting prints for the glass front of building no. 9.

name: Duik in de verbeelding
en: Duik in de verbeelding is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work dates from 2008 and is by Mario Molina Espeleta. It is applied to the business building Petersburg on the Frans de Wollantstraat, but it can be seen best as a whole from the entrance to the Funenpark.

name: Dwazen denken te beschermen
en: Dwazen denken te beschermen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. There are two versions, both by Berend Peter. The artist believed the object should be viewable from all sides without "the story" being lost, so it has no specific front, side or back.

name: Eberhard van der Laan (Frankey)
en: Eberhard van der Laan is a small artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work by Street Art Frankey came after a commission from pop venue Paradiso on the Weteringschans. That artist, known simply as Frankey, enlivened the Amsterdam streetscape in the early 21st century with all sorts of small art objects.

name: Ecologische voetafdruk (brugschildering)
en: Ecologische voetafdruk is a mural (street painting) in Amsterdam-Noord. What is special about this mural is that it is set horizontally, on the bridge deck of the Elsje Christiaensbrug over the Buiksloterkanaal.

name: Een groot teken
en: Een groot teken is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Een mens van water
en: Een mens van water is an artistic artwork and fountain in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue seems to stand out of context. In 2003 the new office of the Amsterdamse Waterleidingbedrijf opened here, in a building designed by Aat van Tilburg.

name: Een poort voor Oostpoort
en: Een poort voor Oostpoort, also known as Oostportaal, is a two-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Een transparante grens
en: Een transparante grens is a form of applied art in Amsterdam-Oost. In the Indische Buurt four squares meet: Obiplein, Ambonplein, Boniplein and a playground on the Sumatrastraat. The Ambonplein forms the hinge point within them.

name: Een vertaling, van de ene taal naar de andere
en: Een vertaling, van de ene taal naar de andere is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It comes from the hand of conceptual artist Lawrence Weiner. He was commissioned by the University of Amsterdam to make that university more visible in the city.

name: Eerbetoon Gliphoeve
en: Eerbetoon Gliphoeve is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost on the end gable of the Gravestein flats.

name: Eerste steen (Jouke Kleerebezem)
en: Eerste steen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. During the redevelopment of KNSM-eiland from harbour to residential area, among other things the Albertcomplex (1989-1993) by architect Bruno Albert was built. This housing complex was built around a central square with entrances on the Levantkade and KNSM-laan.

name: Gedenksteen Comenius
en: De Gedenksteen Comenius is a memorial stone set into the pavement of the Valeriusplein, Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies in the middle pavement towards the Het Amsterdams Lyceum. It was a so-called first stone; here it would also be the last stone. The early asylum seeker Jan Amos Comenius was on the run and came to live (and to die) in Amsterdam.

name: Energie en tijd
en: Energie en tijd is a wall sculpture from 1962 by artist Hans Verhulst. The sculpture of concrete and steel is located on a wall of the Marnixstraat substation bordering the Lauriergracht. The site of the object has been connected with energy since the start of Amsterdam's urban expansions.

name: Entree De Borcht
en: Entree De Borcht is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. To give the Amstelpark more visibility as an attraction park, the Zuideramstel borough invited five artists to make new entrances. These new entrances and exits had to be both functional and artistic.

name: Entree Rozenoordbrug
en: Entree Rozenoord is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. To give the Amstelpark more visibility as an attraction park, the Zuideramstel borough invited five artists to make new entrances. These new entrances and exits had to be both functional and artistic.

name: Erectus
en: Erectus is a group of statues standing in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a creation by Erwin de Vries from 1977, which since 1978 has stood in the inner courtyard of what was then the Gliphoeve flats. That flat was renamed Geldershoofd en Gravestein in 1984 because of its negative reputation.

name: Erotica (Erwin de Vries)
