en: Erotica is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Artist Erwin de Vries was commissioned by the municipality of Amsterdam around 1971 to make a sculpture for placement in a small park between the Jan Tooropstraat and the rear of the low-rise flats on the Jan Voermanstraat.

name: Europa (beeld)
en: Europa is a statue by Hans Kuyper. The statue dates from around 1995. Since 2005 it has stood in a small park near the Arend Westermanbrug (bridge 186), north-west of the place where the Postjeswetering and Admiralengracht meet. The main road along which the artwork can be seen is called the Postjesweg.

name: Familie (Paul de Reus)
en: Familie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a two-part group of statues and depicts a family (woman, man, daughter, son). Familie was designed by Paul de Reus. It dates from 2008 and was made on commission from the municipality of Amsterdam or the relevant borough. It stands in the north-western part of the Theo van Goghpark.

name: Familie Woezel
en: Familie Woezel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The creation by Marijke van Lis, standing in front of the Tjasker flats in Molenwijk, forms a (split) unit together with the Woezel in Zaanhof, Amsterdam-West. Following a larger Woezel (Woezelflat) shown at Floriade 1972 in 1972, the artist explained it.

name: Verwantschappen
en: Verwantschappen (Family ties) is an artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos. The group of eleven statues is by artist Serge Verheugen and dates from 2013/2014. Verheugen was inspired by the wood present in the forest.

name: Fata morgana (Iris Le Rütte)
en: Fata morgana is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It stands on a railway bridge over the Ringvaart van de Watergraafsmeer. The statue group was made by artist Iris Le Rütte and dates from 2005; they were unveiled on 9 September of that year.

name: Hekwerk Olympiaplein
en: Het Hekwerk Olympiaplein is an artistic artwork in the category of applied art in Amsterdam-Zuid. The elongated Olympiaplein in Amsterdam is for the most part used by Sportpark Olympiaplein. This sports park served as a training ground during the 1928 Summer Olympics.

name: Vruchtbaarheid (Jacques Jutte)
en: Vruchtbaarheid is a statue in Amsterdam by artist Jacques Jutte (1930). Since 1970 it has stood in the small park of the residential street Vreedenhaven, along the road Hoekenes, in the Osdorp neighbourhood of the Nieuw-West borough. This work by Jutte is a kind of triptych in geometric bronze forms, which also match in atmosphere.

name: Fête galante (Van den Ban)
en: Fête galante is a sculpture by Hans van den Ban from 1997, placed along the Weesperstraat and Nieuwe Kerkstraat in Amsterdam-Centrum. The title would refer to the painting term in which pleasure is the main element. The playfulness was needed because of the austere house and office blocks that rose here after a thorough clearance of the neighbourhood.

name: Figuren (Lex Horn)
en: Figuren is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. In the years 1960-1963 a school was built at Krelis Louwenstraat 1 for the Vereniging Hendrick de Keijserschool. It was to provide accommodation for the Uitgebreid Technisch Onderwijs; the school was a design by Arno Nicolaï.

name: Moederste
en: Moederste is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is work by Susanne Khalil Yusef (Germany, 1984), child of Palestinian refugees, trained at the St. Joost School of Art & Design. With this work Yusef reflected on the fiftieth anniversary of the House of Orange in the Bellamybuurt.

name: Drijvende Tuinen
en: Drijvende Tuinen are a group of five floating gardens in the Oostelijk Havengebied in Amsterdam, designed and built by artist Robert Jasper Grootveld.

name: Floating poetry room
en: Floating poetry room is an artwork from 2005 in Amsterdam-Oost. It was designed by the American artist Siah Armajani and produced by the Dutch artist Ben Raaijman. The artwork was funded from the art budget of the IJtram project, the construction of tram line 26, administered by the Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunsten (AFK).

name: De lente
en: De lente (colloquially Flora) is an artistic artwork in the Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a statue of Flora, goddess of spring. The statue was made with a subsidy from the municipality of Amsterdam, a support project during the interwar period to help artists somewhat during the crisis.

name: Fontein Haarlemmerplein
en: De Fontein Haarlemmerplein is a fountain placed in/on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam-Centrum. The fountain was placed after a new redesign of the square, following an earlier "touch-up" in the 1970s. Around 2010, after years of new building, a new northern edge was created to a design by architect Dick van Gameren, who thereby created a new northern edge.

name: Fontein Hogeweg
en: De Fontein Hogeweg is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Fontein Kolenkit
en: De Fontein Kolenkit is a fountain in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The fountain was placed in a spirit reflecting the continuous changes in this part of Amsterdam in the 21st century. In the Kolenkitbuurt a lot of buildings have been renovated or demolished and replaced by new construction.

name: Fontein met boegbeelden
en: Fontein met boegbeelden is the exact description of an artistic artwork standing on the Amsterdam Marineterrein, Kattenburg. The statue was placed thanks to the 1% scheme, under which 1% of the construction costs of new or restored buildings had to be spent on art in public space.

name: Fontein Wertheimpark
en: Fontein Wertheimpark is an artistic artwork in the Wertheimpark in Amsterdam-Centrum. It consists of a combination of a statue and a fountain. After entrepreneur and philanthropist Abraham Carel Wertheim died in 1897, a committee was formed within a few days to commemorate him, by means of a street named after him and a statue.

name: Fortuna (Pieter Starreveld)
en: (Vrouwe) Fortuna is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. In 1949 sculptor Pieter Starreveld made, for the Stoomvaart-Maatschappij Nederland (SMN), the war memorial Zeeman op de uitkijk, which was placed on Java-eiland. Not long afterwards, on the occasion of the SMN's eightieth anniversary, he made the statue Fortuna.

name: Fotokijkers
en: Fotokijkers, or Viewers, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is the work of artist Robin van 't Haar, who in his work often depicted people in their urban surroundings. He believed that this environment (open space) influenced people and therefore influenced the behaviour of those same people.

name: Fontein 's-Gravesandeplein
en: De Fontein 's-Gravesandeplein is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The 's-Gravesandeplein was almost completely redesigned at the start of the 21st century, with the demolition of older buildings and the subsequent new construction for the Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis.

name: Fontein Droogbak
en: Fontein Droogbak is a fountain in Amsterdam-Centrum. This small fountain was placed in 2000 to round off the restoration (and conversion) of Droogbak on the street of the same name in Amsterdam. The fountain was designed by architect Simon Sprietsma, working for the Dienst Ruimtelijke Ordening (Dienst Binnenstad).

name: Fontein Krugerplein
en: De Fontein Krugerplein is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. When the Krugerplein was redesigned around the turn of the century, two artists were asked to design an artwork for public space. Caro Bensca came up with Lady Solid and Peer Veneman with the fountain.

name: Fragment van een huiskamer
en: Fragment van een huiskamer (officially with the addition: reduced to 88%) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a statue from 2001 by Mark Manders, who at that time was working on a series of statues under the heading Zelfportret als gebouw (Self-Portrait as Building).

name: Franse bogen
en: Parijse bogen is a fictitious title of an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The artist Peter Diem had bought these arches from the remains of the Les Halles fish market in Paris, which was demolished in 1971. After restoring them, he gave them to the Gemeente Amsterdam, which placed them at the entrance of the W.H. Vliegenbos on the Meeuwenlaan.

name: Friends part 1
en: Friends part 1 is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum; the original was called Airhead nr. 1. The artist Nouch first put up this mural in 2019. She had already drawn murals in the form of an airhead (balloon head or balloon creature) on paper, but she also wanted to find them again at a larger scale.

name: Future past glory
en: Future past glory is a work by Liet Heringa and Maarten van Kalsbeek in Amsterdam-Zuid. The stainless steel statue, 8.5 metres wide and 5.30 metres high, stands in the Beatrixpark. It is a tribute to architect Ko Mulder, who worked at the Dienst der Publieke Werken from 1930 to 1965.

name: Gatekeepers
en: Gatekeepers is a group of statues in Amsterdam-Oost. The two statues come from the studio of artist Monika Dahlberg, who makes statues from recyclable material. According to Het Parool, her statues have already been found all over the world. Nevertheless, Gatekeepers also regularly go missing.

name: Gedenkraam Sociale Dienst
en: Het Gedenkraam Sociale Zaken, also known as Bevrijdingsraam, is a memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. The window was designed in 1945/1946 by Jan Grégoire for the Gemeentelijke Dienst voor Sociale Zaken in Amsterdam. It was placed in July 1946 in memory of civil servants of that department who lost their lives during the Second World War.

name: Gedenksteen Gerrit van der Veen
en: De Gedenksteen Gerrit van der Veen is a war memorial and artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The tableau is the work of Fred Carasso, who designed it in memory of artist and resistance fighter Gerrit van der Veen. Both had studios in the studio houses on the Zomerdijkstraat in the Rivierenbuurt.

name: Gedenksteen voor het voormalig Huis van Bewaring
en: De Gedenksteen voor het voormalig Huis van Bewaring, also called Gedenksteen 4 mei, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The sculpture was designed by architect Pieter Zaanen, who was responsible for the new building around 1990 at the Max Euweplein.

name: Gedenkteken De Leeuw
en: Gedenkteken De Leeuw consists of a relief set into a blind gable section on the Anne Frankstraat, Amsterdam-Centrum. The association building De Leeuw was located at Valkenburgerstraat 149.

name: Gedenkteken Gerard Reve
en: Het Gedenkteken Gerard Reve is a memorial in Amsterdam-West. The three-part artistic artwork (2006) in memory of Gerard Reve is by Margriet Kemper. For the Waterspiegelplein she came up with a fairly unobtrusive monument that blends entirely into its surroundings. The first part consists of a wooden bench, which offers a view to the east.

name: Gedenkteken Ir. Jakoba Mulder
en: Het Gedenkteken Ir. Jakoba Mulder is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work can be seen on the Ir. Jakoba Mulderplein; both are named after city architect Ko Mulder. The sculpture consists of three parts. First there is a round base plate of granite, which rises at an angle out of the ground.

name: Gedenkteken Joodse Musici
en: The Gedenkteken Joodse Musici is a monument placed in the Koninklijk Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. It is located on the first floor behind the Grote Zaal, behind the organ and near a portrait bust of Gustav Mahler. Interior architect Evelyne Merkx and graphic designer René Knip made the monument.

name: Gedenkteken Lancaster
en: The Gedenkteken Lancaster is a memorial placed in December 2022 at Metrostation Amsterdam-Noorderpark. On 20 December 1942 an Avro Lancaster (R5512) crashed into the Volewijkspark near Nieuwendammerham. It was returning from a bombing raid on Duisburg in the Ruhr area when German anti-aircraft fire hit it over Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Gedenkteken Maria Montessori
en: The Gedenkteken Maria Montessori is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue from 1953 was made by Gerarda Rueter. The commission came from the municipality of Amsterdam, which at the time customarily commissioned art to be delivered. The statue was due to be finished by September 1953.

name: Gedenkteken Muiderpoortstation
en: The Gedenkteken Muiderpoortstation, also known as the Deportatiemonument Muiderpoortstation, is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Oost at the Oosterspoorplein. It was placed in 2002 in memory of the more than 11,000 Jews who were first deported from Station Amsterdam Muiderpoort to the transit camp Westerbork.

name: Gedenkteken voormalig Nederlands-Israëlisch jongensweeshuis
en: The Gedenkteken voormalig Nederlands-Israëlisch jongensweeshuis is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The orphanage was known as the Joods Jongenshuis. It served that purpose until 1977, although in its last years it had various other uses, such as a social workshop. It was razed to make way for the construction of the Stopera.

name: Gedenkteken W.A. Froger
en: The Gedenkteken W.A. Froger is a memorial in honour of engineer Willem Anthonie Froger, one of the men behind the construction of the Noordzeekanaal. Froger was involved while he was still a professional soldier in the engineers. He died in 1883 as an independent architect, when one would have expected a memorial marker for his contribution to the canal.

name: Genius van Amsterdam
en: Genius van Amsterdam is an artwork on the border of Amsterdam-Zuid and Amsterdam-Oost. When the construction of the Berlagebrug over the Amstel, led by Hendrik Petrus Berlage (aesthetics) and Wichert Arend de Graaf (engineering), was definitively announced in 1927, the name Hildo Krop also came up.

name: Gestold water
en: Gestold water is an artwork and applied art at Oostoever Sloterplas in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. When the Oostoever neighbourhood was laid out from the decommissioned West sewage treatment plant, art was also integrated into it. The initiators were the Amsterdamse Fonds voor de Kunst and Stadsdeel Nieuw-West.

name: Getekend (Hans van der Pas)
en: Getekend is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. The artwork, from the category of optical illusion, was placed in 2006 by the artist Hans van der Pas.

name: Sublime symbols
en: Sublime symbols is a series of sculptures by Peter van de Locht, started in 1979. One of them stands in Amsterdam-West. The artwork stands on the south-eastern wing of bridge 347. The bridge is located on the Haarlemmerweg, where it meets the De Wittenkade, on the bank of the Kostverlorenvaart.

name: Giant pink glasses
en: Giant pink glasses (Dutch: Gigantische roze bril) is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artist Daniella Rubinovitz wanted people to see the world differently, not in the open field but through a see-through frame, in this case a large pink pair of glasses. It could bring a person to a different insight.

name: Goede verzorging van een zwerfsteen
en: Goede verzorging van een zwerfsteen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. This 1988 creation by Peter Breed consists of a granite plinth standing in the water, with a metal water pipe from which water flows onto an erratic boulder connected to the plinth.

name: Gold in your mind, gold in your feet
en: Gold in your mind, gold in your feet is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue by the artist Mirjam Janse is a gift from the artist to Stadsdeel Westerpark. That district had no money, so the artist had to finance the statue alone; the district only provided the location.

name: Golf (beeld)
en: Golf is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue, whose maker is as yet unknown, is built into the entrance to an education complex on De Klencke. A school stood here from the 1960s, which was demolished in the early 1980s.

name: Golf met drukveer
en: Golf met drukveer is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The creation by Gérard Leonard van den Eerenbeemt has stood since 1980 on a grass field between the Westlandgracht and the Heemstedestraat. The grass field lies south of the Westlandgrachtschutsluis.

name: Grachtenvlinder
en: Grachtenvlinder is a temporary artistic and structural artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. During the work on the bridges in the Oranje Loper, auxiliary bridges had to be placed. These were needed not only to keep foot and bicycle traffic possible, but also because all kinds of cables were rerouted from the main bridge.

name: Graft (beeld)
en: Graft 1-5 (Dutch: ent) is a group of sculptures by James Beckett in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Granietblokken Jacoba van Tongerenbrug
en: Granietblokken Jacoba van Tongerenbrug is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The Jacoba van Tongerenbrug, named after Jacoba van Tongeren, was delivered in 1953 as Bridge 602. The aesthetic architect of the fixed bridge was Piet Kramer; the technical part came from the office of the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

name: Grenspaal (Hans 't Mannetje)
en: Grenspaal, also known as Zuildragende schildpad (column-bearing turtle) or Monument van Jacob Israël de Haan, is a statue in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was made by Hans 't Mannetje. The statue stands at the start of the Jodenbreestraat, at the point where the road begins at the Sint Anthoniesluis.

name: Groot Landschap
en: Groot Landschap is an artwork in the Sloterpark in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. This large Cor-Ten steel statue is the work of visual artist Wessel Couzijn and was executed by bronze founder Mart Joosten. The sheet-steel statue measures 22 by 12 by 3.5 metres and was placed here in 1974 on a mound built for it.

name: Grote man, kleine man
en: Grote man, kleine man is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artist Stephan Balkenhol designed for the M.J. Granpré Molièreplein in the new-build neighbourhood Noordenhof a statue in which a small man climbs up the left leg of a large man. Balkenhol's oeuvre is full of images of people, but in enlarged form.

name: Gyroscoop (Jos Kokke)
en: Gyroscoop is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work, based on a gyroscope, was placed in 1995 on top of the offices of Stadsdeel Zeeburg. The artist is Jos Kokke, who was inspired by the work that for a century took place in the Entrepothaven, where ships came and went.

name: Haak en oog
en: Haak en oog is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue was designed by Wendela Gevers Deynoot and dates from 1991. It stands in front of the Gein neighbourhood centre, which was completed at that time. The address of the building is Wisseloord 83, where Wisseloord crosses the Westbroekstraat. The statue is made of black lacquered steel.

name: Haan op zuil
en: Haan op zuil is a sandstone sculpture in Westerpark in Amsterdam-West. It is a classically styled statue by Han Rädecker. Little is known about its background. The sculptor is said to have received the commission in 1955; the statue was placed in late summer 1958. It was the first statue placed in the park, and several more followed.

name: Handen (Reijers)
en: Handen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a sculpture created by the artist Willem Reijers (1910-1958). Handen can be seen on the Wibautstraat; the artwork suddenly protrudes from the almost completely flat rear facade of the Cygnus Gymnasium, formerly the Eerste Christelijke LTS Patrimonium.

name: Hans Snoekfontein
en: The Hans Snoekfontein is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The fountain is named after Hans Snoek, founder of the Scapino Ballet, who contributed financially through a legacy to the construction of the fountain and the renovation of the square. Other contributions came from American Hotel and Holland Casino. The whole was unveiled on 12 June 2006.

name: Hazentafel
en: Hazentafel is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, on the Dufaystraat. The artist Iris Le Rütte made a neighbourhood table around 2006 in the category of optical illusion. At first glance three hares carry a tabletop. At a second look it turns out that the hares, in the pose they are shown in, could never lift the tabletop; it hangs from their legs.

name: Heilig Hartbeeld (Amsterdam)
en: The Heilig Hartbeeld (Sacred Heart statue) is a statue in the Dutch city of Amsterdam.

name: Hekwerk De Nederlandsche Bank
en: The Hekwerk (railing) of De Nederlandsche Bank was an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The building of De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) at Westeinde 1 has an overhang (an overhanging facade element) where the ground floor meets the first floor. Above and below that overhang, glass is the most widely used material.

name: Hekwerk Hudsonhof
en: The Hekwerk Hudsonhof in Amsterdam-West is the alternative name for an untitled artwork by Narcisse Tordoir. In 1993 Tordoir's Hekwerk Barcelonaplein was built into the Albert complex by Bruno Albert on the Barcelonaplein.

name: Hekwerk van de Hermitage Amsterdam
en: The Hekwerk van de Hermitage Amsterdam is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. When the Amstelhof building was converted from a care centre into the Hermitage Amsterdam, the architecture firm around Hans van Heeswijk was brought in to guide the conversion and redesign.

name: Hemels juweel
en: Hemels juweel is an artwork from 1998 in Amsterdam-Oost. For the redevelopment of Java Island from harbour area to residential neighbourhood, architect and urban planner Sjoerd Soeters developed not only the layout but also designed a number of buildings. Several of his buildings were then decorated with an artwork.

name: Hemelwater (Erick de Lyon)
en: Hemelwater is applied art in Amsterdam-Oost. Erick de Lyon designed it for the 140-metre-long front facade of two combined new-build complexes at Vrolikstraat 331-395 in Amsterdam (1999). The BAG viewer gives 1999 as the completion date. The rainwater downpipes were originally meant to be hidden behind the facade.

name: Het geheim en het bewijs
en: Het geheim en het bewijs is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue from 2010 stands at the spot where the Abcouderpad crosses the Anna Blamansingel.

name: Het gezin
en: Het gezin is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The maker of the relief, Nico Onkenhout, gave his vision of the families who settled around 1955 in the new-build homes by architect Commer de Geus on the De Perronstraat. Stair-access apartments were built there, suitable for new small or starting families. Six small blocks were set out.

name: Het gouden kruis
en: Het gouden kruis is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Following a number of building projects in Reigersbos in the 1980s, an art competition was held. Art in public space could be placed for 1 percent of the building costs. Artist Han Goan Lim won the competition with his Gouden kruis, working title Double cross.

name: Het Palenhuis
en: Het Palenhuis, or Ode aan de heipaal, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It was unveiled in September 2021 on the north-western side of the junction of the Zuiderzeeweg and the IJburglaan, north of the entrance and exit of the Piet Heintunnel. The municipality of Amsterdam began in 2018 laying out and preparing the so-called Sluisbuurt for building.

name: Het toverbos aan De Rijpstraat
en: Het toverbos aan De Rijpstraat (the magic forest on De Rijpstraat) is a house-high mural on the building at De Rijpstraat 125 in Amsterdam-West. Rijpstraat 125 is the first building with an odd house number on De Rijpstraat.

name: Het westen ontvangt en ontmoet 't oosten
en: Het westen ontvangt en ontmoet 't oosten is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Oosterpark. It is a totem of galvanised steel with various chakras. It was made by Theo Niermeijer and dates from 1970. Niermeijer described the statue as "symbolic representations of human energy centres".

name: Heuvelreeks
en: The Heuvelreeks is a partly deteriorated artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The artist Jaap van Hunen made seven retaining walls for the Molenwijk neighbourhood, placed around hills along the bicycle path (which is also called Molenwijk) to keep the hills alive and emphasise them. The series dates from 1975-1977 and is made of gravel concrete.

name: Home sweet home (hekwerk)
en: Home sweet home is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It falls into the category of applied art. The Bijlmerpark was laid out around 1977 and was re-arranged in the years 2009 under the lead of Francine Houben of Mecanoo. In both the southern and northern parts a section was (again) reserved and laid out as a sports ground.

name: Jezus als dakloze
en: Jezus als dakloze (English: Homeless Jesus) is an artwork by Timothy Schmalz that has been placed in more than a hundred cities around the world since 2013.

name: Hommage (Jos Willems)
en: Hommage is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artist Jos Willems paid tribute to the history of the Entrepothaven in the Eastern Harbour area. The statue consists of a sturdy anvil of Cor-Ten steel, with a bronze bollard placed at an angle on top of it.

name: Hommage aan Paradzjanov
en: Hommage aan Paradzjanov is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, Nieuwe Pijp, on the Vredeskerkplein. The artwork by Thom Puckey was placed on commission from the municipality of Amsterdam, which, at the request of the Vredeskerk, specified that a water element had to be incorporated into the artwork.

name: Hondje (Linda van Boven)
en: Hondje is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The official body that manages art in public space has little information on this work: "Bronzen hondje op een kademuurtje van de Erasmusgracht" (bronze little dog on a quay wall of the Erasmusgracht). The site Buitenbeeldinbeeld also lists no details.

name: Hoofd (Eddy Gheress)
en: Hoofd is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a statue by Eddy Gheress from around 1995, worked out in red granite.

name: Hoogovenarbeider
en: De Hoogovenarbeider is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue from 1970 is by Wilfried Put. Put gave his bronze vision of a worker at the Koninklijke Hoogovens in Velsen. He depicted a worker in overalls and gloves. In his hands is a rod with which he had to stir the hot mass.

name: Hope (Pieter Ceizer)
en: Hope is a statue by Pieter Ceizer. Ceizer (Amsterdam, 1982) grew up around or in the Museumkwartier; as a child he learned to swim in the Zuiderbad, for example. He was regularly to be found on the Museumplein, where he saw alternative art (skateboard halfpipe, graffiti, etc.) come and go. He wanted that too.

name: Horizontale compositie
en: Horizontale compositie is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The municipality of Amsterdam asked the artist Henk Zweerus for a statue oriented horizontally for placement in the Leidsebosje. Zweerus had already made a design drawing in 1954; the announcement with a photo in De Telegraaf drew unfriendly comments.

name: Wapen van Holendrecht
en: The Wapen van Holendrecht, pars pro toto for Hub Holendrecht, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The Holendrechtplein, dating from the 1970s, received a makeover in the early 2010s. The shopping centre in the northern part was extended, and the southern part was also tackled.

name: Huil van de Wolff
en: Huil van de Wolff is an interactive artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was conceived by composer Martijn Padding in collaboration with Johan van der Kreij (programmer and sonologist) and René Bakker (instrument maker). They wanted to keep alive the memory of horn player and concert organiser Jan Wolff.

name: Huygenika
en: Huygenika is a mural in Amsterdam-West. Huygenika is a portmanteau of the two subjects of the painting: the scientist Constantijn Huygens and the painting Guernica by Pablo Picasso from 1937.

name: I am at home
en: I am at home is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The Latvian artist Asnate Bočkis made the artwork for Homo urbanus - Homo sapiens. This statue exhibition partly grew out of the collaboration that Amsterdam has with the Latvian capital Riga.

name: I amsterdam
en: I amsterdam was an attraction that from 2005 appeared in various places in Amsterdam. It consisted of large red and white letters forming the words I amsterdam in Avenir font (where the a and m are still joined together). The words were chosen in 2004 as successor to the slogan Amsterdam has it.

name: I don't waste my time
en: I don't waste my time (graphically: I don't wa$te my time) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist Selwyn Senatori (born 1973) made an enlarged replica of his pedal bin in his studio. In doing so he did not leave out the dent. The theme is Time=money (time is the ultimate luxury).

name: I amsterdam Sloterplas
en: I amsterdam Sloterplas is a variant on the I amsterdam theme, placed in July 2016 on the south bank of the Sloterplas, near the Cornelis Lelylaan.

name: If walls could speak
en: If walls could speak is a ten-part artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. After renovation of five low-rise apartment blocks on the Platanen- and Olmenweg in Amsterdam-Oost, murals were placed in May 2019 on the ten almost gable-end facades of those blocks.

name: If you know, you know/5713
en: If you know, you know/5713 (Als je het weet, weet je het) is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West by Narges Mohammadi, Zeinab El Bouni and the youth department of art institution De Appel. The diptych was unveiled on 12 October 2024.

name: Ik speel in de stad met alles wat er bestaat
en: Ik speel in de stad met alles wat er bestaat is a mural painted on the blind gable walls of the Tuinstraat in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: In between the gap
en: In between the gap is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is applied art: a bird-watching hide designed by Dimitra Chrysovergi from Greece, a student at the Gerrit Rietveld Academie. It is one of a set of three bird hides; the others are 270 degrees and Amfibion (they stand far apart).

name: Individualiteit tegenover collectiviteit
en: Individualiteit tegenover collectiviteit (Individualism vs collectivism) is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is a full-width facade mural by Munir de Vries, who has also made murals elsewhere in the city and in Utrecht.

name: Industrieel monument (Joep van Lieshout)
en: Industrieel monument is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It consists of a former railway platform with a foreman's hut and a wagon. It is a creation of (Atelier) Joep van Lieshout, placed in public space on the Cruquiusweg in the Eastern Harbour area.

name: Innerlijke kleur
en: Innerlijke kleur is a mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The mural dates from 2013 and was painted on a blind wall in the Paul Scholtenstraat.

name: Islanded
en: Islanded is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue is by the artist Anneke de Witte, a graduate of the Koninklijke Academie (KAKV) in 's-Hertogenbosch.

name: Gedenkteken Johan Cruijff
en: Gedenkteken Johan Cruijff is an artwork in the form of a memorial. In the Amsterdam neighbourhood of Watergraafsmeer, various artistic and architectural artworks commemorate the footballer Johan Cruijff.

name: Jonas en de walvis (Amsterdam)
en: Jonas en de walvis is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sculptor Nic Jonk made this bronze statue on a concrete plinth in 1968; it is signed and dated. In 1976 it was included in a sculpture route by Stichting Beeldende Kunst running from the Dam along the Damrak. At that time it stood on the Beursplein.

name: Jongen met haan (Ruth Brouwer)
en: Jongen met haan is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Ruth Brouwer made a bronze statue on a concrete plinth for the Montessorischool on Hoekenes, showing a boy playfully holding a rooster. The statue is sometimes seen as a reaction to the 1953 Gedenkteken Maria Montessori by Gerarda Rueter in the Corellistraat, Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Monument Jordaanoproer
en: The Monument Jordaanoproer, also known as Eenheid de sterkste keten (Unity is the strongest chain), is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The monument dates from 1987, was made by Sofie Hupkens and stands on the Noordermarkt, the square belonging to the Noorderkerk.

name: Oorlogsgedenkteken omgekomen Jordaanbewoners
en: The Oorlogsgedenkteken omgekomen Jordaanbewoners is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bronze plaque, set in relief, is attached to the southern facade of the Noorderkerk in Amsterdam. The maker and designer is Ezechiël Jacob Hoek. It refers to all residents of the Amsterdam Jordaan neighbourhood who died in the Second World War.

name: Juicy light
en: Juicy light is a set of six art objects placed in Amsterdam Oud-West. The 'statue' consists of six lighting units hanging above the Ten Katemarkt, that is, in the Ten Katestraat.

name: Justus van Maurikbank
en: The Justus van Maurikbank is an artwork and memorial bench in Amsterdam-Oost. It commemorates the then-popular writer Justus van Maurik jr. and was unveiled in 1907.

name: Kaarttableaus Amsterdamse Bos
en: The Kaarttableaus Amsterdamse Bos (map tableaux) consist of a number of maps set into the Amsterdamse Bos.

name: Kabouterstandbeeld
en: The Kabouterstandbeeld is a form of public art in Amsterdam-Centrum. The little statue was made as a reminder of the gnome movement, which had its Magies Sentrum (experience centre) on the Spui. Still standing there is Het Lieverdje by Carel Kneulman, which has been knocked over several times but always rises again.

name: Kabouterhuis-hek
en: The Kabouterhuis-hek is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It consists of a two-dimensional rendering of a gnome village, cut by laser from 10 mm thick Cor-Ten steel.

name: Kapkar/GTO-B10
en: Kapkar/GTO-B10 is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a statue by Frank Havermans from 2019. Havenaar was asked by the art event "Play Station Sloterdijk" (28 June 2019 to 3 November 2019) to design a statue in connection with the building frenzy around Station Amsterdam Sloterdijk and Rijksweg 10 (Ringweg-West).

name: Kariatidenzuil
en: The Kariatidenzuil is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The sculptor Joost Barbiers made his version of a column with caryatids around 1984. In antiquity these caryatids served as the column; in the work of Joost Barbiers they form only a small part.

name: Triomfboog van Kattenburg
en: The Triomfboog van Kattenburg (English: Kattenburger Triumphal Arch) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The triumphal arch is built into an underpass in an apartment block on the Kattenburgerstraat leading to the Kattenburgerkruisstraat. The artwork is placed on the six pillars in that underpass and consists of twelve parts.

name: Kazemat en kogels
en: Kazemat en kogels is a chosen title for a two-part artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Until the mid-1980s the Wittenburgervaart was a waterway running between factory grounds. The industry there was still largely related to shipbuilding, which thrived here for years.

name: Keeping watch above the flowers
en: Keeping watch above the flowers is an artwork by Richard John Jones in Amsterdam-Zuid. It stands among the benches on the Beethovenplein, which is surrounded by a series of buildings. Buildings on the square are in use by the Sint-Nicolaaslyceum, the law firm Stibbe and AkzoNobel.

name: Kennisoverdracht
en: Kennisoverdracht is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It depicts a schoolmaster and three of his pupils. Two of the pupils appear to be bent under a row of books.

name: Kissing Couple XXXL
en: The Kissing Couple XXXL (Kussend Paar) is an artwork in Westpoort, Amsterdam. It is a work by Saske van der Eerden.

name: Klimmuur Dokter Meurerlaan
en: De Klimmuur Dr. Meurerlaan is an architectural and artistic artwork. It is an example of applied art: an open-air climbing wall from 1988-1991, designed by the artist Boudewijn Payens, who is himself a mountaineer. The wall consists of two concrete triangles resting obliquely against each other.

name: Mono No Aware II
en: Mono No Aware II is a mural in central Amsterdam, made by the artist Mick La Rock in 2023.

name: Kogelbron (RAI Amsterdam)
en: De Kogelbron is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The work is a creation of the German artist Christian Tobin. Christian Tobin, who was then still called Christian Mayer, has made this kind of stone (German: Kugelbrunnen; English: Floating spheres) since 1983. The first, titled Oblio, is in Munich.

name: Kogelbron (Oostenburgerpark)
en: De Kogelbron is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work is a creation of the German artist Christian Tobin. Christian Tobin, who was then still called Christian Mayer, has made this kind of stone (German: Kugelbrunnen; English: Floating spheres) since 1983. The first, titled Oblio, is in Munich.

name: Opengewerkte kolom
en: Opengewerkte kolom is a fictitious name for an untitled artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Het kompas
en: Het kompas is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It consists of a mosaic by Fabrice Hünd; it is one of his four mega-mosaics in Amsterdam (data 2018). In 2006 he applied thousands of small stones and shards to a small outbuilding on the Marie Heinekenplein, which looked rather forlorn and had fallen victim to all kinds of vandalism.

name: Monument voor koningin Emma (Amsterdam)
en: The Monument koningin Emma, in memory of Queen Emma, stands on the Emmaplein in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Willemsparkbuurt. The statue was designed by sculptor Lambertus Zijl (1866-1947) and unveiled in 1938.

name: Koningin Wilhelmina (Onkenhout)
en: Koningin Wilhelmina is an artwork standing on the Koningin Wilhelminaplein in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue was made by Nico Onkenhout and was commissioned around 1967 by the Confectiecentrum (garment trade centre), later renamed World Fashion Centre. The Confectiecentrum had been spread across the city and began to centralise around this square.

name: Kosmos (Vondelpark)
en: Kosmos is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, Vondelpark. Kosmos is a statue created by Wim van Hoorn. It was made in 1969-1970 and dates from the period when the artist was interested in the cosmos after Neil Armstrong set foot on the Moon. It consists of a bronze rhombus with cut-outs.

name: Kostwinner (Constance Wibaut)
en: Kostwinner, also known as Drie generaties, is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue by Constance Wibaut stands in a (closed-off) inner courtyard between two apartment blocks with stair-access flats, built on the Granidastraat and the Gulden Winckelstraat. The Leeuwendalerspad, which once ran through, passes the opening on the south side of the block.

name: Kreukel (kunstwerk)
en: Kreukel is a temporary artwork on the border between Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The boundary between the two districts is formed by the Singelgracht, which here is spanned by bridge 167, named the Rijckerbrug, by architect Piet Kramer and the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

name: Kruis (Michel Somers)
en: Kruis is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Little is known about the statue. It was made around 1979 by the artist Michel Somers and placed by the Dalsteinmetrobrug on the Oostlijn. The original was a light object of perspex and steel, with the lighting concealed inside the perspex.

name: Kruisteken (Jan Verschoor)
en: Kruisteken or Kruisbeeld is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Around 1979 the artist Jan Verschoor received a commission from the municipality of Amsterdam. It is an assembly of abstract forms around a vertical axis. With this statue Verschoor sought to find balance.

name: Kubus (Arie Jansma)
en: The Kubus is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. Little is known about the work. It was designed (and perhaps also made) by Arie Jansma. It dates from 1975 and was intended for Shell. Jansma was, however, an amateur artist.

name: Zonder titel (Joost van Santen)
en: At the grade-separated junction of Cornelis Lelylaan and Johan Huizingalaan in Amsterdam Nieuw-West stands an untitled artwork. The crossing between the two avenues is handled by an architectural artwork in the form of bridge 705, which carries the Cornelis Lelylaan over the Johan Huizingalaan.

name: Zonder titel (André Volten, 1984)
en: In the Bella Vistapark in Amsterdam-Oost stands an untitled artwork. The work comes from André Volten, who was allowed by the Dienst der Publieke Werken to design a statue for a new headquarters of the GEB. Placement and unveiling took place around 23 May 1985. The headquarters at the time stood at Spaklerweg 20.

name: Monument voor het kunstenaarsverzet 1940-1945
en: The Monument voor het kunstenaarsverzet 1940-1945 is an artwork and monument in Amsterdam-Centrum. Following the demolition of the Panoramagebouw at Plantage Middenlaan 50, a relatively wide strip of greenery came into being, which in 1963 was given the name Plantage Westermanlaan. It became a small park, without officially receiving that name.

name: Kwibukamonument
en: The Kwibukamonument is a monument in the Beatrixpark, Amsterdam-Zuid. It refers back to the genocide in Rwanda in 1994. A number of refugees fled to the Netherlands and united in Ibuka-Nederland, but unlike elsewhere in the world they still had no memorial in remembrance of it.

name: La demeure humaine
en: La demeure humaine is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Leda en de zwaan (Han Rädecker)
en: Leda en de zwaan is an artwork in the Erasmuspark in Amsterdam-West. At the request of the municipality of Amsterdam, sculptor Han Rädecker made his version of the mythological story of Leda. He depicted both Leda and Zeus, who had been transformed into a swan.

name: Ontdek de Dam
en: Ontdek de Dam is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work was placed in the last week of August 2021 and is a creation by Street Art Frankey. Frankey places a small artwork in the city of Amsterdam every week, enriching the streetscape with humorous additions to street and facade elements.

name: Leeuw en tijger met prooi
en: Leeuw met prooi and tijger met prooi (lion with prey and tiger with prey) are two sculptures of French limestone in Amsterdam-Centrum. They stand on either side of the entrance to the former main building of the Artis zoo. The sculptures were originally carved by Jacques Joseph François Verdonck, commissioned by Artis in 1859 and placed in 1861.

name: Leeuwen van Zeeburg
en: Leeuwen van Zeeburg is a group of sculptures on either side of the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal. The artwork was "made" by Marieke van Diemen. The group consists of four identical lions standing at the entrance to the canal. These lions date from 2015 but have a history going back to the late 19th century.

name: Blauw Jan
en: Blauw Jan is a collection of bronze statues placed on the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen. The maker is Hans van Houwelingen.

name: Tayouken Piss
en: Tayouken Piss, or Les pisseurs d'Amsterdam, is a group of statues in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Levensboom (Wim Tap)
en: De Levensboom is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a creation of the artist Wim Tap and is said to date from 1989. The artwork consists of two parts. The most striking part is a column of blue bluestone, roughly worked at the lower part as if the column had been eaten away.

name: Levensboom (Angie Abbink)
en: Levensboom is a sculptural pavilion and artwork in public space on the Ontmoetingseiland in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. It was designed by architect and artist Angie Abbink and completed in 2015. The steel and glass construction forms a canopy over the existing round stage on the island.

name: Liedje van Hans Andreus
en: Liedje van Hans Andreus is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The poet Hans Andreus wrote several poems under the title Liedje. The poem contains words he invented himself, such as roekoe- and toedoemeisjes. It is set in lettered pavement tiles in the street tile pattern of the J.W. Siebbeleshof in central Amsterdam.

name: HIV/AIDSmonument
en: The HIV/AIDSmonument is an artwork on De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam-Centrum that was unveiled on 1 December 2016. The creation by Jean-Michel Othoniel stands on De Ruijterkade, Amsterdam. The initiative for the monument came around 2013 from the Stichting Namen Project Nederland, which asked a number of artists for a monument.

name: Lord of the rings (Amsterdamse Bos)
en: Lord of the rings is an artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos. The design, within the category of applied art, comes from Buitenom, made up of Minka Haverkorn and Carolien Oomes. The firm designs items for placement in public spaces.

name: Love or generosity
en: Love or generosity (Dutch: Liefde of edelmoedigheid) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a five-metre-high statue by the French/American artist Nicole Eisenman, placed on 27 November 2020. The statue is part of the new building for the Rechtbank Amsterdam on the Parnassusweg.

name: Love sphinx
en: Love sphinx is a sculpture by Carel Kneulman. The statue stands in the Eendrachtspark in Amsterdam Nieuw-West near bridge 619. It dates from around 1974. The Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam exhibited a preliminary study of the statue in 1974 at Museum Fodor.

name: Maalstroom nr. 1
en: Maalstroom nr. 1 is an artwork in Amsterdam-Westpoort. The artist Thomas Elshuis is an architect by training. He received an inheritance from a friend of the family consisting of 20.000 photos. Since then he has made collages of photos in walls and other constructions.

name: Maalstroom nr. 2
en: Maalstroom nr. 2 is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artist Thomas Elshuis is an architect by training. He received an inheritance from a friend of the family consisting of 20.000 photos. Since then he has made collages of photos in walls and other constructions.

name: Maan over Ameland
en: Maan over Ameland is an artistic artwork that stands on an architectural structure in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist Bert de Laaf (Gaspard Albert Jean de Laaf 1932-2014) received a commission in 1969 from the municipality of Amsterdam for an artwork on a new bridge 485 to be built over the Oosterdoksdoorgang.

name: Magneten (beeld)
en: Magneten is a statue in Amsterdam-West. The artwork stands on the Koningin Wilhelminaplein (in front of number 16), where it connects with the Schipluidenlaan via bridge 691. The stainless steel sculpture is a design by Lies Maes and was the first Amsterdam commission for this female artist.

name: De toeschouwer en abstracte vorm
en: De toeschouwer en abstracte vorm is an atypical sculpture group in Westerpark in Amsterdam-West. It is a combined work by Ronald Tolman (figurative) and Liesbeth Pallesen (abstract). Like other parks and small parks in Amsterdam, Westerpark has an extensive art collection.

name: Manenschaap (beeld)
en: Manenschaap is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a work by Pieter d'Hont that belongs to the art collection of De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB). The statue dates from 1969, when d'Hont made two versions of a manenschaap.

name: Manna (Ram Katzir)
en: Manna is a multi-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Colloquially it became known as Halfje gesneden wit. In the period 2018 to 2020 the Meerwaldtplantsoen was renovated. The small park, which has only an unofficial name, is named after resistance fighter Arthur Meerwaldt.

name: Mare Nostrum (beeld)
en: Mare Nostrum is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The creation by Barten van Elden and Raymond Hirs dates from around 1988 and consists of three stainless steel zigzag strips lying in a grassland along the Abcouderpad.

name: Maria Planeta Citta
en: Maria Planeta Citta (1991) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue, a creation by Evert van Kooten Niekerk, was made at the request of the municipality of Amsterdam.

name: Maria van de 21e eeuw
en: Maria van de 21e eeuw is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue can be found in the publicly accessible reception space of the OLVG-Oost, Oosterpark 9.

name: Staande Maria met Christus
en: Staande Maria met Christus is a statue in Amsterdam-Oost. It adorns the facade wall of the Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis on the Eerste Oosterparkstraat. The statue, more than a century old, is the only thing that has survived from the original Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis, which opened in 1898.

name: Markering (Rees)
en: Markering is an unofficial name for a sculpture group in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The group of four statues comes from a collaboration between artist Adriaan Rees and children from the neighbourhood of Stadspark Osdorp. The artist himself calls them Kinderbeelden.

name: Markttafereel
en: Markttafereel consists of two artistic artworks in Amsterdam-Zuid. It forms half of a set of four loose statues from the period 1921-1924 by Hildo Krop. In that period two school buildings (a Hogere Burgerschool and a Handelsschool) rose on the Jozef Israëlskade, separated by the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat.

name: Mbulu Ngulu
en: Mbulu Ngulu is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Alexander Schabracq designed this Mbulu Ngulu, which is the embodiment of the spirit of the dead in Bantu, West Africa. Schabracq himself refers to the Bakota in northeast Gabon. It was placed on a peperbus (advertising column) at the junction of the Czaar Peterstraat and the quay of the Oostenburgergracht.

name: Zonder titel (Tom Postma)
en: On a small square on the Hercules Seghersstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid, De Pijp, stands an untitled artwork. It is a statue from 1982 by artist Tom Postma. He made it as a memorial to the milk factory (Melkfabriek Holland, Milko) that stood here on the Eerste Jan Steenstraat 10-38.

name: Monument aan de Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat
en: The Monument aan de Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Monument voor Damslachtoffers 7 mei 1945
en: A plaque and thirty-two paving stones on the Dam in Amsterdam-Centrum commemorate the victims of the shooting on the Dam on 7 May 1945.

name: Memories (Bastardilla)
en: Memories is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a mural by Bastardilla as tall as a house, on the side wall of a housing block between the Burgemeester Röellstraat (house numbers 207-267) and the Nicolaas Ruychaverstraat (house numbers 18-40) in Geuzenveld.

name: Mens in beweging
en: Mens in beweging is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The creation by artist Peter van den Akker has been placed on the Arent Janszoon Ernststraat in the Buitenveldert district. Van den Akker made the sculpture group commissioned by GGZ Buiten Amstel, which is located in the building with house number 1187.

name: De greep naar het schone
en: De greep naar het schone consists of two artistic artworks in Amsterdam-Zuid. It forms half of a set of four loose statues from the period 1921-1924 by Hildo Krop. In that period two school buildings (a Hogere Burgerschool and a Handelsschool) rose on the Jozef Israëlskade, separated by the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat.

name: Mensen op strand met parasol
en: Mensen op strand met parasol is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Artist Jan Spiering designed a statue for a small park on the Botteskerksingel, in which a man shields a woman from the sunrays with a parasol. Almost nothing else is known about the work.

name: Hide and see(k)
en: Hide and see(k) is a work of applied art in Amsterdam-Zuid. The work consists of a fountain designed by the Danish artist Jeppe Hein. Hein designed more fountains, which found their place scattered across the world.

name: Microben (Pauline Wiertz)
en: Microben (ook wel Microbe) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. Artist Pauline Wiertz designed a set of twelve round hardstone tiles in 2003 for the WG-Plein, named after the Wilhelmina Gasthuis, which was located here between 1891 and 1983.

name: Minerva (Jan Havermans)
en: Minerva is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, made between 1929 and 1931 by Jan Havermans.

name: Minervapassage
en: De Minervapassage is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is the pedestrian tunnel under Station Amsterdam Zuid, which connects the Zuidplein and the Gustav Mahlerplein. It was named after the Minervalaan.

name: Mirakelkolom
en: De Mirakelkolom is a column on the Rokin in the Dutch capital Amsterdam, erected as a memorial to the Heilige Stede, a church building that formerly stood on the Rokin. The word 'mirakel' refers to the Miracle of Amsterdam, which is said to have taken place in 1345.

name: Mirror, mirror (lichtkunst)
en: Mirror, mirror is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Westpoort. The Arlandabrug is a structure on the Rijksweg 10 over what until 1985 was the Amsterdam-Haarlem railway line. When that was removed here, it became a tunnel for pedestrians, cyclists and trams. That relatively long underpass was felt to be unsafe.

name: Sight point (for Leo Castelli)
en: Sight point (for Leo Castelli) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The artwork is a creation of the American artist Richard Serra (1938-2024). The statue grew out of a competition around 1972 announced by Wesleyan University in Middletown (Connecticut).

name: Missing numbers
en: Missing numbers is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Zonder titel (Dik Box, Amsterdam-Oost)
en: On the eastern bank of the Amstel, in Amsterdam-Oost, stands an untitled artwork. The work stands where the pedestrian area of the Amstelboulevard meets the cycle path of the Omval. The artwork consists of two rotating arms standing on two stake frames along the cycle path of the Amstelboulevard.

name: Meisje met de parel (muurschildering)
en: Meisje met de parel is a mural in the Dutch city of Amsterdam by Roelof Schierbeek (graffiti name Beyond) from 2023.

name: Moeder Aarde (Krop)
en: Moeder Aarde is a sculpture by sculptor Hildo Krop from the 1920s that has stood in the Tweede Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam since 1958. In 2016 it was replaced by a replica due to serious weathering damage. The statue is said to date from 1926 and is carved from French limestone.

name: Moeder en kind (Han Wezelaar)
en: Moeder en kind, also known as De zorg, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a statue carved from French limestone by Han Wezelaar, placed between September and December 1939 on the Euterpestraat, which was renamed the Gerrit van der Veenstraat on 18 May 1945.

name: Oorlogsmonument Marnixstraat
en: The Oorlogsmonument Marnixstraat is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. It stands next to the DeLaMar on the Marnixstraat 404.

name: Monument 1940-'45 in Bos en Lommer
en: The Monument 1940-1945 is a war memorial in the Bos en Lommer district of Amsterdam-West. A statue by sculptress Gerarda Rueter (1904-1993) stands here. It is known by many names, including Zittende vrouw, Zittende figuur, Monument 1940-1945, Monument aan de Bos en Lommerweg and Herdenkingsmonument zittende vrouw.

name: Monument Burgemeester Tellegen
en: The Monument Burgemeester Tellegen is a monument in Amsterdam-Zuid. Jan Willem Cornelis Tellegen was director of "Bouw- en Woningtoezicht" in Amsterdam from 1901, and mayor from 1915 until his death in 1921.

name: Gedenkteken Van Houten & Zn
en: The Gedenkteken Van Houten & Zn is a municipal monument in the Dutch town of Weesp. Staff presented the memorial in 1928 to mark the 100th anniversary of the firm C. J. van Houten & Zoon. It stands on the corner of Hugo de Grootlaan and G.J. van Houtenlaan/Groeneweg, in Zeerust park by the care home Oversingel.

name: Monument De Waarheid
en: Monument De Waarheid is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a monument in memory of the staff of De Waarheid, which was distributed illegally from the start of the Second World War. De Waarheid was at that time connected to the Communist Party of the Netherlands. The idea arose at a gathering of Jong en oud verzet.

name: Monument aan de Haarlemmerweg
en: The Monument aan de Haarlemmerweg is a monument to war victims, placed on the Haarlemmerweg in Amsterdam Nieuw-West between the footbridges and cycle bridges Burgemeester Eliasstraat and Burgemeester Fockstraat.

name: Monument Henri Viotta
en: The Monument Henri Viotta is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Joods Verzetsmonument
en: The Monument Joods Verzet 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood since 1988 on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, on the side of the Stopera. It was erected in memory of all Jewish resistance members who perished in the Second World War.

name: Monument leven en vrijheid
en: The Monument leven en vrijheid is a memorial on the Ceramplein in Amsterdam-Oost. For years, celebrations of the Second World War were held in the Amsterdam Indische Buurt near a freedom tree standing on that square. In 1957 a tile was placed near that freedom tree.

name: Monument ter herdenking van in de Tweede Wereldoorlog gevallen oud-kwekelingen
en: The Monument ter herdenking van in de Tweede Wereldoorlog gevallen oud-kwekelingen is a monument in Amsterdam-Centrum. It came about on the initiative of the "Vereeniging van oud-kwekelingen van de Kweekschool voor de Zeevaart" in Amsterdam.

name: Monument Rozenoord
en: Monument Rozenoord is a commemorative monument in Amsterdam-Zuid from 2015, in memory of those shot by firing squad during the Second World War at the execution site Rozenoord. A monument (memorial stone and flagpole) has stood at the site of the execution itself for years. However, the dead are not named individually here.

name: Monument tegen apartheid en racisme
en: Monument tegen apartheid en racisme is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue from 1987 is by artist Pépé Grégoire. The bronze statue depicts human unity in diversity through an arm and a leg.

name: Monument voor Keesje Brijde
en: The Monument voor Keesje Brijde (also referred to as Keesje) is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Monument to the unsung
en: Monument to the unsung is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. It comes from the Iraqi-Kurdish artist Walid Siti, born in Duhok, and was placed as part of Framer Framed. Siti wants to call attention to women. In his view, too much attention goes to men in proportion.

name: Monument van Joodse Erkentelijkheid
en: The Monument van Joodse Erkentelijkheid, also known as the Monument van Joodse Dankbaarheid and the Wertheimmonument, is a monument on the Weesperplein in Amsterdam. It was erected in 1950 as an expression of thanks to the Amsterdammers who helped the Jewish population during the Second World War.

name: Monument voor Annick van Hardeveld
en: The Monument voor Annick van Hardeveld is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. The monument, a hardstone plinth with a plaque, has been placed on the Hekelveld in front of the building with house number 25 (the point between the Spuistraat and the Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal). It was designed by artist Hans Bayens.

name: Monument voor de liefde
en: Monument voor de liefde is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The monument was erected to celebrate the love between poet Osip Mandelstam and his wife Nadjezjda Mandelstam. He was a reviled poet in the Soviet Union under Jozef Stalin and his work was not published.

name: Monument voor de stad Amsterdam
en: The Monument voor de stad Amsterdam is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Artist Pieter Engels designed a statue of 18.000 kilograms of Swedish granite, concrete and steel for the place between the apartment blocks Groenhoven and Gouden Leeuw, at a cost of 150.000 guilders.

name: Monument voor de te jong gevallen boom
en: The Monument voor de te jong gevallen boom is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The design of the statue comes from artist André van der Linden (Amsterdam, 1945), who studied for a year at the Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten on the Stadhouderskade in Amsterdam, but is otherwise self-taught.

name: Monument voor een verzonken stad
en: Monument voor een verzonken stad is an artistic artwork standing in the Erasmuspark in Amsterdam-West. The work is dated 1981-1982 in the oeuvre of Berend Peter. At that time this transparent frame, essential according to the artist, was placed in the Frederik Hendrikplantsoen in Amsterdam.

name: Monument voor Joop den Uyl
en: The Monument voor Joop den Uyl is an artistic artwork in Zaanstad. It was designed by Jan Wolkers and unveiled in 1990.

name: Monument Walraven van Hall
en: The Monument Walraven van Hall is an artwork and war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. The initiators of this sculpture were retired general practitioner Hans Weijers and retired medic Loek van Buchem, who set up a foundation to erect a monument to resistance fighter Walraven van Hall.

name: Monument Watersnoodramp 1960
en: The Monument Watersnoodramp 1960 is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord, Zonneplein. The statue is by Robbert Ritmeester and was placed in 1990. Ritmeester (1958) had only just graduated from the Gerrit Rietveld Academie at that time. It is a memorial to the flooding of the Tuindorp Oostzaan district on 14 January 1960.

name: Moodwall
en: Moodwall is an artistic viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. At the start of the 21st century, the Zuidoost borough saw much urban renewal. One of the reasons was the feeling of insecurity under the countless viaducts built in the borough in connection with the separated traffic flows.

name: Morgenster (Arjen Lancel)
en: Morgenster is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is by Arjen Lancel (1951). Lancel received a commission from Stadsdeel De Baarsjes for the Stadsreiniging Amsterdam, which had a branch (filiaal) with maintenance workshops on the Admiraal Helfrichstraat. The funding came from the Amsterdams Fonds van de Kunst.

name: Moeder en kind (Nic. Jonk)
en: Moeder en kind is an artwork in Amstelveen. It is a bronze statue from 1958 standing on a plinth, made by artist Nic Jonk. It stands in a bed of half-high shrubs on the Keizer Karelweg, where it crosses the Dr. Plesmansingel.

name: Muurschildering De Roggeveen
en: Muurschildering De Roggeveenstraat is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum, Zeeheldenbuurt. The painting was made by Klaartje Bruyn of Bont & Bruyn. De Roggeveen is a care centre of HVO Querido, an institution for social shelter and supported and sheltered living.

name: Mural Foodstrip
en: Mural Foodstrip is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The mural was applied by the street art artists "Karski & Beyond" and "Bier en Brood". The work symbolises the changes within the Amsterdam Zuidoost district and the Amstel III area. The artists felt that the diversity of the residents should be reflected in the artwork.

name: Muurschildering van Keith Haring
en: De Muurschildering van Keith Haring is an artwork by Keith Haring in Amsterdam-West. Haring applied the mural in 1986 to a depot of the Stedelijk Museum, located on the grounds of the Centrale Markthallen. He was staying in Amsterdam at that time for a solo exhibition in the aforementioned museum.

name: Muurschildering Osdorpplein
en: De Muurschildering Osdorpplein is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The mural was placed in 1983 by Chilean artist Jorge Kata Nuñez. He was working at that time with the artists' collective Brigada Ramona Parra.

name: Muurschildering Reigersbos
en: De Muurschildering Reigersbos is a mural in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. This mural was applied by the Utrecht illustrator and designer Munir de Vries in early summer 2019, and was unveiled on 29 June. De Vries, himself from the Reigersbos district, felt the grey walls did not suit the colourful (population makeup of the) district.

name: Muurschildering Thérèse Schwartze
en: De Muurschildering Thérèse Schwartze is a mural depicting artist Thérèse Schwartze on the building at Frans Halsstraat 35, which has a side wall on the Quellijnstraat.

name: Muziek en vreugde
en: Muziek en vreugde is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Artist Bart van Hove originally made the statue to decorate the facade of the Amsterdam Stadsschouwburg on the Leidseplein.

name: Muur van Surinaamse en zwarte helden
en: De Muur van Surinaamse en zwarte helden is a mural several metres long in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Muurschildering Hemsterhuisbruggen
en: De Muurschildering Hemsterhuisbruggen is a multi-part mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Muurschildering Kees de jongen
en: Muurschildering Kees de jongen is a mural on a partly blind facade of the building at Tuinstraat 61, Jordaan (Amsterdam-Centrum). The mural refers back to the novel Kees de jongen by Theo Thijssen.

name: Muurschildering Overschiestraatbrug
en: De Muurschildering Overschiestraatbrug is a mural on the abutments of the Overschiestraatbrug in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Muurschildering Rijswijkstraatbrug
en: De Muurschildering Rijswijkstraatbrug is a mural applied to an abutment of the Rijswijkstraatbrug in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The concrete of the southern abutment was given a tunnel painting in 2008. It is a creation by artist Frederik Molenschot.

name: Muurschildering Tweede Kostverlorenkade
en: De Muurschildering Tweede Kostverlorenkade is a mural in Amsterdam-West.

name: Muurschilderingen Nieuwe Hemweg
en: De Muurschilderingen Nieuwe Hemweg were two artistic artworks applied to blind walls along the Nieuwe Hemweg in Westpoort, Amsterdam.

name: Naaktfiguur
en: Naaktfiguur, also known as Meisje or Staand naakt, is the title of a statue in the Amsterdam Vondelpark. The statue dates from around 1957 and is by Frits Sieger. It was on show during the exhibition "Nederlandse Beeldhouwkunst '57" in the Museum Boijmans. The municipality of Amsterdam subsequently bought it in 1958.

name: Naald van Goedkoop
en: De Naald van Goedkoop (officially Zuil van Goedkoop) is a memorial and artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. During the war years a celebration nevertheless took place at the Nederlandsche Scheepsbouw Maatschappij. The celebration on 25 August 1944 marked the fiftieth anniversary of that company.

name: Nail House
en: Nail House (synonymous with holdout, standing one's ground) is an artwork that stood/stands temporarily in Amsterdam in 2015 and 2019. It is built after the model of a spijkerhuis or nagelhuis (nail house).

name: NAP-Stedenmaagd
en: NAP-Stedenmaagd is a mural as tall as a house in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Nautilus (Barbara Nanning)
en: Nautilus is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Barbara Nanning designed a ceiling relief for the gatehouse between the Erich Salomonstraat and the Theo Frenkelhof on IJburg. The commission came from the housing associations De Alliantie and Waterstad 3.

name: Nereus op zeepaard
en: Nereus op zeepaard is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. This creation of the god Nereus is by sculptor Nic Jonk (1928-1994). The statue stands in front of the boathouse and clubhouse of the rowing club ASR Nereus.

name: Kranten en letters
en: Kranten en letters is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Although it is an artwork in public space, it can only be viewed by passengers on the Amsterdam Metro, specifically on the lines that use the so-called Oostlijntraject.

name: NO (Paul Vendel)
en: NO (Paul Vendel) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The artwork was placed during the construction of the Waterwijk district, on the site of the relocated Gemeentewaterleidingen. During the layout (and its further existence) there was much deliberation to arrange the district according to residents' wishes.

name: No war
en: No war is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a so-called respect monument by artist Remco Swart. It was placed on the electricity cabin at the Balboaplein. It dates from 2005, with an unveiling on 22 June of that year by, among others, alderman (diversity, education and youth) Ahmed Aboutaleb.

name: Nooit Meer Teruggekomen
en: Nooit Meer Teruggekomen is a monument on the Prins Bernhardlaan in Amstelveen, dedicated to commemorating the Amstelveen victims of the persecution of Jews who were murdered during the Second World War. It was unveiled on 24 September 2020.

name: Noorderklankpark
en: Het Noorderklankpark is a collection of musical instruments in Amsterdam-Noord, Noorderpark. The instruments are made of corten steel. The designer of the large musical instruments is Hans van Dorp, an artist who works in sound and design.

name: Not in my back yard (Voerman)
en: Not in my back yard (Nimby) was an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a creation by Rob Voerman, made specifically for Amsterdam Zuidoost for a biennale held in 2009. It consists of a combination of steel, glass and polycarbonate.

name: Ode aan de paardenvijg
en: Ode aan de paardenvijg is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue by Aart Rietbroek was placed in 1972 in the small park of the Merwedeplein. Rietbroek reduced the form of a horse dropping to its essence: an abstracted heap of horse dung that has fallen apart into three pieces.

name: ODE's blozers
en: ODE's blozers is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Kantoorgangers
en: Kantoorgangers is a sculpture group on the Schalk Burgerstraat in Amsterdam-Oost. The statues were designed after the Woningbedrijf Amsterdam had renovated a housing complex by Jan Gratama on that street.

name: Olifant (Jan Meefout)
en: Olifant is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work by Jan Meefout is at once a statue, a climbing object and a fountain. Meefout said in an interview in Het Parool of 1 November 1964: "I had to fill a large space, so you cannot come at it with a small creature".

name: Olifant India
en: Olifant India is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was one of the 105 elephants that took part in the Olifantenparade (Elephant Parade) in Amsterdam in 2009.

name: Olifant met kalf
en: Olifant en kalf is a composite form of art in public space in Amsterdam-Oost. The Transvaalplein was laid out and fully built up in the 1910s of the 20th century. The open space was regularly redesigned after that time.

name: Omgevallen boom
en: Omgevallen boom is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. In their second collaboration, Pieter Engels and Shlomo Korén created an artwork during a redevelopment of the Bickerseiland district in 1983. It resembles a sawn-out hollow tree. The residents saw nothing in it and invariably called it the Walvis (Whale).

name: Oneindigheid (Mies Wubs)
en: Oneindigheid is an artistic artwork in the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery in Amsterdam-Oost. The cemetery was laid out around 1894 as the successor and replacement of the full Oosterbegraafplaats.

name: Ontmoeting (Aart Lamberts)
en: Ontmoeting is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Aart Lamberts made a number of identical statues around 1995. Ontmoeting was placed in the Middelveldsche Akerpolder district, on the island of the Heklaflat (address Matterhorn). Another work, Communicatie, stands in the Amsterdam Oosterpark.

name: Leda en de zwaan (Ben Guntenaar)
en: Leda en de zwaan is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is Ben Guntenaar's depiction, from 1955, of the story of Leda and the swan. The story has inspired countless artists, particularly in paintings. Guntenaar carved it from natural stone. It first stood for years in the ponds in front of the GAK building on the Bos en Lommerplein in Amsterdam-West.

name: Oorlogsgedenkteken Tuindorp Oostzaan
en: Het Oorlogsgedenkteken Tuindorp Oostzaan is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The little-known statue was made by Jan Havermans, mainly known for his war memorial Monument gefusilleerde verzetsstrijders on the Apollolaan in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Oorlogsmonument Amstelveenseweg
en: Het Oorlogsmonument Amstelveenseweg is a memorial stone for four fallen members of the Binnenlandse Strijdkrachten (BS) in shootings on the Amstelveenseweg in Amsterdam-Zuid. The whole was designed by Ferdinand Jantzen. The statue was unveiled on 25 May 1946.

name: Oorlogsmonument Gerard Terborgstraat
en: Het Oorlogsmonument Gerard Terborgstraat is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. The monument from 2017 was designed by Victor Levie.

name: Oorlogsmonument Harmoniehof
en: Het Oorlogsmonument aan het Harmoniehof is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a so-called Vrijheidsboom (Crimean linden, Tilia euchlora), planted in 1947 at the edge of one of the small parks that the Harmoniehof is rich in. The freedom tree, also known as the peace tree, is protected by an ornamental border of hardstone segments.

name: Oorlogsmonument Kinderdijkstraat
en: Het Oorlogsmonument aan de Kinderdijkstraat is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. The monument has two parts. Part 1 is a plaque, attached to the western facade of the studio homes on the Zomerdijkstraat.

name: Oorlogsmonument Witte de Withstraat
en: Het Oorlogsmonument aan de Witte de Withstraat is a memorial on the Witte de Withstraat in Amsterdam-West. The Witte de Withstraat is a street from around 1911 that runs from south to north. In its southern part, at house numbers 78-80, a stone has been placed in the facade to commemorate three war victims.

name: Zonder titel (Frans Mossou)
en: Untitled (Frans Mossou) stands on the south-western bank of the Sloterplas. It has stood there since 2003 and dates from 1988. It is a 5 metre high column by artist Frans Mossou, made of corten steel. The column is supported by a concrete slab with a screen of the same material on top.

name: Jubileumbank Vondelpark
en: De Jubileumbank Vondelpark of Oprichtersbank is a memorial bench in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Origin (Vendel & de Wolf)
en: Origin is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was designed by Vendel & de Wolf.

name: Orso
en: Orso is a statue in Amsterdam-West. The artwork from 1997/1998 stands on the northern edge of the Erasmuspark, near the Wil de Graaffbrug over the Erasmusgracht, which dates from the same period. The standing polar bear (Orso is Italian for bear) looks out over the Erasmuspark and faces away from the former Augustanakerk.

name: Oscar Carré (Fabrice Hünd)
en: Oscar Carré is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The artist Fabrice Hünd ran a studio for years in the Amsterdam district De Pijp. He was asked to celebrate the 25th jubilee of the primary school Oscar Carréschool on the Eerste Jan van der Heijdenstraat by embellishing the site fence with an artwork.

name: Oude en jonge arbeider
en: De Oude en jonge arbeider is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. In 1956 the Nederlands Verbond van Vakverenigingen (NVV) celebrated its fiftieth anniversary. It then commissioned sculptor Han Wezelaar to make a statue for that anniversary.

name: Our land
en: Our land is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Artist Judith de Leeuw placed a mural of Amy Winehouse in 2015/2016 on a blind wall of the corner building at Vijzelgracht (house number 47) and Fokke Simonszstraat.

name: Ouroboros Arborum
en: Ouroboros Arborum is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a work from 2007 by Sjoerd Buisman. The statue belongs to the art collection of that bank and stands near the Acanthusgebouw of ING Groep.

name: Oute Waal
en: Oute Waal dan wel Mollenmuur (1996) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work was initiated by Stadsdeel Oost (which had its offices here) and the Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst. It consists of a number of panels (tableaux) designed by artist Ingrid Pasmans (Amby, 1964).

name: Borstbeeld P.C. Hooft
en: The Borstbeeld P.C. Hooft is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bust was made at the request of the municipality of Amsterdam by sculptor Frits Sieger. Amsterdam marked the 300th anniversary of the death of Pieter Corneliszoon Hooft with a grand commemoration and all kinds of cultural activities.

name: Monument Peter Wilhelm Janssen
en: The Monument Peter Wilhelm Janssen is a memorial on the Bellamyplein in Amsterdam-West.

name: Paard (Theresia van der Pant)
en: Paard is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Paard en tafel
en: Paard en tafel is a two-part artistic artwork in the Waterwijk in Amsterdam-West. The artist Mathieu Nab made a set of three works around 1996, during the development of that district. A horse, a foal and a table were placed in a small park along the Waterrijkweg and Waterloop, footpaths and cycle paths that cut through the neighbourhood.

name: Paleisbeeld
en: Paleisbeeld, also known as Sarphati's visioen, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. In the years after founding it was given the nickname Eendenhotel (Duck Hotel). In Sarphatipark a bare platform stands in the pond in front of the Liefdesbruggetje. In 2020 the idea arose to fill that platform, until then used by ducks and other birds, with a statue.

name: Palen-staketsel
en: Palen-staketsel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It dates from 1987 or 2002, when the artist Ger Dekker (1943-2020) taught at the Rietveld Academie in Amsterdam. By then Dekker had long stopped working figuratively and came up with this place: a hardstone plinth from which six wooden and nine steel poles point to the sky.

name: Pancakes aan 't IJ
en: Pancakes aan 't IJ was an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist Hugo Kaagman had designed several artworks for the company Pancakes Amsterdam. He also took care of the interior fit-out for a number of branches. He gave them his personal style, with an emphasis on attributes resembling Delft blue.

name: Paradiso meteoriet
en: Paradiso meteoriet is an artistic artwork from 2026 that stands on a fenced, vacant building site south of Paradiso, Weteringschans, Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Passages (Arno van der Mark)
en: Passages is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It consists of an installation in the form of a colonnade, to a design by Arno van der Mark, placed in a gateway in the Woongebouw Piraeus. The artist worked on the work together with architect Hans Kollhoff of Piraeus.

name: Passer (kunstwerk)
en: Passer is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue depicts a pair of compasses, with which the circle on a small square in the Lizzy Ansinghstraat in De Pijp is said to have been drawn.

name: PAWS
en: PAWS is an artwork by Aisha Madu in Uilenstede, Amstelveen. The artwork consists of two sculptural cat paws, placed in front of the hospitality venue Upper East. The artwork is based on the stories of more than 75 residents and entrepreneurs about the student campus.

name: Pendulum (Gijs Assmann)
en: Pendulum is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue appeared under the percentage scheme of the Rijksgebouwendienst for the construction of the Vivaldigebouw, the new address of the European Medicines Agency at Domenico Scarlattilaan 6. A competition was held, which Gijs Assmann won.

name: Peter Alma in Station Amsterdam Amstel
en: Three artworks by Peter Alma can be seen in the station hall of Station Amsterdam Amstel.

name: Phoenix (Dannenburg)
en: Phoenix, the Monument for the Fallen in Amsterdam-Noord, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The artwork refers to the victims who fell during the bombings of Amsterdam-Noord in 1943 during the Second World War. As early as 1945 there were plans for such a monument. However, it remained quiet for a long time.

name: Phoenix (André Schaller)
en: Phoenix is a form of public art in Amsterdam-Noord. Work on Het Breed, later called Plan van Gool after Frans van Gool, took place here between 1966 and 1970. That neighbourhood came to lie within a ring ditch around the Buikslotermeer.

name: Piramide (Cornelius Rogge)
en: Piramide is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a creation by Cornelius Rogge. In the 1960s it became somewhat known for a series of tents he had made. The drawback of the series was that these artworks gradually wore out and blew away.

name: Pirateneiland
en: Pirateneiland is a mural from 2026 in Amsterdam-Oost. The Oostelijk Havengebied was converted at the end of the 20th century from a harbour area into a residential area. One of the expressions of this is the Watertoren Entrepot-West, a skyscraper in Dutch style on the C. van Eesterenlaan.

name: Plaquette Februaristaking
en: Plaquette Februaristaking is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bronze plaque was installed in 1976 on the south facade of the Noorderkerk in Amsterdam. The maker/designer is Ezechiël Jacob Hoek. It refers to a public gathering here of the Communist Party on 24 February 1941.

name: Plaquette Samuel Coster
en: The Plaquette Samuel Coster is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It actually consists of two plaques. The upper one shows a portrait of Samuel Coster, a physician by training, but also known as the founder of the first Amsterdamse Schouwburg in 1617.

name: Oorlogsmonument Laing's Nekstraat
