en: Oorlogsmonument Laing's Nekstraat is a memorial on a school grounds on the Laing's Nekstraat in Amsterdam-Oost. The school grounds lie within a residential block on the streets Laing's Nekstraat, Transvaalstraat, Smitstraat and Pretoriusstraat.

name: Plastiek in landschap
en: Plastiek in landschap (Spiegelbeeld) is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The sculpture consists of two parts, both designed by artist Hans Mantje. The whole is made of stainless steel and stands in Park de Kuil near the Cort van der Lindenkade.

name: Plastische tekens in steen
en: Plastische tekens in steen is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artwork was designed by Ben Guntenaar and consists of twenty-one arranged and worked stones, which mostly stand in groups of three. Because of the combination of lying and standing stones, it popularly acquired the name Stonehenge, but on a small scale.

name: Played rack
en: Played rack is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam. The creative artist Maze de Boer was inspired for this work by the climbing frames Iglo and Klimboog by Aldo van Eyck (English for climbing frame is Play rack) and by the drip racks that Jan van der Togt designed for Tomado (English for drip rack is Plate rack).

name: Players and supporters
en: Players and supporters is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. It is a group of four statues by artist Harmut Wilkening, placed after a redesign of this area where (many of) the Amsterdam ferries arrive and depart. The request came from the district council of Amsterdam-Noord, supported by the Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst.

name: Pluk de dag (beeld)
en: Pluk de dag is a relatively inconspicuous and little-known artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a statue or group of statues in an open space at the northern end of the Vier Heemskinderenstraat and Twee Koningskinderenstraat, near the Bos en Lommerweg. Between the two streets lies a playground combined with a meeting space with concrete benches.

name: Poëziecartouches
en: The Poëziecartouches are two artistic artworks in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Pontus (Tom Claassen)
en: Pontus is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. Artist Tom Claassen made a concrete statue of a dog for the IJpromenade behind Station Amsterdam Centraal. The almost man-high dog stood, including its dog kennel, near the place where the IJ ferries arrive and depart.

name: Poolkleed
en: Poolkleed is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is applied art from 2005/2006 by Alphons ter Avest and stands in an unnamed open space on the Barentszstraat. The little square does, however, have a street name sign reading Pleintje zonder naam (square without a name).

name: Blauwe poort (Amsterdam)
en: The Blauwe poort is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. After a thorough clean-up in the neighbourhood around the Van Beuningenstraat in the Staatsliedenbuurt, part of the streets was made car-free.

name: Poort van Nieuwendam
en: Poort van Nieuwendam (De Poort) is an artistic and architectural artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. Artist Marcel Smink (1967) won the commission around 1999 to design an artwork highlighting the junction of the IJdoornlaan and Zuiderzeeweg, which received a new traffic layout.

name: Pride (Ronald A. Westerhuis)
en: Pride is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Gedenkteken Prof. Dr. Dirk Durrer
en: The Gedenkteken Prof. Dr. Dirk Durrer is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. After the death on 3 March 1984 of cardiologist and professor of cardiology at the University of Amsterdam Dirk Durrer, a foundation was set up that worked to place a memorial somewhere in Amsterdam.

name: Borstbeeld Prins Hendrik de Zeevaarder
en: The Borstbeeld Prins Hendrik de Zeevaarder is an artwork on the Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bust was made by Frans Stracké.

name: Prometheus (Fred Carasso)
en: Prometheus is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a war memorial in memory of "sportspeople who perished" during the Second World War. The artist Fred Carasso depicted the Greek mythological figure Prometheus with a torch. According to the myth, Prometheus stole the fire of the Olympian gods to give it to humans.

name: Kubuspoort
en: The Kubuspoort is an artwork in the De Aker neighbourhood in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The "statue" stands at the edge of the Ecuplein, where bridge 1884 leads to the Pesetalaan. Marijke de Goey designed a gate several metres high, made of carelessly stacked and somewhat battered cubes, of which only the edges are made.

name: Raammannetjes
en: Raammannetjes consists of two artistic artworks in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. In the first years of the 21st century a renewal took place on the northern facade wall of the Postjesweg, between the Derkinderenstraat and Jan Tooropstraat.

name: Muurschildering Ramses Shaffy
en: The Muurschildering Ramses Shaffy, or Leef!, is a relatively small mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. Ramses Shaffy died in 2009, having lived for years in the Dr. Sarphatihuis on the Roetersstraat.

name: Raw paradise
en: Raw paradise is a form of public art in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a light installation designed by Nicky Zwaan and installed on the Kruislaanspoorbrug. In 2008 a design competition for artists was announced, which drew 350 entries.

name: Rebirth magick
en: Rebirth magick is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. Artist Camile Smeets (1983; studied at the Gerrit Rietveld Academie) is credited with the concrete statue, which was made for the exhibition Concepts of mind on the occasion of 200 years of the Rijksmuseum van Oudheden in 2018.

name: Reinaert de vos (Stefan Glerum)
en: Reinaert de vos is a mural in Amsterdam-West. When the gallery-access housing was built in the Bos en Lommerbuurt, blind walls were chosen to close off the residential blocks. These grey blind facades were seen, especially in the first years of the 21st century, as signs of gloom and decay.

name: Rembo
en: Rembo is a statue in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artist of the work is Bastienne Kramer. She was commissioned by the Slotervaart district, which required that the statue be extremely vandal-proof. Vandalism is quite frequent in and around the Rembrandtpark, where the statue stands.

name: Replacement piece
en: Replacement piece is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a work by Ger van Elk, who replaced a piece at four road surfaces in Europe with a "monochrome colour print on a sheet of stainless steel".

name: Revisiting the cullinan
en: Revisiting the cullinan is a multi-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It was designed by Sanja Medic. The objects refer to the neighbourhood in which the nine objects are located, the Diamantbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Zonder titel (Bert Meinen)
en: An untitled artistic artwork stands in a small field north-west of the junction of the Stradvlietpad and Frissensteinpad in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The artwork by Bert Meinen dates from the 1980s and, because of its shape, was popularly given the title Rietstengels (reed stalks).

name: Rise (beeld)
en: Rise is a six-metre-high form of public art in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue forms a kind of gate in the footpath at the junction of the Dr. H. Colijnstraat and the Beerenbrouckstraat, towards the Eendrachtspark.

name: Rode poes
en: Rode poes is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The cat is designed as a play structure on a playground between the Fleerde and Frissenstein apartment blocks. The designer and year of making are unknown, but the statue is said to have stood there already before the (partial) demolition of the flats in 1997/1998.

name: Rokinfontein
en: The Rokinfontein is an artwork in the form of a fountain in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work is part of the large redesign of the city centre under the name De Rode Loper. The fountain was built to a design by Mark Manders.

name: Roll on/twisted/roll off no.1
en: Roll on/twisted/roll on no.1 is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was designed by Cor de Reus (Cornelis Johannes de Reus, 1947) and was first located in the Kinkerbuurt. It was moved in 1982 to the Sloterpark (along the President Allendelaan).

name: Rona Batho
en: Rona Batho is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

name: Zonder titel (Lies Maes, Ingelandenweg)
en: Along the Osdorper Ban in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, an untitled artistic artwork can be seen. Around 1965 this little neighbourhood, known by the name De Punt (after its shape towards the west), was built up. Artist Lies Maes was asked to brighten up two blind facades on the Osdorper Ban with a sculpture.

name: Rotsvast
en: Rotsvast is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Since its placement around 1982 it went for about twenty-five years by the name of a work by an unknown artist; it simply stood there all of a sudden.

name: Rue des Reves
en: Rue de Reves is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a tribute from 2004 to the writers and brothers Karel van het Reve and Gerard van het Reve. They spent their youth on the Ploegstraat in Betondorp.

name: Ruimtestructuur
en: Ruimtestructuur is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The municipality of Amsterdam asked Ewerdt Hilgemann to design a statue in connection with the layout of the Bijlmermeer.

name: Ruiter te paard
en: Ruiter (te paard) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue on a plinth was designed and made by the sculptor Floyd DeWitt, who a year earlier had made a small statue titled Veulen for Madurodam. Ruiter te paard was supposed to be the first statue placed in the then developing neighbourhood of Buitenveldert.

name: De rustende atleet
en: De rustende atleet is an artistic artwork by Jan Havermans in Amsterdam-Zuid. The commission for this work came in May 1940 from the municipality of Amsterdam. The Second World War caused a delay. In June 1950 it was announced that the statue would then indeed come, but that first it would be lent to an international exhibition in Antwerp.

name: Rustpunten XXL
en: Rustpunten XXL is an artistic artwork in Diemen.

name: Samen zijn wij Oost
en: Samen zijn wij Oost is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is by Enzo Pérès-Labourdette.

name: Sarphatimonument
en: The Sarphatimonument is a monument honouring the 19th-century Jewish Amsterdam physician and benefactor Samuel Sarphati, in the Sarphatipark in the Amsterdam neighbourhood De Pijp. The monument was built in 1886 on a small hill made for it in the park.

name: Schaapjes
en: Schaapjes, although the neighbourhood more often speaks of Lammetjes, is a group of statues in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, in the Dutch province of Noord-Holland. On 21 October 1964 mayor Gijsbert van Hall opened the shopping centre on the Osdorpplein, which was not yet finished, designed by architect Ger Husslage.

name: Schaduwen
en: Schaduwen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a design by artist Ram Katzir. With this statue, which stands on the Olympiaplein in Amsterdam-Zuid, he gave an artistic depiction of a raid that was held in that neighbourhood on 20 June 1943. It was the last major raid within the Municipality of Amsterdam.

name: Scheibe
en: Scheibe is an artistic artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos, in the territory of Amstelveen, managed by the municipality of Amsterdam. When a section of the forest was redesigned, the idea arose to make more room for art in the Amsterdamse Bos. The Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst then engaged Ulrich Rückriem for a sculpture around 1996.

name: Schip op helling
en: Schip op helling is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work is by Marius van Beek, Hank Beelenkamp and Willem Tap. Together they depicted a ship on a slipway. The ship was hewn and cleft from a block of Belgian hard stone from Sprimont (where the work was also carried out) and is shown in simplified form.

name: Schommelstoelen en wippen
en: Schommelstoelen en wippen is a multi-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Schoolbank (beeld)
en: Schoolbank, or Gedenksteen Sint Joannesschool, is an artistic artwork in Duivendrecht. The work dates from around 2011 and was designed from an idea by architect Dick Albert and executed by the artist couple Marianne and Rob Wintershoven. It was placed in a small park northeast of Station Duivendrecht.

name: Schoolreis (Munir de Vries)
en: Schoolreis is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Artist Munir de Vries was commissioned to brighten up a grey and yellow storage place for sports goods of "De Holendrechtschool" with a mural. The surroundings and the school building were not very colourful, mainly grey and blue.

name: Senza parole
en: Senza parole (Without words) is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Sequence V
en: Sequence V, or Horizontaal beeld, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer. It is a creation by Henk van Bennekum from 1987, located in a strip of greenery along the Hugo de Vrieslaan at the height of the Pasteurstraat.

name: Toegang Wertheimpark
en: The Toegang Wertheimpark is the southern entrance gate of the Wertheimpark in Amsterdam-Centrum. When the park was still managed by the Hortus Botanicus, an entrance with railings was placed there in the mid-19th century. It consisted of four stone columns in Empire style, on which two sphinxes rest. These sphinxes were made of zinc.

name: Shelter (Andreas)
en: Shelter is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The design of the statue comes from artist Tony Andreas. It shows a tent that is not joined together; it is a shelter (to shelter is schuilen). Andreas first had an example in aluminium set up; this variant was included in the collection of the Kröller-Müller Museum.

name: Signaal 1 en 2
en: Signaal 1 en 2 is a statue in public space, consisting of two composite forms, which originally stood in the Bezuidenhout neighbourhood in The Hague. In 2024 it was given a place in the museum garden of the Amsterdam Rijksmuseum.

name: Signalerend object
en: The Signalerend object is a form of public art in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Signs of Mokum
en: Signs of Mokum is a mural in Amsterdam-West. The metres-long mural has been applied to a blind wall of the Mercator Speeltuin on the Orteliuspad, on the dividing line of Oud-West and Nieuw West. The enormous painting refers back to Amsterdam (Mokum) in the Golden Age, with all its wealth resulting from shipping.

name: Silhouetten (Marin Kasimir)
en: Silhouetten is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. In the 1990s a small urban expansion took place. North of the Molenwijk neighbourhood a small area was still unbuilt between that neighbourhood and the Ringweg-Noord. To fill that space, a small residential area was built under the neighbourhood name Walvisbuurt.

name: Buste Simon Carmiggelt
en: The Buste Simon Carmiggelt is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. In November 1987 the writer Simon Carmiggelt, a well-known Amsterdam personality, died. The idea soon arose to place a statue in the city as a tribute. Friends and acquaintances of the writer, and the public led by actor Ton van Duinhoven, collected money.

name: Sirene (Nic. Jonk, Amsterdam)
en: Sirene is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a bronze statue by Nic Jonk from 1976 depicting a siren. This graceful, seductive siren rises out of the waves with outspread wings and shows her mermaid's tail. Jonk showed her in round forms (breasts, legs, face etc.). The statue stands on a basalt plinth.

name: Slag om het Watergraafsmeer
en: Slag om het Watergraafsmeer is an educational artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work came about after several organisations in Watergraafsmeer, part of Oost, worked together. They wanted to bring into view the lost knowledge about this neighbourhood, but also the knowledge of weaving branches.

name: Rokende schipper
en: Rokende schipper is a controversial mural on the corner of the Nieuwe Foeliestraat and the Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work is by Nils Westergard.

name: Sobibór-Wat doe jij?
en: Sobibór-Wat doe jij? is an artistic artwork as well as a monument in Amsterdam-Zuid. On 4 May 2020 King Willem-Alexander of the Netherlands gave a speech during the National Commemoration of the Dead. In it the following line appeared: "Sobibór began in the Vondelpark".

name: Speelobject Beatrixpark
en: The Speelobject Beatrixpark is applied art in the Beatrixpark, Amsterdam-Zuid. The municipality of Amsterdam commissioned the design and engineering firm Carve to design a multifunctional play structure that could be placed on a disused concrete basketball court.

name: Speelplaats Falckstraat
en: Speelplaats Falckstraat is an example of applied art in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Speelplastiek (Bart van de Weijer)
en: Speelplastiek is an artistic artwork in the Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. According to the Friends of the Beatrixpark, sculptor Bart van de Weijer was commissioned by the municipality of Amsterdam in 1969 to design a statue specifically for this park. He came up with an abstract statue, which is best described as Speelplastiek.

name: Speelplastieken
en: Along the Etnastraat in Amsterdam Nieuw-West stands a series of untitled artistic artworks within the category of applied art, grouped under the name speelplastieken (play sculptures). Around 1968 Jos Wong designed twenty-one sculptures in bright colours for the Delflandplein.

name: Speeltoestel Van Eesteren Museum
en: Speeltoestel Van Eesteren Museum is applied art in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Architect Aldo van Eyck designed countless play structures for Amsterdam, which were placed on some 700 small playgrounds. Mostly they were loose structures such as the igloo and tunnel.

name: Spelende hond
en: Spelende hond is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The Norwegian artist Elena Engelsen lived in Amsterdam for a time during her marriage to the Dutch town planner Wisse. She learned sculpting in the workshop of the Buitenveldert Cemetery, a workshop that was later abolished.

name: Spelende kinderen (Gerda Rubinstein)
en: Spelende kinderen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a bronze statue by Gerda Rubinstein standing in the Oosterpark. The statue depicts a running boy with a girl on his back. Rubinstein made it on commission from the municipality of Amsterdam on the occasion of fifty years of the Amsterdamse Vacantie Kindercomité.

name: Spiegel van de hemel
en: Spiegel van de hemel is a twenty-metre-high sculpture of stainless steel by visual artist André Volten, near the former Burgerweeshuis in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue consists of two intertwined stainless steel columns that come loose from their embrace as they rise upwards.

name: Sporen volgen het Javaplantsoen
en: Sporen volgen het Javaplantsoen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Indische Buurt. It is a work or collection of works by Wim Tap, which stands or lies on the Javaplantsoen. The northern part of the small park is executed as a field of cement/asphalt that belongs to the artwork.

name: Zonder titel (Eugène van Lamsweerde)
en: On the Europaboulevard in Amsterdam-Buitenveldert stands an untitled artwork. The creation by Eugène van Lamsweerde stands on a grass field between two apartment blocks on that street, which have the address Weerdestein.

name: De Staalman
en: (De) Staalman is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue came about from a collaboration between Stadsdeel Slotervaart, the housing association De Alliantie and Face your world (Stedelijk lab Slotervaart).

name: Staat van zijn
en: Staat van zijn is a group of statues in rural Amsterdam-Noord. The five sculptures stand on the Durgerdammerdijk in Durgerdam. For addressing purposes the dike has a bulge towards the Church of Durgerdam and sports fields at the foot of the dike. The group of statues stands in front of the church among plants, shrubs and trees.

name: Stadsmuur West
en: Stadsmuur West is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The 2010 work by Rob Birza consists of a built city wall between a residential area and the Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Zeven Smartenkerk.

name: Standbeeld voor de Halsbandparkiet
en: Standbeeld voor de Halsbandparkiet is a seven-metre-high ceramic artwork by Teun Castelein in the Wilhelmina Druckerpark in Amsterdam-Noord. The work is an ode to the rose-ringed parakeet and, in a broader sense, to all "strange birds" in the city.

name: Standing stone
en: Standing stone is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It consists of a boulder on a marble plinth with the inscription STANDING STONE, 1989 - PINK, placed on the pavement in front of Overtoom 16.

name: Standbeeld van Johan Cruijff
en: Standbeeld van Johan Cruijff is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The working group "Die man verdient een standbeeld" (That man deserves a statue), which had earlier commissioned the statue Bobby Haarms, De goede beul, held a competition around 2018 to have a statue of Johan Cruijff made.

name: Standbeeld Joost van den Vondel
en: The Standbeeld Joost van den Vondel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sculptor Gerarda Rueter made a statue for a building on the Warmoesstraat in memory of the place where Joost van den Vondel lived.

name: De gekroonde valk (beeld)
en: De gekroonde valk is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. On the Hoogte Kadijk the brewery De Gekroonde Valk was located for centuries, which probably came into the hands of Van Vollenhoven en Co in 1791.

name: Standbeeld van Mahatma Gandhi (Amsterdam)
en: Mahatma Gandhi is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It depicts Mahatma Gandhi walking with a stick in his hand. The statue came about thanks to the Stichting Standbeeld Mahatma Gandhi (Vereniging Trideva), consisting mainly of Indian and Surinamese followers of Mahatma Gandhi's ideas.

name: Heilig Hartbeeld (Watergraafsmeer)
en: The Heilig Hartbeeld is a statue in the Dutch Watergraafsmeer, in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Stedemaagd (Amsterdam)
en: De Stedemaagd is a statue in the Dutch capital Amsterdam. It stands in the entrance of the Vondelpark on the Stadhouderskade. The statue stands on the middle pillar.

name: Stedenmaagd Amsterdamse Bos
en: De Stedenmaagd Amsterdamse Bos is a statue in the Amsterdamse Bos. The forest lies largely in the municipality of Amstelveen, but is owned and managed by the municipality of Amsterdam. The statue stands just within the municipality of Amsterdam, on the border with Amstelveen.

name: Stéle
en: Stéle is an artistic artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos, territory of Amstelveen, managed by the municipality of Amsterdam. When a section of the forest was redesigned, the idea arose to make more room for art in the Amsterdamse Bos. The Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst then engaged Ulrich Rückriem for a sculpture around 1996.

name: Stenen sculptuur met tulp
en: Stenen sculptuur met tulp, or simply Pleinbeeld, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue was designed by the little-known artist Harry van Renswou. Stadsdeel Zeeburg asked for a statue for the newly laid-out Timorplein. According to Buitenkunst Amsterdam, a steel and bronze form rests on a concrete slab.

name: Stenen tapijt
en: The Stenen tapijt is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. When the public space between the Oranje-Nassau Kazerne and the Singelgracht was laid out, the Wilhelmina Blombergplein came into being. Artist Agnes van Genderen was asked to provide the former exercise ground (drill grounds etc.) with an artwork.

name: Steve van Dorpel (beeld)
en: Steve(n) van Dorpel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. In 1990 Nelson Carrilho received the request and commission to make a statue of footballer Steve van Dorpel, who died in 1989 during the SLM disaster. The initiator of the statue was SV Bijlmer (Sportvereniging Bijlmer), where Van Dorpel began playing football at a young age.

name: Stier (Beursplein, Amsterdam)
en: De Stier is an artwork on the Beursplein in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Stoere bloemen
en: Stoere bloemen is a group of statues in Amsterdam-West. It is a joint work on the initiative of artist Marieke Bolhuis; it was her first commission for work in public space. She was commissioned by the municipality of Amsterdam to brighten up a small green on the Erik de Roodestraat with an artistic artwork.

name: Stoet (Dagmar de Kok)
en: Stoet is an artistic artwork by Dagmar de Kok, standing in Reigersbos I, Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The three-part work stands on the southern quay of the Snellerwaardgracht, by the Ouder Kind Centrum Gaasperdam, which had just been renewed at the time.

name: Straalcompositie
en: Straalcompositie is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work by Henk Zweerus came with the completion of a telephone exchange on the L. van Sonsbeeckstraat, Osdorp. The artwork is executed in the materials and colours of the original building by architect B.J. Odink.

name: Straatkleed Henrick de Keijserstraat
en: The Straatkleed Henrick de Keijserstraat is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, De Pijp. It is a street painting by Marjet Wessels Boer. The housing corporation Stadgenoot allowed her to place an artwork to close off a renovation project of what in the early 21st century were called the Bakkerpanden.

name: Streets of the world
en: Streets of the World is a public photo exhibition by Jeroen Swolfs. Over seven years Swolfs photographed street scenes in 195 capital cities of the world, except in places where that was not permitted for military reasons (e.g. Chad).

name: Stuck (Nouch)
en: Stuck is a mural on a stone site boundary on the Korte 's-Gravesandestraat in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Surround sound (Kenor)
en: Surround sound is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The title refers to surround sound.

name: Tabula rasa (Hans Mantje)
en: Tabula rasa, popularly known as Gebroken tafel (broken table), is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. Artist Hans Mantje designed a statue in the form of a broken table for the Buikslotermeerplein, where from 1982 it stood in front of the district office Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Voor de bijen
en: Voor de bijen, also known as Bijentafels, is an artwork by Frank Mandersloot from 2004 in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue stands at the junction of the Piet Heinkade, the road to and from the Piet Heintunnel, the Panamalaan and the former exit of the Czaar Peterstraat, south-west of the Rietlandpark.

name: Tectona Grandis (Amsterdam)
en: Tectona Grandis is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, De Aker. The artwork by Marinus Boezem consists of 33 so-called tree discs of granite. The surfaces are polished and reflect the cloudy sky (when present), while the edges are rough.

name: Teken (Egidius Knops)
en: Teken is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. Egidius Knops designed this abstract stainless steel statue in 1984/1985 as part of a structure plan for the neighbourhood around the Westerpark. It was then placed on the Zaanstraat/Polanenstraat near the Zaandijkspoorbrug.

name: Teken (Marianne van den Heuvel)
en: Teken is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue is a creation by Marianne van den Heuvel, among others for the Stichting Memento Gedenkbeelden.

name: Terreinafscheiding Johanna Westerdijkplein(tje)
en: Terreinafscheiding Johanna Westerdijkplein(tje) is applied art on the Johanna Westerdijkplein(tje) in Amsterdam-Oost. That little square is not an official square, but got its name after a redesign of an open spot left over during an extensive clean-up within the Dapperbuurt, mainly along the passing Pieter Nieuwlandstraat.

name: Terugblik en Toekomst der Spoorwegen
en: Terugblik en Toekomst der Spoorwegen are two artworks by the Dutch artist Theo van Reijn. The two statues can be seen in and around Amstelstation on the Julianaplein in Amsterdam. The artworks were made on the occasion of the opening of Amstelstation in 1939.

name: Tetraëder met cirkel
en: Tetraëder met cirkel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work was funded by the municipality of Amsterdam as well as the province of Noord-Holland. It was originally placed in the Open Havenfront in front of Station Amsterdam Centraal.

name: Teun de Jager
en: Teun de Jager is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Vondelpark. Jan Bronner made the Hildebrandmonument on commission from Haarlem. The request came as early as 1914, but Bronner only finished the statue group in 1947; it was not unveiled until 1963.

name: Het buikschot
en: Het buikschot is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a monument in memory of three men who were shot dead on the spot here on 15 December 1944 by the German occupier, in retaliation for an attack on the railway line earlier that day.

name: The circus has left town...We just stuck around
en: The circus has left town... We just stuck around is a mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Flowers (Karel Appel)
en: Flowers is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artwork of four bronze flowers stands on the Oosterspoorplein in the fork of Station Amsterdam Muiderpoort. Karel Appel made the original on his estate near Florence.

name: The fountain (Karel Appel)
en: The fountain is an artistic artwork in Amstelveen. Karel Appel made a first version in 1992 with the original materials of wood, plaster and papier-mache. Around 2001 he cast it in bronze. It was placed for his eightieth birthday (Appel was born in 1921) in front of the Cobra Museum voor Moderne Kunst, which was then six years old, on the Sandbergplein.

name: The great wall (Gerti Bierenbroodspot)
en: The great wall is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. The Lange Leidsedwarsstraat is a centuries-old little street in Amsterdam-Centrum. In the 21st century too, the street has an almost closed facade wall. The exception is where house numbers 156 and 158 stood until 1970. They were demolished that year because of dilapidation.

name: Het huis aan het water
en: Het huis aan het water is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a creation by artist Dicky Brand, placed on the green strip south of the Zuider Amstelkanaal, which bears the name of Henri Viottakade. It stands just north of the corner of the Prinses Marijkestraat.

name: The last dance
en: The last dance (also known as Dansend paar) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. At the end of the 1990s a small neighbourhood was built on an agricultural patch of land between De Nieuwe Noorder and Rijksweg 10 (Ringweg-Noord), and since its existence it has been given several different names.

name: The light kite
en: The light kite (Dutch: De lichte vlieger or De lichtvlieger) is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work from 2016 by Saskia Hoogendoorn and Lieuwe Martijn Wijnands takes the form of a kite.

name: The long hum
en: The long hum (De lange adem) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. Theo Niermeijer depicted in the work the last syllable (hum) of Om mani padme hum.

name: The magic bats
en: The magic bats is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. The Lange Leidsedwarsstraat is a centuries-old little street in Amsterdam-Centrum. In the 21st century too, the street has a nearly closed facade wall. The exception is where house numbers 156 and 158 stood until 1970. They were demolished that year because of dilapidation.

name: The mask (muurschildering)
en: The mask is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. This mural on a blind wall of a Liander building on the Hoogte Kadijk, corner Geschutswerf, came about at the initiative of Anouk Piket. She worked for a long time in Brazil and became acquainted there with graffiti artist Fefe Talavera (born 1979).

name: The miracle garden
en: The miracle garden is a natural artwork located in the Erasmuspark in Amsterdam-West. This art and nature project grew out of a blog titled The Studio Garden. That was a project starting in the garden belonging to the studio on the Witte de Withstraat of artist Elspeth Diederix.

name: Nachtwacht 3D
en: De Nachtwacht 3D (also De Nachtwacht in drie dimensies) is a sculpture group that stood on the Rembrandtplein in Amsterdam in front of the Rembrandt monument from 2006 until 11 February 2020.

name: Sinaasappels van Halfweg
en: De sinaasappels van Halfweg (The oranges of Halfweg) is an artwork standing on the Mientekade/Houtijkstraat in Halfweg. It is a statue made by artist Mike Pratt, placed following the construction and completion of a new housing district in Halfweg. A design competition was announced, which Pratt won.

name: The sailing man
en: The sailing man is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The creator of the work is Alphons Freijmuth/Freymuth. The statue was designed at the request of the city of Amsterdam, which commissioned an artwork for the Kattenburgerplein, referring to the maritime history of Kattenburg.

name: The underground tree
en: The underground tree is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The artist is Tanja Smeets. The work is a tribute to an old chestnut tree that had to be felled because of disease. For visitors to the Westerpark and the Westergasfabriek it was an eye-catcher and a landmark when entering the grounds.

name: The white cube
en: The white cube is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a light installation by Giny Vos from 2012. Giny Vos has several artworks in Amsterdam, such as White noise in Amsterdam-Zuid. The reason for placing The white cube was less romantic.

name: Theo Thijssen (beeld)
en: Theo Thijssen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sculptor Hans Bayens portrayed the schoolmaster Theo Thijssen and his eternal pupil Kees de jongen. Theo sits nonchalantly on the lectern, while Kees sits struggling behind it. The scene is cast in bronze and placed on a granite plinth.

name: They tried to bury us, but they didn't know we were seeds
en: They tried to bury us, but they didn't know we were seeds is a mural of 700 m², painted on the floor of the basketball court on the Museumplein in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Tijden van groei
en: Tijden van groei is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artwork was sponsored by De Nederlandsche Bank in a period when its head office on the Westeinde underwent a thorough renovation. The round tower disappeared and the shell of the remaining building was stripped.

name: Toegang Botanische tuin Zuidas
en: De Toegang Botanische tuin Zuidas is applied art in Amsterdam-Zuid. When the Hortus Botanicus Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam was transformed into the Botanische tuin Zuidas, it was felt that the park, which lay somewhat out of the way, had to become "more visible".

name: Totempaal (Rietbroek)
en: Totempaal is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a sculpture by Aart Rietbroek. The bronze statue was placed as a result of the 1% scheme, under which 1 percent of the construction budget of public buildings had to be spent on art.

name: Totempaal (Alphons Freijmuth)
en: Totempaal, or Totem, is the common designation of an untitled artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The totem pole is a work by artist Alphons Freijmuth, who designed the statue for the Drachten agency of De Nederlandsche Bank. In 1991 it moved to the Hoogeveen branch because of the closure of the Drachten agency.

name: Tranen voor het verzet
en: Tranen voor het verzet, or Twee tranen, is an artwork by Bernard Heesen in one of the passageways of the Max Euweplein in central Amsterdam. The artwork commemorates the former Huis van Bewaring on the Weteringschans. During the occupation in the Second World War this building was used by the Sicherheitsdienst and the Gestapo.

name: Transit (Claudia Kölgen)
en: Transit is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. For the redevelopment of the Java island from harbour area into a residential district, architect and urban planner Sjoerd Soeters developed not only the layout; he also designed a number of buildings. Several of his buildings were then decorated with an artwork.

name: Gedenkteken Truus Wijsmuller-Meijer
en: Het Gedenkteken Truus Wijsmuller-Meijer is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bronze portrait or bust of Truus Wijsmuller-Meijer was made on commission from the City of Amsterdam by artist Herman Diederik Janzen in 1964. On 20 September 1965 it was unveiled at the Beatrixoord Ziekenhuis on the northern edge of the Oosterpark.

name: Tulpen palepai
en: Tulpen palepai (English: Tulip palepai, Navigating the river of the world) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artwork from 2017 is a creation by Jennifer Tee and one of eight artworks in Amsterdam that were initiated by the construction of Amsterdam Metro line 52 (Noord/Zuidlijn).

name: Tulpmonument
en: The Tulpmonument is a monument at the Westgaarde Cemetery in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It consists of two parts.

name: Tussentijd
en: Tussentijd (English: Between time) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Twee hondjes
en: Twee hondjes is an artistic diptych in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. During the redesign of the Postjesweg between 1999 and 2002, Marjolijn Mandersloot was approached in Amsterdam to design an artwork. She came up with two little dogs; Mandersloot specialises in animal figures.

name: Twee kinderen
en: Twee kinderen is an artwork placed in the Siegerpark, Riekerpolder, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue by Hildo Krop has been part of the sculpture garden of the park since 1998. Krop's work as city sculptor is widely spread throughout Amsterdam, especially in the neighbourhoods from the 1920s of the 20th century.

name: Twee silhouetten
en: Twee silhouetten is a hard stone sculpture by the Belgian artist Huib Fens. The statue consists of two cut-out figures of arduin (bluestone) on a base plate. It stands on a grassland between the Sarphatistraat and the Plantage Muidergracht, opposite the block of houses between the Kazernestraat and the Alexanderstraat.

name: Zonder titel (Dirk Müller)
en: In the Martin Luther Kingpark in Amsterdam-Zuid lies an untitled artwork. It is in the part of the park west of the Utrechtsebrug. The artwork consists of a rock split into two parts. The artist Dirk Müller wanted to intervene as little as possible in the material during the period of making (1976).

name: Twijfel zaaien
en: Twijfel zaaien is an artistic and biological installation in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Two frames
en: Two frames is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The abstract work consists of two obliquely standing, identical frameworks of aluminium placed on a recessed ground surface. The artist is Shlomo Koren, who worked with the colours black, grey and white; here mainly grey.

name: U bevindt zich hier
en: U bevindt zich hier is an art project in Amsterdam-Oost. The Oostpoort neighbourhood was fully built up in the early years of the 21st century, after extensive clearance had taken place. At about the same time the project 'Erfenis van de twintigste eeuw' ran in the neighbourhood.

name: Uit de driehoek I
en: Uit de driehoek I is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a creation by artist Yvonne Kracht from 1976. In those years she produced a series of works in which a simple figure such as a circle, square or triangle was pulled apart or folded. There are therefore several versions of "Uit de driehoek", "Uit het vierkant" and so on to be found.

name: Zonder titel (Jan van der Ploeg)
en: Under the Oude Haagsebrug in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, an untitled pillar painting by Jan van der Ploeg can be seen as of 2024. Artist Van der Ploeg (1959) specialises in murals, some of which are temporary and others permanent. The painting under this structure falls into the second category.

name: Zonder titel (Piet Dieleman)
en: On the Java island in the Dutch capital Amsterdam, an untitled two-part artwork by Piet Dieleman hangs above the walking and cycling route. It concerns metal frames placed in 2000 that hang on facades like a signboard. They became known colloquially as Violet en geel.

name: Zonder titel (Tim Rodermans, spoorbrug)
en: Under the railway bridge over the Muiderstraatweg in the Dutch municipality of Diemen (province of Noord-Holland), an untitled artwork has been placed on the abutments.

name: Urban jungle
en: Urban jungle is a mural in graffiti style (graffiti painting) in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a work by artist Tim Rodermans. He regularly provides blind facades with murals of all sizes. Rodermans regularly cycled up and down the Sarphatistraat and saw at the height of Sarphatistraat 163 an ideal spot for a large work.

name: Vadermonument
en: The Vadermonument (earlier Vader en kind) is an artwork at Zorgvlied. That cemetery lies within the municipality of Amstelveen, but is often counted as part of Amsterdam.

name: Van Cuyp tot Dou
en: Van Cuyp tot Dou is a mural in Amsterdam-Zuid. The ground floor of the building of the former Stadsbank van Lening on Gerard Doustraat 156 in Amsterdam was converted into a bicycle parking facility in 2017 and 2018.

name: Vanitasborden
en: The Vanitasborden (1994) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Artist Peter Baren drew inspiration for this work from the painting Vanitas by Adriaen van Nieulandt, which is in the collection of the Frans Halsmuseum in Haarlem. Van Nieulandt expressed the pointlessness of vanity within human life.

name: Monument Vaz Dias
en: The Monument Vaz Dias is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work by Herman van der Heide stands on the Weesperstraat just south of the M.S. Vaz Diasbrug, for which Van der Heide designed the railings and a name plate. The name refers to Mozes Salomon Vaz Dias, founder of the press bureau M.S. Vaz Dias.

name: Air cells
en: Air cells is applied art in Amsterdam-West.

name: De geboorte van Venus (Meursing)
en: De geboorte van Venus is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. This creation, dating from 1963, was designed and made by artist Wicher Meursing. The statue has stood since that year in a green strip along the rear facades of the odd-numbered houses on the Dirk Bonstraat.

name: Verdoonermonument
en: The Verdoonermonument is a monument in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Wapen van Amsterdam (Frans Werner)
en: The Wapen van Amsterdam is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. For the "Vereeniging bouwmaatschappij tot verkrijging van eigen woning" (a building society for acquiring one's own home), architect Piet Kramer designed a block of houses on the Uiterwaardenstraat, Dintelstraat, the then still unnamed President Kennedylaan and Maasstraat.

name: Verzetsmonument Halfweg
en: The Verzetsmonument Halfweg is a war memorial in Halfweg in the municipality of Haarlemmermeer. The monument consists of a plinth and a statue. The statue was designed by Jan Havermans. He depicted a resistance fighter who, with raised arm, calls on people to resist.

name: Verschuivingen
en: Verschuivingen is a sculpture designed by Ben Guntenaar, standing at the end of the Churchill-laan in Amsterdam-Zuid. The six-metre-high statue was made by Guntenaar at the request of the city of Amsterdam to celebrate the 700th anniversary of the city in 1975.

name: Verticale compositie
en: Verticale compositie is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Verzetsmonument Apollolaan
en: The Verzetsmonument Apollolaan is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The monument, based on a design by Jan Havermans, is placed in the median strip of the Apollolaan west of its junction with the Beethovenstraat.

name: Verzonken schepen
en: Verzonken schepen is the imaginary title of a two-part artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. In the 2000s the grade-separated junction between the Nieuwe Leeuwarderweg and the Nieuwe Purmerweg in Amsterdam-Noord was redesigned under bridge 932.

name: Verzonken toren
en: Verzonken toren is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a statue by Rik van Dolderen that has stood in the Ringvaart (Watergraafsmeer) since 1987. Van Dolderen made art that drew on urbanisation. The Verzonken toren is said to reflect the buildings on the northern side of the Transvaalkade, quay of the said ring canal.

name: Vier vormen in graniet
en: Vier vormen in graniet is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The maker André Volten wanted these granite blocks to allow an experience of the material. The blocks stand like upright edges of a cube on a square base paved with cobblestones. Two faces of each block are polished; the other two faces are rough.

name: Vijf wolken
en: Articulate, colloquially known as Vijf wolken, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a creation by artist Bert van Loo. The artwork was placed around 1993 in front of the Instituut voor Taxonomische Zoölogie, which was located at Mauritskade 61 in the Oosterparkbuurt. The institute researched, among other things, crustaceans.

name: Vlaggenmonument
en: The Vlaggenmonument is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Marte Röling created this flagpole for the Amsterdams Medisch Centrum around 1984. The flagpole consists of a flag draped crumpled around a concrete mast. It is said to be a parody or homage to flags fluttering on all kinds of (government) buildings.

name: Vleugelvormen (Gerard Bruning)
en: Vleugelvormen is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a creation by artist Gerard Bruning. According to Kunstwacht Amsterdam (manager of art in public spaces), he apparently wanted to depict here the sails of windmills or the tail sections of aircraft. The wings are arranged in the directions of the X, Y and Z axes (sideways, upward, forward).

name: Vliegend (Amsterdam)
en: Vliegend is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a statue by Wessel Couzijn from 1955 that was placed in 1956 at the De Olijftak church in the garden city of Slotermeer. According to a report of the church's opening in 1956 by the Algemeen Handelsblad, the statue was meant to depict a bird with an olive branch.

name: Afrika ontwaakt
en: Afrika ontwaakt, also known as Ontwakend Afrika and Vliegend, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue dates from 1961 and is by Wessel Couzijn. It is one of his expressive statues. That period started in the 1950s, when he, together with Shinkichi Tajiri, Hans Verhulst, Ben Guntenaar and Carel Kneulman, founded Groep A'dam.

name: Vliegende schotels
en: Vliegende schotels is an artistic artwork and applied art in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The artwork by Wim Winnubst came about in collaboration with the primary school Santenkraam (merged into Samenspel from 2009). It is then 1985 and the pupils asked for a play object in the form of "something to fly into".

name: Vliegende vogels
en: Vliegende vogels is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Artist Jannes Limperg made the bronze statue for the Christelijk MAVO on the Nieuwe Laan in Osdorp. That school had opened in 1971 and therefore expected the statue. The artist, however, had bad luck.

name: Vlindermolen (Herman Makkink)
en: Vlindermolen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a creation by Herman Makkink, who had a fondness for brick constructions. The latter can be found here in the "plinth", which consists of a half sphere standing slightly out of level.

name: Vlucht van kennis
en: Vlucht van kennis is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work by artist Jentsje Popma hangs on the north facade of a building at the junction of the Aletta Jacobslaan and the Johan Huizingalaan.

name: Voetbalkooi Geschutswerf
en: Voetbalkooi Geschutswerf is applied art in Amsterdam-Centrum. Both football and (crosswise) basketball can be played there.

name: Vogel met klaprozen
en: Vogel met klaprozen is a mural by Tim Rodermans and Karskione.

name: Vogel op pyloon
en: Vogel op pyloon is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. This abstractly designed bird is the work of Dolf Breetvelt. He was engaged to deliver an artwork during the redesign of the University of Amsterdam grounds on and around Roeterseiland around 1968.

name: Vogelhotel
en: The Vogelhotel is a structure placed in Amsterdam's Oosterpark. It is both a structure and applied art.

name: Vogeltjes van Kattenburg
en: Vogeltjes van Kattenburg is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artwork can be found in the underpass from the Kattenburgerkruisstraat to the Olifantswerf. That underpass forms part of a concrete low-rise block of flats from around 1976, designed by Dick Apon and/or Toon ter Braak, who had an office together.

name: Vondelfontein
en: De Vondelfontein is a drinking fountain in Amsterdam's Vondelpark. The fountain was donated by Luigi Prins (Cobraspen Groep) and placed in the park on 19 June 2009. It was designed by architect Jan Willem Walraad, based on photos of a drinking fountain that once stood in the park.

name: Vondelhappertjes
en: De Vondelhappertjes form a multi-part artistic artwork within applied art in the Vondelpark, Amsterdam-Zuid. Over the years an extensive art collection has been built up scattered throughout that park. The largest of these is the Vondelmonument by Louis Royer from 1867.

name: Voor de verpleging
en: Voor de verpleging is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is a tribute from 1992 by artist Liesbeth Pallesen (1955) to nurses Anna Reynvaan and Jeltje de Bosch Kemper. On 4 and 5 October 1892 they held two gatherings within the "Congres voor Ziekenverpleging" (Congress for Nursing the Sick) in reserved rooms inside the Wilhelmina Gasthuis.

name: Voor water
en: Voor water is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Artist Harald Schole made a statue for the newly established A.S. Onderwijzerhof that refers to the synagogue on the square. The bronze part is his interpretation of the light-permeable dome.

name: Voortdurend
en: Voortdurend is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. When the Spaarndammertunnel was built, a section of the historic Spaarndammerdijk disappeared. It was dug away to make room for that tunnel, and with it a historic place was lost; for centuries that Spaarndammerdijk had kept water of the Zuiderzee/IJ out of this area.

name: Vreemde vogels (beeld)
en: Vreemde vogels-Monument voor verdraagzaamheid is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. Artist Fredie Beckmans (1956) wanted with this "statue" to emphasise that differences in origin, religion, sexuality or way of life do not (should not) matter. All "strange birds" are equally important.

name: Vrijheidscarillon
en: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a carillon made in 1952 by the firm A.H. van Bergen in Heiligerlee, on the initiative of the Nederlandse Comité Nationale Herdenking. It hung in several locations, including on the Dam in 1955. It was offered to the City of Amsterdam in 1960.

name: Vrouw met stola
en: Vrouw met stola is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The statue came about thanks to a sculpture trail set up by the Stichting Beeldende Kunst. One of the statues was supplied by Pieter d'Hont; however, it is already older.

name: Wachter (Eric Claus)
en: Wachter is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The guard in the form of a knight on horseback stands along the Ookmeerweg at the height of the entrance to the Westgaarde Cemetery (near the Osdorperban). Eric Claus carved the guard from shell limestone around 1977 for this location. The surface has remained coarse (not polished).

name: Walenweeskinderen
en: Walenweeskinderen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Felix van Kalmthout made a bronze statue of nine walking orphan children around 1984, presumably on their way from the orphanage to church or the reverse. The statue, with its pedestal, has stood on a plinth on the Weteringstraat since 1984.

name: Wandelend muurtje
en: Wandelend muurtje is a statue by Dutch visual artist Jan Snoeck (1927-2018) in Amsterdam. The work is a ceramic sculpture in two parts: a rectangular blue gate and a red figure with twisted legs.

name: Herdenkingsmonument (Mischa Rakier)
en: Herdenkingsmonument, also known as Herdenken en herinnering, is an artistic artwork in the Gijsbrecht van Amstelpark, Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue by artist Mischa Rakier (born in Delft in 1970) was placed in 2014 following a commission from the City of Amsterdam and Stadsdeel Zuid.

name: Oorlogsmonument Jan van Eijckstraat 47
en: The Oorlogsmonument Jan van Eijckstraat 47 is a memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. At the outbreak of the Second World War, two school buildings stood on the north and south edges of the Adama van Scheltemaplein.

name: Water, aarde, lucht
en: Water, aarde, lucht is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a stone relief by Jan Meefout, which he carved himself into a freestanding column near the Nieuwe Meersluis. It was a commission from the City of Amsterdam and would remain Meefout's largest commission. Meefout first sketched the design.

name: Waterdraagster met vissen
en: Waterdraagster met vissen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. In the small park of the Bellamyplein there originally (1905) stood a classic fountain. The planting fell into chaos and the City of Amsterdam cleared it; the fountain made way for a paddling pool designed by Ko Mulder.

name: Watergordijn
en: The Watergordijn is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Architect Hans Hagenbeek designed a number of new homes for the Zuiderkerkhof, after the buildings there were demolished to make way for the construction of the Oostlijn of the Amsterdam Metro.

name: Watermuur Rembrandtpark
en: De Watermuur Rembrandtpark is a combination of a fountain and public art in Amsterdam-West. The placing of the water wall was part of a long-term renovation (2017-2031) of the Rembrandtpark, which has to be tackled every so many years because of subsidence.

name: Watertafel Botteskerkpark
en: De Watertafel Botteskerpark is an example of applied art in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, Osdorp. The design comes from Karres en Brands Landschapsarchitecten. It was placed in 2011 in the Botteskerkpark, a green strip on the Botteskerksingel. The water table is an artistic artwork on which children can play.

name: Waterwiel
en: The Waterwiel is a combination of a fountain and an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Water is pumped up through a pipe from a basin, and then flows through a protruding pipe and distributor cap into the open air. Under the pipe and distributor cap, twelve leaking metal buckets turn on a rotating wheel.

name: Wegwerphuisje
en: Het Wegwerphuisje is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a creation by artist Herman Makkink. The small house stands on an embankment of the Cornelis Lelylaan near the Sloterplas. Makkink made a small house that displays all kinds of brick jointing (or the lack of it): horizontal, vertical, diagonal, sawtooth figures and so on.

name: Welkom-Goededag
en: Welkom-Goededag is a mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Wensplein voor vrede
en: Het Wensplein voor vrede is an unofficial square with an official statue in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located south-west of the entrance to the remains of the Amsterdamse Muiderkerk. Officially the square forms part of the Linnaeusstraat.

name: Dr. F.M. Wibaut
en: Dr. F.M. Wibaut is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a statue portrait of Floor Wibaut. It is a corner stone at the point where the buildings of the Henriëtte Ronnerplein (even house numbers) give way to those of the Henriëtte Ronnerstraat.

name: White noise (kunstwerk)
en: White noise is a light artwork on the Telecomtoren Zuidas in Amsterdam-Zuid. It concerns the light installation "Handschrift van het universum" (Handwriting of the universe). The work by Giny Vos was put into operation in 2009.

name: Wilhelmina Drucker-monument
en: The Wilhelmina Drucker-monument is a memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue was funded by a collection organised by the "Comité huldeblijk Wilhelmina Drucker" (Committee for Tribute to Wilhelmina Drucker). Sculptor Gerrit van der Veen was engaged to make the statue.

name: Windbuilroute
en: Windbuilroute is a group of statues in the Molenwijk in Amsterdam-Noord. In 1974 artist Herman Damen was asked to design an alternative to the wayfinding markers in the neighbourhood. Molenwijk is not only the name of the neighbourhood, but also of all the footpaths and cycle paths in it.

name: Windgolf (Irene Vonck)
en: Windgolf is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord, Terrasdorp. Irene Vonck (born 1952) is mainly known as a ceramicist, trained by Jan van der Vaart, but was afterwards influenced by West Coast Ceramics in California. The Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam owns eleven works by her.

name: Windzuil
en: Windzuil is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The sculpture by artist Cornelius Rogge is placed in the Gerbrandypark. It stands just north of the Burgemeester van Tienhovengracht near the Ina Boudier-Bakkerbrug. Whether the artist was inspired by the Oriental pillars of architect Piet Kramer on that bridge is unknown.

name: Zonder titel (Alfred Eikelenboom, Amsterdam)
en: At the junction of the Europaboulevard and the Van Boshuizenstraat in Amsterdam-Buitenveldert stands an untitled artwork. This three-part creation by Alfred Eikelenboom stands on a roundabout.

name: Zonder titel (Anna Enquist, Ferdinand Bolstraat)
en: On the Ferdinand Bolstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid an untitled artwork stood between 2017 and 2021. It consisted of lines of poetry by Anna Enquist applied to three benches on the Ferdinand Bolplein. After the redesign and repaving of De Bol, a number of small benches were placed here.

name: Witte bollenboom
en: Witte bollenboom is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The title for the work was given by artist Timo Goosen, who made a sculpture in the form of a pure white tree with all kinds of whimsical branches. The artwork stands in a wild grass field on the west side of the park De Oeverlanden.

name: Woezel
en: Woezel is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The creation by Marijke van Lis standing in the Zaanhof forms, together with a woezel family in Amsterdam-Noord, a split unity. Referring to a larger woezel (Woezelflat) at the Floriade 1972, the artist explained it.

name: Wolken (Raymond Perridon)
en: Wolken is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The work by Raymond Perridon (Den Bosch, 1943) consists of three poles on which a number of two-dimensional clouds cross each other. The whole stands on a concrete foundation in a pond in the Bijlmerweide park, near the low-rise neighbourhood Kantershof.

name: Vrouwen met schalen
en: Vrouwen met schalen is a group of four statues in Amsterdam-Zuid, Vondelpark. The ceramic group of four has stood since 1953, two by two, on the steps of the Vondelparkpaviljoen. The maker of the statues is Leo Braat, who was inspired by pre-Columbian cultures. The bowls above their heads were, over the years, used as plant containers.

name: Woutertje Pieterse en Femke
en: Woutertje Pieterse en Femke is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The City of Amsterdam commissioned the already elderly sculptor Frits Sieger to make a statue referring to the novel Woutertje Pieterse by Eduard Douwes Dekker. Sieger was inspired by the embrace of Woutertje by Femke, daughter of a washerwoman.

name: Wubboboom
en: De Wubboboom is a living memorial and monument standing on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam-Centrum. Almost immediately after the death of physicist Wubbo Ockels (18 May 2014), the idea arose in the Amsterdam city council of creating a living monument for him in the ground.

name: Verzetsmonument (De Nieuwe Ooster)
en: Het Monument voor de verzetsstrijders is a monument standing at the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Yellow wings
en: Yellow wings is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The artwork came about in the period 2011-2015. The Bijlmermeer was at that time undergoing a large-scale clearance, in which some neighbourhoods were given a completely different layout.

name: Your life is calling
en: Your life is calling, nicknamed Vuisten or De handjes, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a sculptural group of clenched fists of reinforced concrete rising out of the ground. The size is 2 by 2 by 1.8 metres and the weight is over 5000 kilos. The artists Paul Pieck and Benno Réwinkel made it themselves in their studio on the Admiraal de Ruyterweg.

name: Boomzagertje
en: Het Boomzagertje, Houtzagertje or Het zagertje, is a small, inconspicuous statue in the Leidsebosje in Amsterdam. It consists of a little man sawing on a thick overhanging branch; until October 2019 he did so in the southernmost plane tree. He does so bending forward, between his legs.

name: Zonder titel (Margot Zanstra)
en: Between two joined former office buildings from 1972 on the Staalmeesterslaan and the Jan Evertsenstraat in Amsterdam stands an untitled artwork. It is a geometric sculpture designed by Margot Zanstra. Her husband Piet Zanstra designed the two concrete, massive-looking buildings.

name: Zeegezicht aan het IJ
en: Zeegezicht aan het IJ is an artwork by Irma Boom in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artwork is located in the Cuyperspassage on the west side of Amsterdam Centraal station and consists of a 110 metre long wall of tiles. Irma Boom was inspired by 's Lands schip Rotterdam and the herring fleet of Cornelis Pieterszoon Boumeester (1652-1733).

name: Zeelandbank
en: Zeelandbank, officially the Schouwse bank, is a memorial bench and artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bench was designed by Nico Onkenhout as a thank-you from the island of Schouwen-Duiveland to the City of Amsterdam. Amsterdam had supported the municipalities on the island after the Watersnood (flood disaster) of 1953.

name: Zeelui (muurschildering)
en: Zeelui is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. In the 2020s the housing association Lieven de Key was developing a campus near the Kweekschool voor de Zeevaart. Old (18th/19th century) and new (1980s) buildings were combined, with renovation and new construction of a number of student homes on the site.

name: Zeeman (Joost Barbiers)
en: Zeeman is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The statue dates from around 1980 and is by sculptor Joost Barbiers. He modelled a sturdy standing seaman who appears to be on lookout. He stands with his arms folded, in rainproof clothing, with his legs somewhat apart so that he stands more stably.

name: Zeeman op de uitkijk
en: Zeeman op de uitkijk is a war memorial placed in Amsterdam-Oost. The monument was made by Pieter Starreveld in 1949/1950 on commission from the Stoomvaart-Maatschappij Nederland (SMN). The company ordered a statue in memory of the 321 SMN seamen who died during the Second World War.

name: Zeemeermin (Leo Braat)
en: De Zeemeermin is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue, with its fountain, was ordered by the City of Amsterdam around 1940 from sculptor Leo Braat for placement at the edge of the Pierenbad in the Beatrixpark. Braat first made a full-size clay model so that it could be cast in bronze in September 1940.

name: Zen Mast
en: Zen Mast (tatramajjhattata) is an artwork from 2023 by artist Jeroen Doorenweerd, which lies in the basin of the Amsterdam Houthaven. The work consists of a 30 metre high mast of worked softwood, which rests underwater on three 9 metre long tubular piles, but otherwise seems to float freely.

name: Zes betegelde zuilen
en: Zes betegelde zuilen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. They stand in a space that connects the Derde Oosterparkstraat (between 338 and 360) and the Vrolikstraat (house numbers 475 through 549) for pedestrians by means of an inner courtyard.

name: Zeven teksten
en: Zeven teksten is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Zevenlandenhuizen
en: Zevenlandenhuizen is a row of houses on the Roemer Visscherstraat in the Amsterdam Vondelparkbuurt.

name: Zigeunermonument Hel en vuur
en: The Zigeunermonument Hel en vuur on the Amsterdam Museumplein is a bronze statue of a man, a woman and two children fleeing from a blazing fire. The statue stands on a masonry plinth and is 3.50 m high. The maker is sculptor Heleen Levano.

name: Zitstenen Jan van Zutphenplantsoen
en: The Zitstenen Jan van Zutphenplantsoen consists of five stone benches in the Jan van Zutphenplantsoen in Amsterdam, a garden city. They sit midway between useful objects and artworks, as applied art. Each stone is four metres wide, six metres long and sixty centimetres high.

name: L'après-midi d'un faune
en: L'aprés-midi d'un faune is an artistic artwork standing in a pond in the Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. Artist Ellen Beerthuis-Roos received the request for a statue for the Beatrixpark through the municipal committee, on which her teacher Piet Esser had a seat.

name: Zonder titel (Pjotr Müller)
en: On the Gaasperparkpad in Amsterdam-Zuidoost stands an untitled statue by Pjotr Müller. When the Bijlmermeer was laid out, money was set aside for artistic artworks. In a free commission, Müller was asked to supply a statue to be placed between the honeycomb flats Grubbehoeve and Grunder.

name: Zonder titel (Harry Karssen)
en: Westerpark in Amsterdam has a number of artistic artworks; some have a title and others are untitled. In the latter category is a statue made by Harry Karssen, although it is also sometimes called Tweetal.

name: Zonder titel (Nico Betjes)
en: In the middle of the small park of the Kleine Zonneplein in Amsterdam-Noord stands an untitled artistic artwork by Nico Betjes, on a plinth. During his career Betjes developed a shift from figurative to abstract works. In doing so he chose to leave out titles as well.

name: Arena (André Volten)
en: Arena is an alternative name, given by André Volten himself, for what would ultimately become an untitled artwork.

name: Zonder titel (Lies Hansen)
en: A temporary artwork was placed between bridge 864 and bridge 866 in March 2019. The junction of Strawinskylaan and Beethovenstraat has separated traffic flows. Motor traffic is routed over an embankment combined with a dike body, while slow traffic crosses beneath it through a tunnel system by means of the two named bridges.

name: Zonder titel (Piet Warffemius)
en: On the Amstelveenseweg in Amsterdam-Zuid stands an untitled artwork. It stands on the front garden near the entrance of house number 638. The artwork is a tree of bronze and a creation by Piet Warffemius from 2010. From the trunk spring two main branches, which themselves again have two side branches.

name: Zonder titel (Ben Guntenaar)
en: Along the Fred. Roeskestraat in Amsterdam-Zuid stands an untitled artistic artwork by Ben Guntenaar. Guntenaar, then a teacher at what would soon become the Gerrit Rietveld Academie, was asked by architect Gerrit Rietveld to design a statue for the garden belonging to the academy, which was designed by Mien Ruys.

name: Zonder titel (Hans Ittmann)
en: On De Mirandalaan in Amsterdam-Zuid stands an untitled artistic artwork by Hans Ittmann. He made this statue for the premises of the Joods Kindertehuis Le-Ezrath Ha-Jeled (The Child for Help), which was established here in 1965. Queen Juliana of the Netherlands came to open the building on 16 November 1965.

name: Zonder titel (Anna Enquist, Rokin)
en: On the Rokin in Amsterdam-Centrum, from 2017, there is an untitled poetic expression. It consists of lines of poetry by Anna Enquist applied to benches that protect a tree near Rokin 9-15. When the Rokin was redeveloped and repaved after the metro construction, the benches were placed.

name: Zonder titel (Jos Wong)
en: At the Verrijn Stuartweg metro station in Amsterdam-Zuidoost stands an untitled artistic artwork. It is a creation from 1980 by Jos Wong, who designed a moving artwork for a windy place. The metro station lies on a dike body, and this artwork also rises above the station.

name: Zonder titel (Vanessa Jane Phaff)
en: On the building at Lijnbaansgracht 60 in Amsterdam there is an untitled mural after Vanessa Jane Phaff. Phaff was born in Tarleton in 1965 and trained at the Willem de Kooning Academie. The building at Lijnbaansgracht 59-60, continuing to Westerstraat 252-254, is relatively new construction on the western edge of the Jordaan.

name: Zonder titel (Frans Hage)
en: On the Overtoom in Amsterdam-West stands an untitled artistic artwork. Around 1980 the Hollandsche Manege at Vondelstraat 140 in Amsterdam was restored. This riding school had a back facade that adjoined the buildings on the Overtoom. That building housed a dealer in classic cars of the Studebaker and Hillman makes.

name: Zonder titel (Kor Heemsbergen)
en: In the Nelson Mandelapark, south of the Karspeldreef, lies an untitled artistic artwork. It is a rough-hewn artwork from 1977 by Kor Heemsbergen (1936-2005), who was not only an artist but also a landscape designer. The work came to be popularly called Omegaberg and De hunebed (the dolmen).

name: Zonder titel (Adri Verhoeven)
en: On the Transvaalplein in Amsterdam-Oost lie two untitled statues by Adri Verhoeven. They are two polished granite stones resting on brick enclosures on the square. The two can be classified as early work. That square, dating from the 1910s, has been redesigned several times.

name: Zonder titel (Auke de Vries)
en: In the Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West there once stood an untitled group of statues by artist Auke de Vries.

name: Zonder titel (Tim Rodermans, metrobrug)
en: Under the metro bridge, bridge 1608 in Diemen, the walls are painted with an untitled artistic artwork. Bridge 1608, from the 1970s, was then built in grey concrete. During the (re)development of the surrounding neighbourhoods, this underpass was felt to be unsafe.

name: Zonder titel (Johan Sterenberg)
en: On the Drie Burgpad in Amsterdam-Oost stands an artistic untitled artwork by Johan Sterenberg. Various sports fields lie along this path. At the entrance of, among others, JOS Watergraafsmeer stands a flagpole at the division of the sports fields. This flagpole looks like every other flagpole, but there is a small difference.

name: Zonder titel (Herbert Nouwens)
en: In the Lepelkruisstraat in Amsterdam-Centrum, on a low wall, stands an untitled statue by Herbert Nouwens.

name: Zonder titel (Lies Maes, Groezestraat)
en: Along the Osdorper Ban in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, two untitled artistic artworks by Lies Maes could be seen. Around 1965 this little neighbourhood, known as De Punt (named for the shape of the neighbourhood toward the west), was built up. Artist Lies Maes was asked to brighten up two blind facades on the Osdorper Ban with a sculpture.

name: Zonder titel (Niels Keus)
en: In the Nelson Mandelapark in Amsterdam-Zuidoost stands an untitled artistic artwork by Niels Keus. Keus designs abstract statues in which geometric figures play the lead role. Cubes, discs and other forms touch or avoid one another.

name: Zonder titel (Henk Duijn)
en: In the Avercampstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid stands an untitled two-part artistic artwork by artist Henk Duijn. The artwork was placed in 1996 as a kind of entrance to the street. The two small columns were made in cooperation with children from the neighbourhood, recruited via Buurthuis De Pijp.

name: Zonder titel (Guido Geelen)
en: On the southern banks of the IJ in Amsterdam-Centrum stands an untitled artwork. It is meant to express the work ethic, solidarity and entrepreneurial spirit, and to connect the local with the international. It is a creation by Guido Geelen, who was asked to make a statue for this place. The financier wished to remain unknown.

name: Zonder titel (Bart Kelholt)
en: Along the Schoonhovendreef in Amsterdam-Zuidoost stands an untitled artistic artwork by Bart Kelholt (1946). The artwork is the outcome of a commission issued by the district of Amsterdam-Zuidoost. With his untitled work Kelholt conveyed the relationship between open space and large metal objects.

name: Zonder titel (Bas Peeperkorn)
en: In an overhang of a residential building on the Assendelftstraat in Amsterdam-West an untitled work by Bas Peeperkorn can be seen.

name: Zonder titel (Femmy Otten)
en: At the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery stands an untitled artistic artwork by Femmy Otten. Otten was still training at the Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten when a sculpture was allowed to be supplied for the exhibition Afterlife, organised by Tot Zover, which is based on the cemetery grounds.

name: Zonder titel (Govert Heikoop)
en: On the Tolstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid stands an untitled artistic artwork. This work by Govert Heikoop (1951-2007) was presumably placed around 1985 to complete a renovation of Cinetol towards the library and the construction of the neighbouring neighbourhood centre.

name: Zonder titel (Jos Kokke)
en: In a green strip west of the Dolingadreef, at the height of the Drostenburgbrug in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, stands an untitled artistic artwork. The work by Jos Kokke, dating from 1990, was popularly given the title Baken (Beacon) because of its shape. The meaning of the statue is described as twofold.

name: Zonnebaken
en: Zonnebaken is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Local residents call it De naald (the needle) or De punt (the point). It stands at a roundabout where the Meerkerkdreef crosses the Valburgdreef, and beyond the roundabout the through road becomes the Langbroekdreef.

name: ZT.AmstBos 2018
en: ZT.AmstBos 2018 is a natural and artistic artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos. That forest lies on the territory of Amstelveen but is managed by the municipality of Amsterdam. It is a work by artist Tom Claassen. Claassen was asked to shape the remains of a number of elms into an artwork.

name: Zuiver (muurschildering)
en: Zuiver is a mural in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Zülbiye Gündüz boom
en: Zülbiye Gündüz boom is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a work by Marianne van den Heuvel from 2000, which stands on the Vrolikstraat at house number 38, at the height of the Iepenweg. The tree is a memorial to Zülbiye Gündüz (1980-1993), who was killed here in March 1993, a girl in the wrong place at the wrong time.

name: Zwaan (beeld)
en: Zwaan is an artwork placed in the Rembrandtpark. The design of the animal came from the schoolgirl Esther Oude Ophuis as a 3D sketch design, with execution by artist Piet van der Kar. It was made in 2014 as part of a competition for the Art-Zuid-Junior art route, which yielded 160 designs.

name: Zwanen van de Watergraafsmeer
en: Zwanen van de Watergraafsmeer is a two-part form of art in public space in Amsterdam-Oost. Two swans bob about on a small park beside the Hugo de Vrieslaan, at the corner of the Fizeaustraat.

name: Zwerm (Paul Vendel)
en: (De) Zwerm is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a creation by artist Paul Vendel, who was allowed to supply an artwork for the junction of the Pieter Calandlaan and the Baden Powellweg, partly at the request of the Osdorp district council.

name: 's-Gravesandeplein 19 (beeld)
en: House number 's-Gravesandeplein 19 in Amsterdam is an artistic artwork applied to the building at 's-Gravesandeplein 19 on the 's-Gravesandeplein in Amsterdam-Oost. This building was constructed in 1902/1903 for the Oosterparkschool. Around 2004 it was redeveloped into a service centre.

name: A'damant
en: A'damant was a sculpture from 1985 by the artist Joost van Santen.

name: Airhead nr. 2
en: Airhead nr. 2 (Balloon head no. 2) is a mural in Amsterdam-Oost. It is also called Totem because of its depiction of a stack of little monsters (airheads), comparable to a totem pole or a cone of ice cream scoops.

name: Akpaku Evelia
en: Akpaku Evelia (calabash) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It was designed by Kokou Ferdinand Makouvia (1989, Togo). Oosterpark has an extensive collection of art in public space. The works date from long ago or are contemporary. From the first category there are the Oosterpark boundary posts; from the last, De Schreeuw.

name: All that glitters...
en: All that glitters... is a temporary artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work by Leonard van Munster can be seen in 2018/2019 in a pond north of the Frieda Belinfantebrug on the Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan.

name: Alleen verder
en: Alleen verder is a wall print in De Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid. When Mayor Eberhard van der Laan left in 2017 due to illness, Joep Bertrams made a drawing in which Van der Laan, as a father figure, lets go of Amsterdam: the city must go on alone, as the caption indicates.

name: Allendemonument
en: The Allendemonument is a statue and monument in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is an abstracted fist of concrete elements designed by Ton Blommerde. Blommerde, who also used the name Blommende, was inspired by the Inca and stacked the concrete parts without mortar.

name: Alles wat er op de markt te koop is
en: Alles wat er op de markt te koop is is an artwork by Reinder Bakker and Hester van Dijk in Amsterdam-Zuid. The artwork was placed in spring 2016 where the Albert Cuypstraat crosses the Van Woustraat. It was felt that walking along the Van Woustraat there were insufficient signals that this was the beginning (or end) of the Albert Cuypmarkt.

name: Anjerperk Vondelpark
en: The Anjerperk is a small memorial in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. The little plot was unveiled on 28 June 2019, one day before the national Veterans Day. It is part of an initiative by the Stichting Nationale Veteranendag to lay out small plots of carnations across the country in memory of veterans, on Carnation Day.

name: Betonplastiek (Ongenae)
en: Betonplastiek (concrete sculpture) is the neutral designation of a statue in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It stands near the Velodrome Amsterdam at Sportpark Sloten. It was designed by the Belgian-born artist Joseph Ongenae (1921-1993), who made it around 1973. The artist had by then already lived in Amsterdam for several years.

name: Bevrijdingslinde van de Jordaankinderen
en: Bevrijdingslinde van de Jordaankinderen is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. On 4 May 1946 a lime tree was planted in a small park at the Marnixplein, south of bridge 128, on the western side of the Lijnbaansgracht.

name: Bevrijdingsraam Amsterdam
en: The Bevrijdingsraam is a memorial window in the Nieuwe Kerk in Amsterdam, commemorating fifty years of liberation.

name: Blauwe reiger (muurschildering)
en: Blauwe reiger (Grey heron) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The mural is the work of the artist Adele Renault (born 1988), originally Belgian. The artwork was applied in 2018 to a partly blind wall of the building at Albert Cuypstraat 2-6 / Ruysdaelkade in Amsterdam.

name: Bokbier (gevelsteen)
en: Bokbier (bock beer) is a gable panel in Amsterdam-Oost. For the new building at Maurtskade 11/14, from around 1931, the sculptor Gerarda Rueter made a sculpture in the form of a relief with goats, ears of grain, hop cones and hop leaves. The last three are ingredients for bock beer, specifically Amstel Bock by Amstel.

name: De onbevangenheid der mensen tegenover het leven
en: De onbevangenheid der mensen tegenover het leven is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue from 1932 is a creation by Hildo Krop and stands on or next to the western abutment of the Kinderbrug between the Muzenplein and the Churchill-laan. It may or may not be part of a collection of sculptures standing here in a small park.

name: Aarde (Brettensuite 17)
en: Aarde (Brettensuite 17) is a statue placed on the Australiëhavenweg in Amsterdam Westpoort. Aarde is part of a group of statues titled Brettensuite, a series of artworks in the Brettenpark. The artist Herbert Nouwens called it 'beads on a string' running through the landscape.

name: Bruidsjurk (Patchwork)
en: Bruidsjurk is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is by the artists' collective Patchwork, consisting of Elleke Haspels, Karolien Helweg and Joanneke Meester. The artists, working from the grounds of the Westergasfabriek, wanted to exhibit a large artwork of their own within the Netherlands.

name: City cells
en: City cells is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The work hangs from pillars along the connecting route over the Hoekenrode between Amsterdamse Poort, Station Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA and the Johan Cruijff Boulevard (until 2020 the ArenA Boulevard).

name: Plaquette Westzaanstraat
en: The Plaquette Westzaanstraat is a war memorial (plaque) in Amsterdam-West. The plaque is found at house number 71 of the Westzaanstraat in the Spaarndammerbuurt.
